Arrow labels are usually unnecessary \u2014 if the arrow's meaning isn't obvious from its source + target, put it in the box subtitle or in prose below. Labels floating in space collide with things and are ambiguous.\n\n**Stroke width:** Use 0.5px strokes for diagram borders and edges \u2014 not 1px or 2px. Thin strokes feel more refined.\n\n**Connector paths need `fill=\"none\"`.** SVG defaults to `fill: black` \u2014 a curved connector without `fill=\"none\"` renders as a huge black shape instead of a clean line. Every `<path>` or `<polyline>` used as a connector/arrow MUST have `fill=\"none\"`. Only set fill on shapes meant to be filled (rects, circles, polygons).\n\n**Rect rounding:** `rx=\"4\"` for subtle corners. `rx=\"8\"` max for emphasized rounding. `rx` \u2265 half the height = pill shape \u2014 deliberate only.\n\n**Schematic containers use dashed rects with a label.** Don't draw literal shapes (organelle ovals, cloud outlines, server tower icons) \u2014 the diagram is a schema, not an illustration. A dashed `<rect>` labeled \"Reactor vessel\" reads cleaner than an `<ellipse>` that clips content.\n\n**Lines stop at component edges.** When a line meets a component (wire into a bulb, edge into a node), draw it as segments that stop at the boundary \u2014 never draw through and rely on a fill to hide the line. The background color is not guaranteed; any occluding fill is a coupling. Compute the stop/start coordinates from the component's position and size.\n\n**Physical-color scenes (sky, water, grass, skin, materials):** Use ALL hardcoded hex \u2014 never mix with `c-*` theme classes. The scene should not invert in dark mode. If you need a dark variant, provide it explicitly with `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` \u2014 this is the one place that's allowed. Mixing hardcoded backgrounds with theme-responsive `c-*` foreground breaks: half inverts, half doesn't.\n\n**No rotated text**. `<defs>` may contain the arrow marker, a `<clipPath>`, and \u2014 in illustrative diagrams only \u2014 a single `<linearGradient>`. Nothing else: no filters, no patterns, no extra markers.\n\n\n## Diagram types\n*\"Explain how compound interest works\" / \"How does a process scheduler work\"*\n\n**Two rules that cause most diagram failures \u2014 check these before writing each arrow and each box:**\n1. **Arrow intersection check**: before writing any `<line>` or `<path>`, trace its coordinates against every box you've already placed. If the line crosses any rect's interior (not just its source/target), it will visibly slash through that box \u2014 use an L-shaped `<path>` detour instead. This applies to arrows crossing labels too.\n2. **Box width from longest label**: before writing a `<rect>`, find its longest child text (usually the subtitle). `rect_width = max(title_chars \u00d7 8, subtitle_chars \u00d7 7) + 24`. A 100px-wide box holds at most a 10-char subtitle. If your subtitle is \"Files, APIs, streams\" (20 chars), the box needs 164px minimum \u2014 100px will visibly overflow.\n\n**Tier packing:** Compute total width BEFORE placing. Example \u2014 4 pub/sub consumer boxes:\n- WRONG: x=40,160,260,360 w=160 \u2192 40-60px overlaps (4\u00d7160=640 > 480 available)\n- RIGHT: x=50,200,350,500 w=130 gap=20 \u2192 fits (4\u00d7130 + 3\u00d720 = 580 \u2264 590 safe width; right edge at 630 \u2264 640)\nWork bottom-up for trees: size leaf tier first, parent width \u2265 sum of children.\n\n**Diagrams are the hardest use case** \u2014 they have the highest failure rate due to precise coordinate math. Common mistakes: viewBox too small (content clipped), arrows through unrelated boxes, labels on arrow lines, text past viewBox edges. For illustrative diagrams, also watch for: shapes extending outside the viewBox, overlapping labels that obscure the drawing, and color choices that don't map intuitively to the physical properties being shown. Double-check coordinates before finalizing.\n\nUse `imagine_svg` for diagrams. The widget automatically wraps SVG output in a card.\n\n**Pick the right diagram type.** The decision is about *intent*, not subject matter. Ask: is the user trying to *document* this, or *understand* it?\n\n**Reference diagrams** \u2014 the user wants a map they can point at. Precision matters more than feeling. Boxes, labels, arrows, containment. These are the diagrams you'd find in documentation.\n- **Flowchart** \u2014 steps in sequence, decisions branching, data transforming. Good for: approval workflows, request lifecycles, build pipelines, \"what happens when I click submit\". Trigger phrases: *\"walk me through the process\"*, *\"what are the steps\"*, *\"what's the flow\"*.\n- **Structural diagram** \u2014 things inside other things. Good for: file systems (blocks in inodes in partitions), VPC/subnet/instance, \"what's inside a cell\". Trigger phrases: *\"what's the architecture\"*, *\"how is this organised\"*, *\"where does X live\"*.\n\n**Intuition diagrams** \u2014 the user wants to *feel* how something works. The goal isn't a correct map, it's the right mental model. These should look nothing like a flowchart. The subject doesn't need a physical form \u2014 it needs a *visual metaphor*.\n- **Illustrative diagram** \u2014 draw the mechanism. Physical things get cross-sections (water heaters, engines, lungs). Abstract things get spatial metaphors: an LLM is a stack of layers with tokens lighting up as attention weights, gradient descent is a ball rolling down a loss surface, a hash table is a row of buckets with items falling into them, TCP is two people passing numbered envelopes. Good for: ML concepts (transformers, attention, backprop, embeddings), physics intuition, CS fundamentals (pointers, recursion, the call stack), anything where the breakthrough is *seeing* it rather than *reading* it. Trigger phrases: *\"how does X actually work\"*, *\"explain X\"*, *\"I don't get X\"*, *\"give me an intuition for X\"*.\n\n**Route on the verb, not the noun.** Same subject, different diagram depending on what was asked:\n\n| User says | Type | What to draw |\n|---|---|---|\n| \"how do LLMs work\" | **Illustrative** | Token row, stacked layer slabs, attention threads glowing warm between tokens. Go interactive if you can. |\n| \"transformer architecture\" | Structural | Labelled boxes: embedding, attention heads, FFN, layer norm. |\n| \"how does attention work\" | **Illustrative** | One query token, a fan of lines to every key, line opacity = weight. |\n| \"how does gradient descent work\" | **Illustrative** | Contour surface, a ball, a trail of steps. Slider for learning rate. |\n| \"what are the training steps\" | Flowchart | Forward \u2192 loss \u2192 backward \u2192 update. Boxes and arrows. |\n| \"how does TCP work\" | **Illustrative** | Two endpoints, numbered packets in flight, an ACK returning. |\n| \"TCP handshake sequence\" | Flowchart | SYN \u2192 SYN-ACK \u2192 ACK. Three boxes. |\n| \"explain the Krebs cycle\" / \"how does the event loop work\" | **HTML stepper** | Click through stages. Never a ring. |\n| \"how does a hash map work\" | **Illustrative** | Key falling through a funnel into one of N buckets. |\n| \"draw the database schema\" / \"show me the ERD\" | **mermaid.js** | `erDiagram` syntax. Not SVG. |\n\nThe illustrative route is the default for *\"how does X work\"* with no further qualification. It is the more ambitious choice \u2014 don't chicken out into a flowchart because it feels safer. Claude draws these well.\n\nDon't mix families in one diagram. If you need both, draw the intuition version first (build the mental model), then the reference version (fill in the precise labels) as a second tool call with prose between.\n\n**For complex topics, use multiple SVG calls** \u2014 break the explanation into a series of smaller diagrams rather than one dense diagram. Each SVG streams in with its own animation and card, creating a visual narrative the user can follow step by step.\n\n**Always add prose between diagrams** \u2014 never stack multiple SVG calls back-to-back without text. Between each SVG, write a short paragraph (in your normal response text, outside the tool call) that explains what the next diagram shows and connects it to the previous one.\n\n**Promise only what you deliver** \u2014 if your response text says \"here are three diagrams\", you must include all three tool calls. Never promise a follow-up diagram and omit it. If you can only fit one diagram, adjust your text to match. One complete diagram is better than three promised and one delivered.\n\n#### Flowchart\n\nFor sequential processes, cause-and-effect, decision trees.\n\n**Planning**: Size boxes to fit their text generously. At 14px sans-serif, each character is ~8px wide \u2014 a label like \"Load Balancer\" (13 chars) needs a rect at least 140px wide. When in doubt, make boxes wider and leave more space between them. Cramped diagrams are the most common failure mode.\n\n**Special characters are wider**: Chemical formulas (C\u2086H\u2081\u2082O\u2086), math notation (\u2211, \u222b, \u221a), subscripts/superscripts via <tspan> with dy/baseline-shift, and Unicode symbols all render wider than plain Latin characters. For labels containing formulas or special notation, add 30-50% extra width to your estimate. When in doubt, make the box wider \u2014 overflow looks worse than extra padding.\n\n**Spacing**: 60px minimum between boxes, 24px padding inside boxes, 12px between text and edges. Leave 10px gap between arrowheads and box edges. Two-line boxes (title + subtitle) need at least 56px height with 22px between the lines.\n\n**Vertical text placement**: Every `<text>` inside a box needs `dominant-baseline=\"central\"`, with y set to the *centre* of the slot it sits in. Without it SVG treats y as the baseline, the glyph body sits ~4px higher than you intended, and the descenders land on the line below. Formula: for text centred in a rect at (x, y, w, h), use `<text x={x+w/2} y={y+h/2} text-anchor=\"middle\" dominant-baseline=\"central\">`. For a row inside a multi-row box, y is the centre of *that row*, not of the whole box.\n\n**Layout**: Prefer single-direction flows (all top-down or all left-right). Keep diagrams simple \u2014 max 4-5 nodes per diagram. The widget is narrow (~680px) so complex layouts break.\n\n**When the prompt itself is over budget**: if the user lists 6+ components (\"draw me auth, products, orders, payments, gateway, queue\"), don't draw all of them in one pass \u2014 you'll get overlapping boxes and arrows through text, every time. Decompose: (1) a stripped overview with the boxes only and at most one or two arrows showing the main flow \u2014 no fan-outs, no N-to-N meshes; (2) then one diagram per interesting sub-flow (\"here's what happens when an order is placed\", \"here's the auth handshake\"), each with 3-4 nodes and room to breathe. Count the nouns before you draw. The user asked for completeness \u2014 give it to them across several diagrams, not crammed into one.\n\n**Cycles don't get drawn as rings.** If the last stage feeds back into the first (Krebs cycle, event loop, GC mark-and-sweep, TCP retransmit), your instinct is to place the stages around a circle. Don't. Every spacing rule in this spec is Cartesian \u2014 there is no collision check for \"input box orbits outside stage box on a ring\". You will get satellite boxes overlapping the stages they feed, labels sitting on the dashed circle, and tangential arrows that point nowhere. The ring is decoration; the loop is conveyed by the return arrow.\n\nBuild a stepper in `imagine_html`. One panel per stage, dots or pills showing position (\u25cf \u25cb \u25cb), Next wraps from the last stage back to the first \u2014 that's the loop. Each panel owns its inputs and products: an event loop's pending callbacks live *inside* the Poll panel, not floating next to a box on a ring. Nothing collides because nothing shares the canvas. Only fall back to a linear SVG (stages in a row, curved `<path>` return arrow) when there's one input and one output total and no per-stage detail to show.\n\n**Feedback loops in linear flows:** Don't draw a physical arrow traversing the layout (it fights the flow direction and clips edges). Instead:\n- Small `\u21bb` glyph + text near the cycle point: `<text>\u21bb returns to start</text>`\n- Or restructure the whole diagram as a circle if the cycle IS the point\n\n**Arrows:** A line from A to B must not cross any other box or label. If the direct path crosses something, route around with an L-bend: `<path d=\"M x1 y1 L x1 ymid L x2 ymid L x2 y2\"/>`. Place arrow labels in clear space, not on the midpoint.\n\nKeep all nodes the same height when they have the same content type (e.g. all single-line boxes = 44px, all two-line boxes = 56px).\n\n**Flowchart components** \u2014 use these patterns consistently:\n\n*Single-line node* (44px tall): title only. The `c-blue` class sets fill, stroke, and text colors for both light and dark mode automatically \u2014 no `<style>` block needed.\n```svg\n<g class=\"node c-blue\" onclick=\"sendPrompt('Tell me more about T-cells')\">\n  <rect x=\"100\" y=\"20\" width=\"180\" height=\"44\" rx=\"8\" stroke-width=\"0.5\"/>\n  <text class=\"th\" x=\"190\" y=\"42\" text-anchor=\"middle\" dominant-baseline=\"central\">T-cells</text>\n</g>\n```\n\n*Two-line node* (56px tall): bold title + muted subtitle.\n```svg\n<g class=\"node c-blue\" onclick=\"sendPrompt('Tell me more about dendritic cells')\">\n  <rect x=\"100\" y=\"20\" width=\"200\" height=\"56\" rx=\"8\" stroke-width=\"0.5\"/>\n  <text class=\"th\" x=\"200\" y=\"38\" text-anchor=\"middle\" dominant-baseline=\"central\">Dendritic cells</text>\n  <text class=\"ts\" x=\"200\" y=\"56\" text-anchor=\"middle\" dominant-baseline=\"central\">Detect foreign antigens</text>\n</g>\n```\n\n*Connector* (no label \u2014 meaning is clear from source + target):\n```svg\n<line x1=\"200\" y1=\"76\" x2=\"200\" y2=\"120\" class=\"arr\" marker-end=\"url(#arrow)\"/>\n```\n\n*Neutral node* (gray, for start/end/generic steps): use `class=\"box\"` for auto-themed fill/stroke, and default text classes.\n\nMake all nodes clickable by default \u2014 wrap in `<g class=\"node\" onclick=\"sendPrompt('...')\">`. The hover effect is built in.\n\n#### Structural diagram\n\nFor concepts where physical or logical containment matters \u2014 things inside other things.\n\n**When to use**: The explanation depends on *where* processes happen. Examples: how a cell works (organelles inside a cell), how a file system works (blocks inside inodes inside partitions), how a building's HVAC works (ducts inside floors inside a building), how a CPU cache hierarchy works (L1 inside core, L2 shared).\n\n**Core idea**: Large rounded rects are containers. Smaller rects inside them are regions or sub-structures. Text labels describe what happens in each region. Arrows show flow between regions or from external inputs/outputs.\n\n**Container rules**:\n- Outermost container: large rounded rect, rx=20-24, lightest fill (50 stop), 0.5px stroke (600 stop). Label at top-left inside, 14px bold.\n- Inner regions: medium rounded rects, rx=8-12, next shade fill (100-200 stop). Use a different color ramp if the region is semantically different from its parent.\n- 20px minimum padding inside every container \u2014 text and inner regions must not touch the container edges.\n- Max 2-3 nesting levels. Deeper nesting gets unreadable at 680px width.\n\n**Layout**:\n- Place inner regions side by side within the container, with 16px+ gap between them.\n- External inputs (sunlight, water, data, requests) sit outside the container with arrows pointing in.\n- External outputs sit outside with arrows pointing out.\n- Keep external labels short \u2014 one word or a short phrase. Details go in the prose between diagrams.\n\n**What goes inside regions**: Text only \u2014 the region name (14px bold) and a short description of what happens there (12px). Don't put flowchart-style boxes inside regions. Don't draw illustrations or icons inside.\n\n**Structural container example** (library branch with two side-by-side regions, an internal labeled arrow, and an external input). ViewBox 700x320, horizontal layout, color classes handle both light and dark mode \u2014 no `<style>` block:\n```svg\n<defs>\n  <marker id=\"arrow\" viewBox=\"0 0 10 10\" refX=\"8\" refY=\"5\" markerWidth=\"6\" markerHeight=\"6\" orient=\"auto-start-reverse\">\n    <path d=\"M2 1L8 5L2 9\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"context-stroke\" stroke-width=\"1.5\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\"/>\n  </marker>\n</defs>\n<!-- Outer container -->\n<g class=\"c-green\">\n  <rect x=\"120\" y=\"30\" width=\"560\" height=\"260\" rx=\"20\" stroke-width=\"0.5\"/>\n  <text distinct ramps \u2014 `c-{ramp}` classes resolve to fixed fill/stroke stops, so the same class on parent and child gives identical fills and flattens the hierarchy. Pick a *related* ramp for inner structures (e.g. Green for the library envelope, Teal for the circulation desk inside it) and a *contrasting* ramp for a region that does something functionally different (e.g. Amber for the reading room). This keeps the diagram scannable \u2014 you can see at a glance which parts are related.\n\n**Database schemas / ERDs \u2014 use mermaid.js, not SVG.** A schema table is a header plus N field rows plus typed columns plus crow's-foot connectors. That is a text-layout problem and hand-placing it in SVG fails the same way every time. mermaid.js `erDiagram` does layout, cardinality, and connector routing for free. ERDs only; everything else stays in SVG.\n\n```\nerDiagram\n  USERS ||--o{ POSTS : writes\n  POSTS ||--o{ COMMENTS : has\n  USERS {\n    uuid id PK\n    string email\n    timestamp created_at\n  }\n  POSTS {\n    uuid id PK\n    uuid user_id FK\n    string title\n  }\n```\n\nUse `imagine_html` for ERDs. The subject might be physical (an engine, a lung) or completely abstract (attention, recursion, gradient descent) \u2014 what matters is that a spatial drawing conveys the mechanism better than labelled boxes would. These are the diagrams that make someone go \"oh, *that's* what it's doing.\"\n\n**Two flavours, same rules:**\n- **Physical subjects** get drawn as simplified versions of themselves. Cross-sections, cutaways, schematics. A water heater is a tank with a burner underneath. A lung is a branching tree in a cavity. You're drawing *the thing*, stylised.\n- **Abstract subjects** get drawn as *spatial metaphors*. You're inventing a shape for something that doesn't have one \u2014 but the shape should make the mechanism obvious. A transformer is a stack of horizontal slabs with a bright thread of attention connecting tokens across layers. A hash function is a funnel scattering items into a row of buckets. The call stack is literally a stack of frames growing and shrinking. Embeddings are dots clustering in space. The metaphor *is* the explanation.\n\nThis is the most ambitious diagram type and the one Claude is best at. Lean into it. Use colour for intensity (a hot attention weight glows amber, a cold one stays gray). Use repetition for scale (many small circles = many parameters).\n\n**Prefer interactive over static.** A static cross-section is a good answer; a cross-section you can *operate* is a great one. The decision rule: if the real-world system has a control, give the diagram that control. A water heater has a thermostat \u2014 so give the user a slider that shifts the hot/cold boundary, a toggle that fires the burner and animates convection currents. An LLM has input tokens \u2014 let the user click one and watch the attention weights re-fan. A cache has a hit rate \u2014 let them drag it and watch latency change. Reach for `imagine_html` with inline SVG first; only fall back to static `imagine_svg` when there's genuinely nothing to twiddle.\n\n**When NOT to use**: The user is asking for a *reference*, not an *intuition*. \"What are the components of a transformer\" wants labelled boxes \u2014 that's a structural diagram. \"Walk me through our CI pipeline\" wants sequential steps \u2014 that's a flowchart. Also skip this when the metaphor would be arbitrary rather than revealing: drawing \"the cloud\" as a cloud shape or \"microservices\" as little houses doesn't teach anything about how they work. If the drawing doesn't make the *mechanism* clearer, don't draw it.\n\n**Fidelity ceiling**: These are schematics, not illustrations. Every shape should read at a glance. If a `<path>` needs more than ~6 segments to draw, simplify it. A tank is a rounded rect, not a B\u00e9zier portrait of a tank. A flame is three triangles, not a fire. Recognisable silhouette beats accurate contour every time \u2014 if you find yourself carefully tracing an outline, you're overshooting.\n\n**Core principle**: Draw the mechanism, not a diagram *about* the mechanism. Spatial arrangement carries the meaning; labels annotate. A good illustrative diagram works with the labels removed.\n\n**What changes from flowchart/structural rules**:\n\n- **Shapes are freeform.** Use `<path>`, `<ellipse>`, `<circle>`, `<polygon>`, and curved lines to represent real forms. A water tank is a tall rect with rounded bottom. A heart valve is a pair of curved paths. A circuit trace is a thin polyline. You are not limited to rounded rects.\n- **Layout follows the subject's geometry**, not a grid. If the thing is tall and narrow (a water heater, a thermometer), the diagram is tall and narrow. If it's wide and flat (a PCB, a geological cross-section), the diagram is wide. Let the subject dictate proportions within the 680px viewBox width.\n- **Color encodes intensity**, not category. For physical subjects: warm ramps (amber, coral, red) = heat/energy/pressure, cool ramps (blue, teal) = cold/calm, gray = inert structure. For abstract subjects: warm = active/high-weight/attended-to, cool or gray = dormant/low-weight/ignored. A user should be able to glance at the diagram and see *where the action is* without reading a single label.\n- **Layering and overlap are encouraged \u2014 for shapes.** Unlike flowcharts where boxes must never overlap, illustrative diagrams can layer shapes for depth \u2014 a pipe entering a tank, attention lines fanning through layers, insulation wrapping a chamber. Use z-ordering (later in source = on top) deliberately.\n- **Text is the exception \u2014 never let a stroke cross it.** The overlap permission is for shapes only. Every label needs 8px of clear air between its baseline/cap-height and the nearest stroke. Don't solve this with a background rect \u2014 solve it by *placing the text somewhere else*. Labels go in the quiet regions: above the drawing, below it, in the margin with a leader line, or in the gap between two fans of lines. If there is no quiet region, the drawing is too dense \u2014 remove something or split into two diagrams.\n- **Small shape-based indicators are allowed** when they communicate physical state. Triangles for flames. Circles for bubbles or particles. Wavy lines for steam or heat radiation. Parallel lines for vibration. These aren't decoration \u2014 they tell the user what's happening physically. Keep them simple: basic SVG primitives, not detailed illustrations.\n- **One gradient per diagram is permitted** \u2014 the only exception to the global no-gradients rule \u2014 and only to show a *continuous* physical property across a region (temperature stratification in a tank, pressure drop along a pipe, concentration in a solution). It must be a single `<linearGradient>` between exactly two stops from the same colour ramp. No radial gradients, no multi-stop fades, no gradient-as-aesthetic. If two stacked flat-fill rects communicate the same thing, do that instead.\n- **Animation is permitted for interactive HTML versions.** Use CSS `@keyframes` animating only `transform` and `opacity`. Keep loops under ~2s, and wrap every animation in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` so it's opt-out by default. Animations should show how the system *behaves* \u2014 convection current, rotation, flow \u2014 not just move for the sake of moving. No physics engines or heavy libraries.\n\nAll core rules still apply (viewBox 680px, dark mode mandatory, 14/12px text, pre-built classes, arrow marker, clickable nodes).\n\n**Label placement**:\n- Place labels *outside* the drawn object when possible, with a thin leader line (0.5px dashed, `var(--t)` stroke) pointing to the relevant part. This keeps the illustration uncluttered.\n- For large internal zones (like temperature regions in a tank), labels can sit inside if there's ample clear space \u2014 minimum 20px from any edge.\n- External labels sit in the margin area or above/below the object. **Pick one side for labels and put them all there** \u2014 at 680px wide you don't have room for a drawing *and* label columns on both sides. Reserve at least 140px of horizontal margin on the label side. Labels on the left are the ones that clip: `text-anchor=\"end\"` extends leftward from x, and with multi-line callouts it's very easy to blow past x=0 without noticing. Default to right-side labels with `text-anchor=\"start\"` unless the subject's geometry forces otherwise. Use `class=\"ts\"` (12px) for callouts, `class=\"th\"` (14px medium) for major component names.\n\n**Composition approach**:\n1. Start with the main object's silhouette \u2014 the largest shape, centered in the viewBox.\n2. Add internal structure: chambers, pipes, membranes, mechanical parts.\n3. Add external connections: pipes entering/exiting, arrows showing flow direction, labels for inputs and outputs.\n4. Add state indicators last: color fills showing temperature/pressure/concentration, small animated elements showing movement or energy.\n5. Leave generous whitespace around the object for labels \u2014 don't crowd annotations against the viewBox edges.\n\n**Static vs interactive**: Static cutaways and cross-sections work best as pure `imagine_svg`. Pastikan: (1) set <code>is_used = true</code> segera setelah token digunakan, (2) tolak token yang sudah expired, (3) simpan token dalam bentuk hash, bukan plain text.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>user_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td>FK ke users</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>token</code></td><td>VARCHAR(255)</td><td><span class=\"badge b-uk\">UNIQUE</span></td><td>SHA-256 dari token asli</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>expires_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Biasanya NOW() + 1 jam</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>is_used</code></td><td>BOOLEAN</td><td>DEFAULT FALSE</td><td>TRUE setelah dipakai</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>created_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>DEFAULT NOW()</td><td></td></tr>\n    </table>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_password_reset_tokens_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#E1F5EE;color:#085041\">4</div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>login_attempts</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">Mencatat setiap percobaan login \u2014 berhasil maupun gagal. Tabel ini adalah lapisan keamanan pertama melawan serangan brute force.</div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-why\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">BAGAIMANA CARA KERJANYA?</div>\n      <p>Setiap kali ada percobaan login, catat email + IP + hasil (sukses/gagal) ke tabel ini. Sebelum memproses login, cek: apakah ada 5 atau lebih baris <code>is_success = false</code> dalam 15 menit terakhir dari email atau IP yang sama? Jika ya, tolak login dan tampilkan pesan \"Akun dikunci sementara\".</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>email</code></td><td>VARCHAR(150)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Email yang dicoba</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>ip_address</code></td><td>VARCHAR(45)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>IPv4 atau IPv6</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>is_success</code></td><td>BOOLEAN</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>TRUE = login berhasil</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>attempted_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>DEFAULT NOW()</td><td>Waktu percobaan</td></tr>\n    </table>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-tip\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">TIPS PERFORMA</div>\n      <p>Tambahkan INDEX pada kolom <code>email</code> dan <code>attempted_at</code> karena dua kolom ini yang paling sering dipakai dalam kondisi WHERE saat mengecek brute force. Tanpa index, query akan lambat jika tabel sudah berisi jutaan baris log.</p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_login_attempts_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n</div>\n</div>\n\n<!-- ===== FASE 2 ===== -->\n<div id=\"pg-phase2\" class=\"pg\">\n<div class=\"phase-header\">\n  <div class=\"phase-title\">Fase 2 \u2014 Profil Lengkap Pelamar</div>\n  <div class=\"phase-desc\">Fase ini membangun semua tabel yang menyimpan kelengkapan profil profesional pelamar: CV, pengalaman kerja, pendidikan, dan skill. Semua tabel di fase ini punya FK ke <code>users</code>, jadi Fase 1 harus sudah selesai.</div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step-list\">\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#E6F1FB;color:#0C447C\">5</div>\n    <div class=\"step-line\" style=\"background:var(--color-border-secondary)\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>cv_templates</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">Master data template CV yang disediakan sistem. Tidak punya FK ke mana-mana \u2014 tabel ini mandiri. Dibuat di sini karena tabel berikutnya (<code>applicant_cvs</code>) butuh tabel ini.</div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-why\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">KENAPA TEMPLATE DIPISAH JADI TABEL SENDIRI?</div>\n      <p>Jika template di-hardcode di aplikasi, HR tidak bisa menambah atau mengubah template tanpa ubah kode. Dengan tabel ini, HR bisa kelola template dari panel admin: tambah template baru, nonaktifkan yang lama, tanpa perlu developer. Kolom <code>is_active</code> memungkinkan template dihide tanpa menghapus data historis CV yang sudah menggunakan template tersebut.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>name</code></td><td>VARCHAR(100)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Nama template, misal \"Modern Blue\"</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>preview_url</code></td><td>VARCHAR(500)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Gambar preview template</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>is_active</code></td><td>BOOLEAN</td><td>DEFAULT TRUE</td><td>FALSE = tidak tampil ke pelamar</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>created_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>DEFAULT NOW()</td><td></td></tr>\n    </table>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_cv_templates_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#E6F1FB;color:#0C447C\">6</div>\n    <div class=\"step-line\" style=\"background:var(--color-border-secondary)\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>applicant_cvs</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">CV yang dibuat pelamar dari template yang tersedia. Satu pelamar bisa punya banyak CV untuk posisi berbeda. FK ke <code>users</code> dan <code>cv_templates</code> \u2014 keduanya harus sudah ada.</div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-why\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">KENAPA cv_data BERTIPE JSON?</div>\n      <p>Setiap template CV punya struktur isian yang berbeda \u2014 template \"Profesional\" mungkin punya 10 section, template \"Simpel\" hanya 5 section. Dengan JSON, kita bisa menyimpan struktur isian yang fleksibel tanpa perlu membuat kolom berbeda per template. Contoh isinya: <code>{\"nama\":\"Ali\",\"ringkasan\":\"...\",\"pengalaman\":[...]}</code>.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-warn\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">PENTING \u2014 SNAPSHOT CV SAAT MELAMAR</div>\n      <p>Saat pelamar melamar pekerjaan, tabel <code>applications</code> menyimpan <code>cv_id</code> yang mereferensikan CV saat itu. Jika pelamar kemudian mengedit CV-nya, data lamaran tidak berubah karena sudah mengacu ke snapshot lama. Ini penting untuk integritas data rekrutmen.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>user_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td>Pemilik CV</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>template_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td>Template yang dipakai</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>title</code></td><td>VARCHAR(150)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Judul CV, misal \"CV untuk IT\"</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>cv_data</code></td><td>JSON</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Isian form CV fleksibel</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>pdf_url</code></td><td>VARCHAR(500)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Path PDF yang sudah digenerate</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>is_primary</code></td><td>BOOLEAN</td><td>DEFAULT FALSE</td><td>CV utama, otomatis terpilih saat melamar</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>created_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>DEFAULT NOW()</td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>updated_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td></td></tr>\n    </table>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_applicant_cvs_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#E6F1FB;color:#0C447C\">7</div>\n    <div class=\"step-line\" style=\"background:var(--color-border-secondary)\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>work_experiences</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">Riwayat pengalaman kerja pelamar. Dipisah dari work_experiences karena strukturnya berbeda (ada jurusan, IPK, jenjang).</div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>user_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>institution</code></td><td>VARCHAR(200)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Nama sekolah/universitas</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>degree</code></td><td>ENUM</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>'SMA','D3','S1','S2','S3'</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>major</code></td><td>VARCHAR(150)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Jurusan/program studi</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>gpa</code></td><td>DECIMAL(3,2)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>IPK, misal 3.75</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>start_year</code></td><td>YEAR</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Tahun masuk</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>end_year</code></td><td>YEAR</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Tahun lulus, NULL = masih studi</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>created_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>DEFAULT NOW()</td><td></td></tr>\n    </table>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_educations_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#E6F1FB;color:#0C447C\">9</div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>applicant_skills</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">Daftar skill dan sertifikasi yang dimiliki pelamar. Satu pelamar bisa punya banyak skill dengan kategori dan level berbeda.</div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-tip\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">TIPS DESAIN</div>\n      <p>Kolom <code>cert_url</code> bisa berisi URL ke file sertifikat yang diupload (misal PDF dari Google Drive atau storage lokal). Jika tidak ada sertifikasi, biarkan NULL. Kolom <code>category</code> membantu HR memfilter kandidat berdasarkan jenis kemampuan.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>user_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>skill_name</code></td><td>VARCHAR(100)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Misal: Laravel, Excel, Bahasa Inggris</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>category</code></td><td>ENUM</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>'technical','soft','language'</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>level</code></td><td>ENUM</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>'beginner','intermediate','expert'</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>cert_name</code></td><td>VARCHAR(200)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Nama sertifikasi jika ada</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>cert_url</code></td><td>VARCHAR(500)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Link atau path file sertifikat</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>created_at</code></td><td>TIMESTAMP</td><td>DEFAULT NOW()</td><td></td></tr>\n    </table>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_applicant_skills_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n</div>\n</div>\n\n<!-- ===== FASE 3 ===== -->\n<div id=\"pg-phase3\" class=\"pg\">\n<div class=\"phase-header\">\n  <div class=\"phase-title\">Fase 3 \u2014 Lowongan Pekerjaan</div>\n  <div class=\"phase-desc\">Fase ini membangun sistem manajemen lowongan. Dimulai dari master kategori, lalu tabel lowongan utama dengan FULLTEXT index, dan tabel bookmark. Semua bergantung pada <code>users</code> yang sudah ada di Fase 1.</div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step-list\">\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806\">10</div>\n    <div class=\"step-line\" style=\"background:var(--color-border-secondary)\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>job_categories</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">Master data kategori lowongan. Tidak punya FK \u2014 tabel mandiri. Harus dibuat sebelum <code>job_postings</code> karena lowongan butuh kategori.</div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-why\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">FUNGSI KOLOM SLUG</div>\n      <p>Slug adalah versi URL-friendly dari nama kategori. Contoh: nama \"IT & Engineering\" menjadi slug \"it-engineering\". Slug dipakai di URL halaman kategori seperti <code>/jobs/it-engineering</code> agar URL bersih dan SEO-friendly. Kolom ini harus UNIQUE karena dua kategori tidak boleh punya URL yang sama.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>name</code></td><td>VARCHAR(100)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Nama kategori, misal \"IT & Engineering\"</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>slug</code></td><td>VARCHAR(120)</td><td><span class=\"badge b-uk\">UNIQUE</span></td><td>URL-friendly, misal \"it-engineering\"</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>icon</code></td><td>VARCHAR(100)</td><td>NULLABLE</td><td>Nama ikon CSS atau path gambar</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>is_active</code></td><td>BOOLEAN</td><td>DEFAULT TRUE</td><td>FALSE = kategori disembunyikan</td></tr>\n    </table>\n    <div class=\"code-block\">php artisan make:migration create_job_categories_table</div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div class=\"step\">\n  <div class=\"step-left\">\n    <div class=\"step-num\" style=\"background:#FAEEDA;color:#633806\">11</div>\n    <div class=\"step-line\" style=\"background:var(--color-border-secondary)\"></div>\n  </div>\n  <div class=\"step-body\">\n    <div class=\"step-title\">Buat tabel <code>job_postings</code></div>\n    <div class=\"step-desc\">Tabel terpenting dari sisi HR. Menyimpan semua data lowongan lengkap dengan mekanisme tutup otomatis dan FULLTEXT index untuk pencarian cepat.</div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-why\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">MEKANISME TUTUP OTOMATIS \u2014 BAGAIMANA CARA KERJANYA?</div>\n      <p>Ada dua trigger tutup otomatis: (1) <strong>Kuota:</strong> setiap lamaran baru masuk, kolom <code>applicant_count</code> bertambah 1. Jika sudah sama dengan <code>quota</code>, sistem otomatis ubah <code>status = 'closed'</code>. (2) <strong>Deadline:</strong> Laravel Scheduler menjalankan cron job setiap hari yang mengecek lowongan dengan <code>deadline < TODAY()</code> dan mengubah statusnya menjadi <code>expired</code>.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-note\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">TENTANG FULLTEXT INDEX</div>\n      <p>FULLTEXT INDEX memungkinkan pencarian teks alami yang jauh lebih cepat dan relevan dibanding LIKE '%keyword%'. Query LIKE selalu full table scan (lambat), sedangkan FULLTEXT menggunakan inverted index (sangat cepat). Di MySQL, tambahkan: <code>FULLTEXT KEY ft_job_search (title, description, requirements, benefits)</code>. Lalu query dengan: <code>MATCH(title,description,requirements,benefits) AGAINST(? IN BOOLEAN MODE)</code>.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <div class=\"info-card ic-danger\">\n      <div class=\"ic-label\">HATI-HATI RACE CONDITION PADA KUOTA</div>\n      <p>Jika ada dua pelamar submit lamaran bersamaan dan kuota tersisa 1, bisa terjadi race condition \u2014 keduanya berhasil melamar padahal seharusnya hanya satu. Gunakan database transaction dengan SELECT ... FOR UPDATE saat mengecek dan mengupdate <code>applicant_count</code> untuk mencegah ini.</p>\n    </div>\n\n    <table class=\"col-table\">\n      <tr><th>Kolom</th><th>Tipe</th><th>Constraint</th><th>Keterangan</th></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-pk\">PK</span></td><td></td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>hr_user_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td>HR yang membuat lowongan</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>category_id</code></td><td>BIGINT UNSIGNED</td><td><span class=\"badge b-fk\">FK</span></td><td>Kategori pekerjaan</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>title</code></td><td>VARCHAR(200)</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Judul posisi</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>slug</code></td><td>VARCHAR(220)</td><td><span class=\"badge b-uk\">UNIQUE</span></td><td>URL-friendly dari judul</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>description</code></td><td>TEXT</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Deskripsi pekerjaan</td></tr>\n      <tr><td><code>requirements</code></td><td>TEXT</td><td>NOT NULL</td><td>Kualifikasi yang 1113:    "text": "Panduan ini terbagi menjadi **8 tab** yang bisa dikerjakan satu per satu:\n\n**Gambaran Umum** menjelaskan mengapa urutan tabel itu penting dan menampilkan daftar lengkap urutan 1\u201318 beserta alasannya. **Fase 1\u20136** masing-masing berisi step detail setiap tabel lengkap dengan struktur kolom, tipe data, constraint, dan yang paling penting \u2014 penjelasan *kenapa* setiap keputusan desain dibuat seperti itu. **Checklist Final** berisi 16 poin yang bisa dicentang satu per satu sebelum menjalankan `php artisan migrate`.\n\nBeberapa hal yang paling kritis untuk diingat: tabel `users` adalah fondasi segalanya dan harus pertama kali dibuat, `password_hash` wajib bcrypt bukan plain text, `FULLTEXT INDEX` di `job_postings` adalah kunci fitur search, `application_status_logs` tidak boleh bisa diedit atau dihapus, dan `hr_notes` di `applications` harus disembunyikan dari response API pelamar.\n\nSetelah semua migration selesai dibuat, langkah berikutnya adalah membuat **Seeder** untuk data dummy. Mau saya bantu juga dengan itu?",

1496:    "text": "Ketemu! Sekarang saya paham dengan jelas apa itu Antigravity. Berikut jawaban lengkapnya untuk konteks project Anda:\n\n---\n\n## Apa itu Google Antigravity?\n\nGoogle Antigravity adalah agentic development platform yang diluncurkan November 2025 \u2014 bukan sekadar code editor biasa. Ini adalah IDE berbasis fork dari VS Code, didukung Gemini 3, yang dirancang agar developer bisa bekerja di level task yang lebih tinggi. Daripada menulis setiap baris kode, Anda mendelegasikan task ke AI agent yang bekerja lintas editor, terminal, dan browser secara otonom.\n\nKonsep intinya: daripada chat dengan satu AI assistant, Anda mengirim beberapa agent yang bekerja paralel \u2014 satu merencanakan arsitektur, satu menulis kode, satu menjalankan test, dan satu lagi browsing app yang sedang berjalan untuk mengecek UI.\n\n---\n\n## Biasanya digunakan untuk project berbasis apa?\n\nAntigravity digunakan untuk membangun aplikasi modern seperti Flutter, React, Angular, dan Next.js. Pendekatannya \"vibe coding\" \u2014 Anda mendeskripsikan apa yang diinginkan, agent membuat rencana, lalu mengeksekusi semua file, dependency, dan testing secara mandiri.\n\nYang perlu Anda tahu \u2014 Antigravity mendukung beberapa model AI sekaligus: Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.6, dan GPT-OSS 120B. Artinya Anda bisa pakai saya (Claude) langsung di dalam Antigravity.\n\n---\n\n## Apakah cocok untuk project E-Recruitment Anda?\n\nJawabannya: **bisa, tapi ada batasan penting yang perlu Anda tahu.**\n\n**Yang Antigravity unggul:**\n- Membuat scaffolding awal project Laravel dengan cepat\n- Membuat file-file boilerplate (controller, model, route)\n- Mengeksekusi perintah terminal seperti `php artisan make:migration` secara otomatis\n- Membuat komponen frontend HTML/CSS/JS\n- Agent-nya membuat Implementation Plan terlebih dahulu sebelum eksekusi, jadi Anda bisa review dulu sebelum kode ditulis\n\n**Yang perlu diwaspadai:**\n- Database Antigravity natively terintegrasi dengan Firebase/Firestore, bukan MySQL \u2014 sementara project Anda pakai MySQL + Laravel. Ini bukan dealbreaker tapi butuh konfigurasi manual ekstra\n- Untuk migration Laravel yang sudah kita rancang dengan sangat spesifik (FULLTEXT index, composite unique key, enum yang presisi), agent kadang membuat versi yang lebih \"generic\" yang harus Anda koreksi\n\n---\n\n## Rekomendasi: kapan masuk Antigravity?\n\nBerdasarkan kondisi project Anda, ini strategi terbaik:\n\n**Fase 1\u20136 (Database) \u2192 Kerjakan manual + panduan saya**\nDatabase adalah fondasi yang harus 100% presisi. Migration yang sudah kita rancang sangat spesifik \u2014 salah satu constraint saja bisa merusak integritas seluruh sistem. Lebih aman dikerjakan manual mengikuti kode yang sudah saya berikan, sambil saya pantau progressnya.\n\n**Setelah database selesai \u2192 Masukkan Antigravity**\nIni saat yang tepat menggunakan Antigravity untuk mempercepat pengerjaan:\n- Buat semua Model Laravel beserta relasinya\n- Generate Controller untuk setiap fitur\n- Buat halaman-halaman UI (HTML/CSS/JS)\n- Setup routing dan middleware autentikasi\n\nDengan kata lain \u2014 **biarkan saya bantu Anda bangun fondasi databasenya dengan benar, lalu gunakan Antigravity untuk mempercepat pembangunan aplikasinya.**\n\n---\n\nJadi untuk sekarang, fokus dulu Fase 1 database. Sudah siap mulai? \ud83d\ude80",
1611:    "text": " Tenang, ini error umum! Artinya Anda belum berada di dalam folder project Laravel-nya di terminal. Mari kita cek dulu.\n\nBuka terminal di VSCode (Ctrl + ` ) lalu jalankan:\n\n```bash\n# Cek posisi Anda sekarang\npwd\n```\n\nPaste hasilnya ke sini. Kemungkinan besar ada 2 kondisi:\n\n---\n\n**Kondisi A \u2014 Project Laravel belum dibuat sama sekali**\n\nKalau folder project belum ada, jalankan ini dari folder mana Anda ingin menyimpan project:\n\n```bash\n# Pindah ke lokasi yang Anda inginkan, contoh:\ncd C:\\xampp\\htdocs\n\n# Buat project Laravel baru\ncomposer create-project laravel/laravel e-recruitment\n\n# Masuk ke folder project\ncd e-recruitment\n\n# Cek berhasil\nphp artisan --version\n```\n\n---\n\n**Kondisi B \u2014 Project sudah ada tapi terminal belum masuk ke foldernya**\n\n```bash\n# Cari dulu di mana folder projectnya, lalu masuk\ncd path/ke/folder/e-recruitment\n\n# Contoh Windows:\ncd C:\\xampp\\htdocs\\e-recruitment\n\n# Contoh Mac/Linux:\ncd /var/www/html/e-recruitment\n\n# Cek berhasil\nphp artisan --version\n```\n\n---\n\nPaste hasil `pwd` dulu ya \u2014 nanti saya bantu arahkan ke langkah yang tepat! \ud83d\udcaa",
2003:    "text": " ## Jawaban Pertanyaan 1 \u2014 Soal Update MySQL\n\n**Tidak perlu diupdate sekarang.** Untuk kebutuhan project kuliah ini, versi MySQL di XAMPP Anda sudah lebih dari cukup. Semua fitur yang kita butuhkan \u2014 FULLTEXT index, JSON column, ENUM, Foreign Key, Composite Unique \u2014 semuanya didukung di versi MySQL yang ada.\n\nYang tidak bisa hanya perintah `php artisan db:show` saja, dan itu bukan bagian dari development maupun presentasi. Untuk laporan dan presentasi database, kita bisa pakai **phpMyAdmin** yang tampilannya jauh lebih bagus dan mudah dipahami penguji.\n\nSoal update \u2014 memang butuh waktu dan data lumayan karena harus download XAMPP versi baru. Tidak worth it untuk sekarang, simpan energi untuk ngerjain projectnya. \ud83d\ude04\n\n---\n\n## Jawaban Pertanyaan 2 \u2014 Cara Buat File Migration\n\nAda **2 cara**, pilih yang paling nyaman:\n\n**Cara A \u2014 Lewat terminal di VSCode (recommended)**\n\nPastikan sudah di dalam folder project dulu:\n```bash\ncd C:\\xampp\\htdocs\\e-recruitment\n```\n\nLalu jalankan satu per satu:\n```bash\nphp artisan make:migration create_users_table\nphp artisan make:migration create_user_profiles_table\nphp artisan make:migration create_password_reset_tokens_table\nphp artisan make:migration create_login_attempts_table\n```\n\nSetiap perintah akan otomatis membuat satu file baru di folder `database/migrations/` dengan nama seperti `2026_03_23_xxxxxx_create_users_table.php`.\n\n**Cara B \u2014 Lewat File Explorer VSCode**\n\nBuka folder `database/migrations/` di VSCode, klik kanan \u2192 New File \u2192 beri nama manual. Tapi cara ini **tidak disarankan** karena timestamp harus diisi manual dan rawan salah urutan.\n\n---\n\nSebelum jalankan perintahnya, **hapus dulu 3 file bawaan Laravel** di folder `database/migrations/`:\n\n```\n0001_01_01_000000_create_users_table.php\n0001_01_01_000001_create_cache_table.php\n0001_01_01_000002_create_jobs_table.php\n```\n\nCaranya di VSCode \u2014 klik file \u2192 tekan `Delete`. Kalau sudah terhapus baru jalankan 4 perintah `make:migration` di atas.\n\nHapus dulu filenya, lalu beritahu saya kalau sudah! \ud83d\udcaa",
2243:    "text": " Siap! Saya jelaskan per file, per baris, dengan penjelasan yang jelas dan sederhana.\n\n---\n\n## File 1 \u2014 `create_users_table.php`\n\n```php\nSchema::create('users', function (Blueprint $table) {\n```\nPerintah untuk **membuat tabel baru** bernama `users` di database.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->id();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`id`** \u2014 angka unik otomatis untuk setiap baris data. Ini selalu jadi kolom pertama di setiap tabel. Akan muncul di semua file migration.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->string('name', 100);\n```\nMembuat kolom **`name`** \u2014 teks maksimal 100 karakter. Wajib diisi, tidak boleh kosong.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->string('email', 150)->unique();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`email`** \u2014 teks maksimal 150 karakter. `->unique()` artinya tidak boleh ada 2 user dengan email yang sama.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->string('password_hash', 255);\n```\nMembuat kolom **`password_hash`** \u2014 teks maksimal 255 karakter. Khusus menyimpan password yang sudah dienkripsi dengan bcrypt. Tidak pernah menyimpan password asli.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->enum('role', ['hr', 'applicant'])->default('applicant');\n```\nMembuat kolom **`role`** \u2014 nilainya hanya boleh `hr` atau `applicant`. `->default('applicant')` artinya kalau tidak diisi, otomatis jadi `applicant`.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->string('phone', 20)->nullable();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`phone`** \u2014 teks maksimal 20 karakter. `->nullable()` artinya boleh dikosongkan, nomor HP tidak wajib diisi.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->boolean('is_active')->default(true);\n```\nMembuat kolom **`is_active`** \u2014 nilainya hanya `true` atau `false`. Default `true` artinya semua akun baru otomatis aktif. Digunakan untuk menonaktifkan akun tanpa menghapus datanya.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->timestamp('email_verified_at')->nullable();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`email_verified_at`** \u2014 menyimpan tanggal dan jam kapan email diverifikasi. `->nullable()` artinya boleh kosong \u2014 kalau NULL berarti email belum diverifikasi.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->rememberToken();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`remember_token`** \u2014 token khusus untuk fitur \"Ingat Saya\" saat login. Ini shortcut bawaan Laravel, tidak perlu diubah.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->timestamps();\n```\nShortcut yang otomatis membuat **2 kolom sekaligus**: `created_at` (kapan data dibuat) dan `updated_at` (kapan data terakhir diubah). Laravel mengisi kedua kolom ini otomatis. Akan muncul di hampir semua file migration.\n\n---\n---\n\n## File 2 \u2014 `create_user_profiles_table.php`\n\n```php\nSchema::create('user_profiles', function (Blueprint $table) {\n```\nMembuat tabel baru bernama `user_profiles`.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->id();\n```\nSama seperti File 1 \u2014 kolom id unik otomatis. **Selalu ada di setiap tabel.**\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->foreignId('user_id')\n      ->unique()\n      ->constrained('users')\n      ->onDelete('cascade');\n```\nIni **Foreign Key** \u2014 kolom yang menghubungkan tabel ini ke tabel `users`. Dibaca per baris:\n\n- `foreignId('user_id')` \u2014 buat kolom bernama `user_id`\n- `->unique()` \u2014 satu user hanya boleh punya satu profil (relasi 1-to-1)\n- `->constrained('users')` \u2014 kolom ini mereferensikan tabel `users`\n- `->onDelete('cascade')` \u2014 kalau user dihapus, profil ikut terhapus otomatis\n\n**Baru muncul di file ini** \u2014 belum ada di File 1.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->text('bio')->nullable();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`bio`** \u2014 teks panjang untuk deskripsi diri. `->nullable()` karena bio tidak wajib diisi.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->string('address', 255)->nullable();\n$table->string('city', 100)->nullable();\n$table->string('province', 100)->nullable();\n```\nTiga kolom alamat \u2014 semuanya `->nullable()` karena tidak wajib diisi saat pertama daftar. Sudah muncul sintaks `->nullable()` di File 1, tapi di sini dipakai lebih banyak.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->date('birth_date')->nullable();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`birth_date`** \u2014 menyimpan tanggal lahir dalam format `YYYY-MM-DD`. **Baru muncul di file ini** \u2014 tipe `date` belum ada di File 1.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->enum('gender', ['male', 'female'])->nullable();\n```\nMembuat kolom **`gender`** \u2014 nilainya hanya `male` atau `female`. Sintaks `enum` sudah muncul di File 1, tapi di sini ditambah `->nullable()` karena gender tidak wajib diisi.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->string('avatar_url', 500)->nullable();\n$table->string('linkedin_url', 500)->nullable();\n$table->string('portfolio_url', 500)->nullable();\n```\nTiga kolom URL \u2014 pakai panjang 500 karena URL bisa sangat panjang. Semuanya `->nullable()` karena tidak wajib diisi.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->timestamp('updated_at')->nullable();\n```\nKolom **`updated_at`** saja tanpa `created_at` \u2014 karena profil tidak perlu dicatat kapan dibuat, yang penting kapan terakhir diupdate. **Perhatikan** \u2014 di File 1 kita pakai `$table->timestamps()` yang buat 2 kolom sekaligus, tapi di sini kita buat manual 1 kolom saja.\n\n---\n---\n\n## File 3 \u2014 `create_password_reset_tokens_table.php`\n\n```php\nSchema::create('password_reset_tokens', function (Blueprint $table) {\n```\nMembuat tabel baru bernama `password_reset_tokens`.\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->id();\n```\nSama seperti file sebelumnya. **Selalu ada di setiap tabel.**\n\n---\n\n```php\n$table->foreignId('user_id')\n      ->constrained('users')\n      ->onDelete('cascade');\n```\nForeign Key ke tabel `users` \u2014 sama seperti File 2, tapi **tanpa** `->unique()`. content.text: {"returncode":0,"stdout":"186:        \"text\": \"# Imagine \\u2014 Visual Creation Suite\\n\\n## Modules\\nCall read_me again with the modules parameter to load detailed guidance:\\n- `diagram` \\u2014 SVG flowcharts, structural diagrams, illustrative diagrams\\n- `mockup` \\u2014 UI mockups, forms, cards, dashboards\\n- `interactive` \\u2014 interactive explainers with controls\\n- `chart` \\u2014 charts and data analysis (includes Chart.js)\\n- `art` \\u2014 illustration and generative art\\nPick the closest fit. The module includes all relevant design guidance.\\n\\n**Complexity budget \\u2014 hard limits:**\\n- Box subtitles: \\u22645 words. Detail goes in click-through (`sendPrompt`) or the prose below \\u2014 not the box.\\n- Colors: \\u22642 ramps per diagram. If colors encode meaning (states, tiers), add a 1-line legend. Otherwise use one neutral ramp.\\n- Horizontal tier: \\u22644 boxes at full width (~140px each). 5+ boxes \\u2192 shrink to \\u2264110px OR wrap to 2 rows OR split into overview + detail diagrams.\\n\\nIf you catch yourself writing \\\"click to learn more\\\" in prose, the diagram itself must ACTUALLY be sparse. Don't promise brevity then front-load everything.\\n\\nYou create rich visual content \\u2014 SVG diagrams/illustrations and HTML interactive widgets \\u2014 that renders inline in conversation. The best output feels like a natural extension of the chat.\\n\\n## Core Design System\\n\\nThese rules apply to ALL use cases.\\n\\n### Philosophy\\n- **Seamless**: Users shouldn't notice where claude.ai ends and your widget begins.\\n- **Flat**: No gradients, mesh backgrounds, noise textures, or decorative effects. Clean flat surfaces.\\n- **Compact**: Show the essential inline. Explain the rest in text.\\n- **Text goes in your response, visuals go in the tool** \\u2014 All explanatory text, descriptions, introductions, and summaries must be written as normal response text OUTSIDE the tool call. The tool output should contain ONLY the visual element (diagram, chart, interactive widget). Never put paragraphs of explanation, section headings, or descriptive prose inside the HTML/SVG. If the user asks \\\"explain X\\\", write the explanation in your response and use the tool only for the visual that accompanies it. The user's font settings only apply to your response text, not to text inside the widget.\\n\\n### Streaming\\nOutput streams token-by-token. Structure code so useful content appears early.\\n- **HTML**: `<style>` (short) \\u2192 content HTML \\u2192 `<script>` last.\\n- **SVG**: `<defs>` (markers) \\u2192 visual elements immediately.\\n- Prefer inline `style=\\\"...\\\"` over `<style>` blocks \\u2014 inputs/controls must look correct mid-stream.\\n- Keep `<style>` under ~15 lines. Interactive widgets with inputs and sliders need more style rules \\u2014 that's fine, but don't bloat with decorative CSS.\\n- Gradients, shadows, and blur flash during streaming DOM diffs. Use solid flat fills instead.\\n\\n### Rules\\n- No `<!-- comments -->` or `/* comments */` (waste tokens, break streaming)\\n- No font-size below 11px\\n- No emoji \\u2014 use CSS shapes or SVG paths\\n- No gradients, drop shadows, blur, glow, or neon effects\\n- No dark/colored backgrounds on outer containers (transparent only \\u2014 host provides the bg)\\n- **Typography**: The default font is Anthropic Sans. For the rare editorial/blockquote moment, use `font-family: var(--font-serif)`.\\n- **Headings**: h1 = 22px, h2 = 18px, h3 = 16px \\u2014 all `font-weight: 500`. Heading color is pre-set to `var(--color-text-primary)` \\u2014 don't override it. Body text = 16px, weight 400, `line-height: 1.7`. **Two weights only: 400 regular, 500 bold.** Never use 600 or 700 \\u2014 they look heavy against the host UI.\\n- **Sentence case** always. Never Title Case, never ALL CAPS. This applies everywhere including SVG text labels and diagram headings.\\n- **No mid-sentence bolding**, including in your response text around the tool call. Entity names, class names, function names go in `code style` not **bold**. Bold is for headings and labels only.\\n- The widget container is `display: block; width: 100%`. Your HTML fills it naturally \\u2014 no wrapper div needed. Just start with your content directly. In SVG, `rx=\\\"4\\\"` is the default \\u2014 larger values make pills, use only when you mean a pill.\\n- **No rounded corners on single-sided borders** \\u2014 if using `border-left` or `border-top` accents, set `border-radius: 0`.
