     5	---
     6	
     7	# PDF Processing Guide
     8	
     9	## Overview
    10	
    11	This guide covers essential PDF processing operations using Python libraries and command-line tools. For advanced features, JavaScript libraries, and detailed examples, see REFERENCE.md. If you need to fill out a PDF form, read FORMS.md and follow its instructions.
    12	
    13	## Quick Start
    14	
    15	```python
    16	from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
    17	
    18	# Read a PDF
    19	reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
    20	print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
    21	
    22	# Extract text
    23	text = ""
    24	for page in reader.pages:
    25	    text += page.extract_text()
    26	```
    27	
    28	## Python Libraries
    29	
    30	### pypdf - Basic Operations
    31	
    32	#### Merge PDFs
    33	```python
    34	from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader
    35	
    36	writer = PdfWriter()
    37	for pdf_file in ["doc1.pdf", "doc2.pdf", "doc3.pdf"]:
    38	    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    39	    for page in reader.pages:
    40	        writer.add_page(page)
    41	
    42	with open("merged.pdf", "wb") as output:
    43	    writer.write(output)
    44	```
    45	
    46	#### Split PDF
    47	```python
    48	reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
    49	for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
    50	    writer = PdfWriter()
    51	    writer.add_page(page)
    52	    with open(f"page_{i+1}.pdf", "wb") as output:
    53	        writer.write(output)
    54	```
    55	
    56	#### Extract Metadata
    57	```python
    58	reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
    59	meta = reader.metadata
    60	print(f"Title: {meta.title}")
    61	print(f"Author: {meta.author}")
    62	print(f"Subject: {meta.subject}")
    63	print(f"Creator: {meta.creator}")
    64	```
    65	
    66	#### Rotate Pages
    67	```python
    68	reader = PdfReader("input.pdf")
    69	writer = PdfWriter()
    70	
    71	page = reader.pages[0]
    72	page.rotate(90)  # Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
    73	writer.add_page(page)
    74	
    75	with open("rotated.pdf", "wb") as output:
    76	    writer.write(output)
    77	```
    78	
    79	### pdfplumber - Text and Table Extraction
    80	
    81	#### Extract Text with Layout
    82	```python
    83	import pdfplumber
    84	
    85	with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    86	    for page in pdf.pages:
    87	        text = page.extract_text()
    88	        print(text)
    89	```
    90	
    91	#### Extract Tables
    92	```python
    93	with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
    94	    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
    95	        tables = page.extract_tables()
    96	        for j, table in enumerate(tables):
    97	            print(f"Table {j+1} on page {i+1}:")
    98	            for row in table:
    99	                print(row)
   100	```
   101	
   102	#### Advanced Table Extraction
   103	```python
   104	import pandas as pd
   105	
   106	with pdfplumber.open("document.pdf") as pdf:
   107	    all_tables = []
   108	    for page in pdf.pages:
   109	        tables = page.extract_tables()
   110	        for table in tables:
   111	            if table:  # Check if table is not empty
   112	                df = pd.DataFrame(table[1:], columns=table[0])
   113	                all_tables.append(df)
   114	
   115	# Combine all tables
   116	if all_tables:
   117	    combined_df = pd.concat(all_tables, ignore_index=True)
   118	    combined_df.to_excel("extracted_tables.xlsx", index=False)
   119	```
   120	
   121	### reportlab - Create PDFs
   122	
   123	#### Basic PDF Creation
   124	```python
   125	from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
   126	from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
   127	
   128	c = canvas.Canvas("hello.pdf", pagesize=letter)
   129	width, height = letter
   130	
   131	# Add text
   132	c.drawString(100, height - 100, "Hello World!")
   133	c.drawString(100, height - 120, "This is a PDF created with reportlab")
   134	
   135	# Add a line
   136	c.line(100, height - 140, 400, height - 140)
   137	
   138	# Save
   139	c.save()
   140	```
   141	
   142	#### Create PDF with Multiple Pages
   143	```python
   144	from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
   145	from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, PageBreak
   146	from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
   147	
   148	doc = SimpleDocTemplate("report.pdf", pagesize=letter)
   149	styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
   150	story = []
   151	
   152	# Add content
   153	title = Paragraph("Report Title", styles['Title'])
   154	story.append(title)
   155	story.append(Spacer(1, 12))
   156	
   157	body = Paragraph("This is the body of the report. " * 20, styles['Normal'])
   158	story.append(body)
   159	story.append(PageBreak())
   160	
   161	# Page 2
   162	story.append(Paragraph("Page 2", styles['Heading1']))
   163	story.append(Paragraph("Content for page 2", styles['Normal']))
   164	
   165	# Build PDF
   166	doc.build(story)
   167	```
   168	
   169	#### Subscripts and Superscripts
   170	
   171	**IMPORTANT**: Never use Unicode subscript/superscript characters (₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉, ⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) in ReportLab PDFs. The built-in fonts do not include these glyphs, causing them to render as solid black boxes.
   172	
   173	Instead, use ReportLab's XML markup tags in Paragraph objects:
   174	```python
   175	from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
   176	from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet
   177	
   178	styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
   179	
   180	# Subscripts: use <sub> tag
   181	chemical = Paragraph("H<sub>2</sub>O", styles['Normal'])
   182	
   183	# Superscripts: use <super> tag
   184	squared = Paragraph("x<super>2</super> + y<super>2</super>", styles['Normal'])
   185	```
   186	
   187	For canvas-drawn text (not Paragraph objects), manually adjust font the size and position rather than using Unicode subscripts/superscripts.
   188	
   189	## Command-Line Tools
   190	
   191	### pdftotext (poppler-utils)
   192	```bash
   193	# Extract text
   194	pdftotext input.pdf output.txt
   195	
   196	# Extract text preserving layout
   197	pdftotext -layout input.pdf output.txt
   198	
   199	# Extract specific pages
   200	pdftotext -f 1 -l 5 input.pdf output.txt  # Pages 1-5
   201	```
   202	
   203	### qpdf
   204	```bash
   205	# Merge PDFs
   206	qpdf --empty --pages file1.pdf file2.pdf -- merged.pdf
   207	
   208	# Split pages
   209	qpdf input.pdf --pages . 1-5 -- pages1-5.pdf
   210	qpdf input.pdf --pages . 6-10 -- pages6-10.pdf
   211	
   212	# Rotate pages
   213	qpdf input.pdf output.pdf --rotate=+90:1  # Rotate page 1 by 90 degrees
   214	
   215	# Remove password
   216	qpdf --password=mypassword --decrypt encrypted.pdf decrypted.pdf
   217	```
   218	
   219	### pdftk (if available)
   220	```bash
   221	# Merge
   222	pdftk file1.pdf file2.pdf cat output merged.pdf
   223	
   224	# Split
   225	pdftk input.pdf burst
   226	
   227	# Rotate
   228	pdftk input.pdf rotate 1east output rotated.pdf
   229	```
   230	
   231	## Common Tasks
   232	
   233	### Extract Text from Scanned PDFs
   234	```python
   235	# Requires: pip install pytesseract pdf2image
   236	import pytesseract
   237	from pdf2image import convert_from_path
   238	
   239	# Convert PDF to images
   240	images = convert_from_path('scanned.pdf')
   241	
   242	# OCR each page
   243	text = ""
   244	for i, image in enumerate(images):
   245	    text += f"Page {i+1}:\n"
   246	    text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
   247	    text += "\n\n"
   248	
   249	print(text)
   250	```
   251	
   252	### Add Watermark
   253	```python
   254	from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
   255	
   256	# Create watermark (or load existing)
   257	watermark = PdfReader("watermark.pdf").pages[0]
   258	
   259	# Apply to all pages
   260	reader = PdfReader("document.pdf")
   261	writer = PdfWriter()
   262	
   263	for page in reader.pages:
   264	    page.merge_page(watermark)
   265	    writer.add_page(page)
   266	
   267	with open("watermarked.pdf", "wb") as output:
   268	    writer.write(output)
   269	```
   270	
   271	### Extract Images
   272	```bash
   273	# Using pdfimages (poppler-utils)
   274	pdfimages -j input.pdf output_prefix
   275	
   276	# This extracts all images as output_prefix-000.jpg, output_prefix-001.jpg, etc.
   277	```
   278	
   279	### Password Protection
   280	```python

     3	description: "Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation."
     4	license: Proprietary. LICENSE.txt has complete terms
     5	---
     6	
     7	# DOCX creation, editing, and analysis
     8	
     9	## Overview
    10	
    11	A .docx file is a ZIP archive containing XML files.
    12	
    13	## Quick Reference
    14	
    15	| Task | Approach |
    16	|------|----------|
    17	| Read/analyze content | `pandoc` or unpack for raw XML |
    18	| Create new document | Use `docx-js` - see Creating New Documents below |
    19	| Edit existing document | Unpack → edit XML → repack - see Editing Existing Documents below |
    20	
    21	### Converting .doc to .docx
    22	
    23	Legacy `.doc` files must be converted before editing:
    24	
    25	```bash
    26	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to docx document.doc
    27	```
    28	
    29	### Reading Content
    30	
    31	```bash
    32	# Text extraction with tracked changes
    33	pandoc --track-changes=all document.docx -o output.md
    34	
    35	# Raw XML access
    36	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
    37	```
    38	
    39	### Converting to Images
    40	
    41	```bash
    42	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to pdf document.docx
    43	pdftoppm -jpeg -r 150 document.pdf page
    44	```
    45	
    46	### Accepting Tracked Changes
    47	
    48	To produce a clean document with all tracked changes accepted (requires LibreOffice):
    49	
    50	```bash
    51	python scripts/accept_changes.py input.docx output.docx
    52	```
    53	
    54	---
    55	
    56	## Creating New Documents
    57	
    58	Generate .docx files with JavaScript, then validate. Install: `npm install -g docx`
    59	
    60	### Setup
    61	```javascript
    62	const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, ImageRun,
    63	        Header, Footer, AlignmentType, PageOrientation, LevelFormat, ExternalHyperlink,
    64	        InternalHyperlink, Bookmark, FootnoteReferenceRun, PositionalTab,
    65	        PositionalTabAlignment, PositionalTabRelativeTo, PositionalTabLeader,
    66	        TabStopType, TabStopPosition, Column, SectionType,
    67	        TableOfContents, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
    68	        VerticalAlign, PageNumber, PageBreak } = require('docx');
    69	
    70	const doc = new Document({ sections: [{ children: [/* content */] }] });
    71	Packer.toBuffer(doc).then(buffer => fs.writeFileSync("doc.docx", buffer));
    72	```
    73	
    74	### Validation
    75	After creating the file, validate it. If validation fails, unpack, fix the XML, and repack.
    76	```bash
    77	python scripts/office/validate.py doc.docx
    78	```
    79	
    80	### Page Size
    81	
    82	```javascript
    83	// CRITICAL: docx-js defaults to A4, not US Letter
    84	// Always set page size explicitly for consistent results
    85	sections: [{
    86	  properties: {
    87	    page: {
    88	      size: {
    89	        width: 12240,   // 8.5 inches in DXA
    90	        height: 15840   // 11 inches in DXA
    91	      },
    92	      margin: { top: 1440, right: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1440 } // 1 inch margins
    93	    }
    94	  },
    95	  children: [/* content */]
    96	}]
    97	```
    98	
    99	**Common page sizes (DXA units, 1440 DXA = 1 inch):**
   100	
   101	| Paper | Width | Height | Content Width (1" margins) |
   102	|-------|-------|--------|---------------------------|
   103	| US Letter | 12,240 | 15,840 | 9,360 |
   104	| A4 (default) | 11,906 | 16,838 | 9,026 |
   105	
   106	**Landscape orientation:** docx-js swaps width/height internally, so pass portrait dimensions and let it handle the swap:
   107	```javascript
   108	size: {
   109	  width: 12240,   // Pass SHORT edge as width
   110	  height: 15840,  // Pass LONG edge as height
   111	  orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE  // docx-js swaps them in the XML
   112	},
   113	// Content width = 15840 - left margin - right margin (uses the long edge)
   114	```
   115	
   116	### Styles (Override Built-in Headings)
   117	
   118	Use Arial as the default font (universally supported). Keep titles black for readability.
   119	
   120	```javascript
   121	const doc = new Document({
   122	  styles: {
   123	    default: { document: { run: { font: "Arial", size: 24 } } }, // 12pt default
   124	    paragraphStyles: [
   125	      // IMPORTANT: Use exact IDs to override built-in styles
   126	      { id: "Heading1", name: "Heading 1", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   127	        run: { size: 32, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   128	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 240, after: 240 }, outlineLevel: 0 } }, // outlineLevel required for TOC
   129	      { id: "Heading2", name: "Heading 2", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   130	        run: { size: 28, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   131	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 180, after: 180 }, outlineLevel: 1 } },
   132	    ]
   133	  },
   134	  sections: [{
   135	    children: [
   136	      new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, children: [new TextRun("Title")] }),
   137	    ]
   138	  }]
   139	});
   140	```
   141	
   142	### Lists (NEVER use unicode bullets)
   143	
   144	```javascript
   145	// ❌ WRONG - never manually insert bullet characters
   146	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("• Item")] })  // BAD
   147	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("\u2022 Item")] })  // BAD
   148	
   149	// ✅ CORRECT - use numbering config with LevelFormat.BULLET
   150	const doc = new Document({
   151	  numbering: {
   152	    config: [
   153	      { reference: "bullets",
   154	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.BULLET, text: "•", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   155	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   156	      { reference: "numbers",
   157	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.DECIMAL, text: "%1.", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   158	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   159	    ]
   160	  },
   161	  sections: [{
   162	    children: [
   163	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "bullets", level: 0 },
   164	        children: [new TextRun("Bullet item")] }),
   165	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "numbers", level: 0 },
   166	        children: [new TextRun("Numbered item")] }),
   167	    ]
   168	  }]
   169	});
   170	
   171	// ⚠️ Each reference creates INDEPENDENT numbering
   172	// Same reference = continues (1,2,3 then 4,5,6)
   173	// Different reference = restarts (1,2,3 then 1,2,3)
   174	```
   175	
   176	### Tables
   177	
   178	**CRITICAL: Tables need dual widths** - set both `columnWidths` on the table AND `width` on each cell. Without both, tables render incorrectly on some platforms.
   179	
   180	```javascript
   181	// CRITICAL: Always set table width for consistent rendering
   182	// CRITICAL: Use ShadingType.CLEAR (not SOLID) to prevent black backgrounds
   183	const border = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "CCCCCC" };
   184	const borders = { top: border, bottom: border, left: border, right: border };
   185	
   186	new Table({
   187	  width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Always use DXA (percentages break in Google Docs)
   188	  columnWidths: [4680, 4680], // Must sum to table width (DXA: 1440 = 1 inch)
   189	  rows: [
   190	    new TableRow({
   191	      children: [
   192	        new TableCell({
   193	          borders,
   194	          width: { size: 4680, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Also set on each cell
   195	          shading: { fill: "D5E8F0", type: ShadingType.CLEAR }, // CLEAR not SOLID
   196	          margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }, // Cell padding (internal, not added to width)
   197	          children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("Cell")] })]
   198	        })
   199	      ]
   200	    })
   201	  ]
   202	})
   203	```
   204	
   205	**Table width calculation:**
   206	
   207	Always use `WidthType.DXA` — `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` breaks in Google Docs.
   208	
   209	```javascript
   210	// Table width = sum of columnWidths = content width
   211	// US Letter with 1" margins: 12240 - 2880 = 9360 DXA
   212	width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA },
   213	columnWidths: [7000, 2360]  // Must sum to table width
   214	```
   215	
   216	**Width rules:**
	< truncated lines 217-374 >
   375	}]
   376	```
   377	
   378	### Critical Rules for docx-js
   379	
   380	- **Set page size explicitly** - docx-js defaults to A4; use US Letter (12240 x 15840 DXA) for US documents
   381	- **Landscape: pass portrait dimensions** - docx-js swaps width/height internally; pass short edge as `width`, long edge as `height`, and set `orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE`
   382	- **Never use `\n`** - use separate Paragraph elements
   383	- **Never use unicode bullets** - use `LevelFormat.BULLET` with numbering config
   384	- **PageBreak must be in Paragraph** - standalone creates invalid XML
   385	- **ImageRun requires `type`** - always specify png/jpg/etc
   386	- **Always set table `width` with DXA** - never use `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` (breaks in Google Docs)
   387	- **Tables need dual widths** - `columnWidths` array AND cell `width`, both must match
   388	- **Table width = sum of columnWidths** - for DXA, ensure they add up exactly
   389	- **Always add cell margins** - use `margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }` for readable padding
   390	- **Use `ShadingType.CLEAR`** - never SOLID for table shading
   391	- **Never use tables as dividers/rules** - cells have minimum height and render as empty boxes (including in headers/footers); use `border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "2E75B6", space: 1 } }` on a Paragraph instead. For two-column footers, use tab stops (see Tab Stops section), not tables
   392	- **TOC requires HeadingLevel only** - no custom styles on heading paragraphs
   393	- **Override built-in styles** - use exact IDs: "Heading1", "Heading2", etc.
   394	- **Include `outlineLevel`** - required for TOC (0 for H1, 1 for H2, etc.)
   395	
   396	---
   397	
   398	## Editing Existing Documents
   399	
   400	**Follow all 3 steps in order.**
   401	
   402	### Step 1: Unpack
   403	```bash
   404	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
   405	```
   406	Extracts XML, pretty-prints, merges adjacent runs, and converts smart quotes to XML entities (`“` etc.) so they survive editing. Use `--merge-runs false` to skip run merging.
   407	
   408	### Step 2: Edit XML
   409	
   410	Edit files in `unpacked/word/`. See XML Reference below for patterns.
   411	
   412	**Use "Claude" as the author** for tracked changes and comments, unless the user explicitly requests use of a different name.
   413	
   414	**Use the Edit tool directly for string replacement. Do not write Python scripts.** Scripts introduce unnecessary complexity. The Edit tool shows exactly what is being replaced.
   415	
   416	**CRITICAL: Use smart quotes for new content.** When adding text with apostrophes or quotes, use XML entities to produce smart quotes:
   417	```xml
   418	<!-- Use these entities for professional typography -->
   419	<w:t>Here’s a quote: “Hello”</w:t>
   420	```
   421	| Entity | Character |
   422	|--------|-----------|
   423	| `‘` | ‘ (left single) |
   424	| `’` | ’ (right single / apostrophe) |
   425	| `“` | “ (left double) |
   426	| `”` | ” (right double) |
   427	
   428	**Adding comments:** Use `comment.py` to handle boilerplate across multiple XML files (text must be pre-escaped XML):
   429	```bash
   430	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Comment text with & and ’"
   431	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 1 "Reply text" --parent 0  # reply to comment 0
   432	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Text" --author "Custom Author"  # custom author name
   433	```
   434	Then add markers to document.xml (see Comments in XML Reference).
   435	
   436	### Step 3: Pack
   437	```bash
   438	python scripts/office/pack.py unpacked/ output.docx --original document.docx
   439	```
   440	Validates with auto-repair, condenses XML, and creates DOCX. Use `--validate false` to skip.
   441	
   442	**Auto-repair will fix:**
   443	- `durableId` >= 0x7FFFFFFF (regenerates valid ID)
   444	- Missing `xml:space="preserve"` on `<w:t>` with whitespace
   445	
   446	**Auto-repair won't fix:**
   447	- Malformed XML, invalid element nesting, missing relationships, schema violations
   448	
   449	### Common Pitfalls
   450	
   451	- **Replace entire `<w:r>` elements**: When adding tracked changes, replace the whole `<w:r>...</w:r>` block with `<w:del>...<w:ins>...` as siblings. Don't inject tracked change tags inside a run.
   452	- **Preserve `<w:rPr>` formatting**: Copy the original run's `<w:rPr>` block into your tracked change runs to maintain bold, font size, etc.
   453	
   454	---
   455	
   456	## XML Reference
   457	
   458	### Schema Compliance
   459	
   460	- **Element order in `<w:pPr>`**: `<w:pStyle>`, `<w:numPr>`, `<w:spacing>`, `<w:ind>`, `<w:jc>`, `<w:rPr>` last
   461	- **Whitespace**: Add `xml:space="preserve"` to `<w:t>` with leading/trailing spaces
   462	- **RSIDs**: Must be 8-digit hex (e.g., `00AB1234`)
   463	
   464	### Tracked Changes
   465	
   466	**Insertion:**
   467	```xml
   468	<w:ins w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   469	  <w:r><w:t>inserted text</w:t></w:r>
   470	</w:ins>
   471	```
   472	
   473	**Deletion:**
   474	```xml
   475	<w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   476	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   477	</w:del>
   478	```
   479	
   480	**Inside `<w:del>`**: Use `<w:delText>` instead of `<w:t>`, and `<w:delInstrText>` instead of `<w:instrText>`.
   481	
   482	**Minimal edits** - only mark what changes:
   483	```xml
   484	<!-- Change "30 days" to "60 days" -->
   485	<w:r><w:t>The term is </w:t></w:r>
   486	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   487	  <w:r><w:delText>30</w:delText></w:r>
   488	</w:del>
   489	<w:ins w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   490	  <w:r><w:t>60</w:t></w:r>
   491	</w:ins>
   492	<w:r><w:t> days.</w:t></w:r>
   493	```
   494	
   495	**Deleting entire paragraphs/list items** - when removing ALL content from a paragraph, also mark the paragraph mark as deleted so it merges with the next paragraph. Add `<w:del/>` inside `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`:
   496	```xml
   497	<w:p>
   498	  <w:pPr>
   499	    <w:numPr>...</w:numPr>  <!-- list numbering if present -->
   500	    <w:rPr>
   501	      <w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"/>
   502	    </w:rPr>
   503	  </w:pPr>
   504	  <w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   505	    <w:r><w:delText>Entire paragraph content being deleted...</w:delText></w:r>
   506	  </w:del>
   507	</w:p>
   508	```
   509	Without the `<w:del/>` in `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`, accepting changes leaves an empty paragraph/list item.
   510	
   511	**Rejecting another author's insertion** - nest deletion inside their insertion:
   512	```xml
   513	<w:ins w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   514	  <w:del w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   515	    <w:r><w:delText>their inserted text</w:delText></w:r>
   516	  </w:del>
   517	</w:ins>
   518	```
   519	
   520	**Restoring another author's deletion** - add insertion after (don't modify their deletion):
   521	```xml
   522	<w:del w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   523	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   524	</w:del>
   525	<w:ins w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   526	  <w:r><w:t>deleted text</w:t></w:r>
   527	</w:ins>
   528	```
   529	
   530	### Comments
   531	
   532	After running `comment.py` (see Step 2), add markers to document.xml. For replies, use `--parent` flag and nest markers inside the parent's.
   533	
   534	**CRITICAL: `<w:commentRangeStart>` and `<w:commentRangeEnd>` are siblings of `<w:r>`, never inside `<w:r>`.**
   535	
   536	```xml
   537	<!-- Comment markers are direct children of w:p, never inside w:r -->
   538	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   539	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   540	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted</w:delText></w:r>
   541	</w:del>
   542	<w:r><w:t> more text</w:t></w:r>
   543	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   544	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   545	
   546	<!-- Comment 0 with reply 1 nested inside -->
   547	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   548	  <w:commentRangeStart w:id="1"/>
   549	  <w:r><w:t>text</w:t></w:r>
   550	  <w:commentRangeEnd w:id="1"/>
   551	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   552	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   553	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="1"/></w:r>
   554	```
   555	
   556	### Images
   557	
   558	1. Add image file to `word/media/`
   559	2. Add relationship to `word/_rels/document.xml.rels`:
   560	```xml
   561	<Relationship Id="rId5" Type=".../image" Target="media/image1.png"/>
   562	```
   563	3. Add content type to `[Content_Types].xml`:
   564	```xml
   565	<Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/>
   566	```
   567	4. Reference in document.xml:
   568	```xml
   569	<w:drawing>
   570	  <wp:inline>
   571	    <wp:extent cx="914400" cy="914400"/>  <!-- EMUs: 914400 = 1 inch -->
   572	    <a:graphic>
   573	      <a:graphicData uri=".../picture">
   574	        <pic:pic>
   575	          <pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId5"/></pic:blipFill>
   576	        </pic:pic>
   577	      </a:graphicData>
   578	    </a:graphic>
   579	  </wp:inline>
   580	</w:drawing>
   581	```
   582	
   583	---
   584

Perancangan basis data yang baik merupakan fondasi utama dalam

Dokumen ini memaparkan proses normalisasi yang diterapkan dalam
perancangan basis data Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals.

1.2 Tujuan Normalisasi

Normalisasi basis data pada proyek ini bertujuan untuk:

-   Menghilangkan redundansi data agar tidak ada informasi yang

-   Mencegah anomali insert, update, dan delete yang dapat merusak

-   Memastikan setiap atribut hanya bergantung pada primary key yang

-   Mendukung skalabilitas sistem di masa mendatang

e-recruitment, mencakup data pengguna, lowongan pekerjaan, lamaran,

menghasilkan 18 tabel final yang dibagi ke dalam 6 grup fungsional.

import zipfile, shutil, os

with open('norm_unpacked/word/document.xml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

# --- Build the new UNF flat table ---
# Colors
BLUE = "1F4E79"
BLUE_MID = "2E75B6"
BLUE_LIGHT = "D6E4F0"
GRAY = "F5F5F5"
ORANGE = "B45309"
ORANGE_LIGHT = "FDEBD0"
RED = "B91C1C"
RED_LIGHT = "FADBD8"
GREEN = "1D6A4E"
GREEN_LIGHT = "D6EAE0"
BORDER = "CCCCCC"

def border_xml(color=BORDER):
    b = f'<w:top w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="{color}"/><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="{color}"/><w:bottom w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="{color}"/><w:right w:val="single" w:sz="4" w:color="{color}"/>'
    return f'<w:tcBorders>{b}</w:tcBorders>'

def cell(text, width, bold=False, bg="FFFFFF", font_size=18, color="333333", italic=False, font="Arial", center=False, colspan=None):
    span = f'<w:gridSpan w:val="{colspan}"/>' if colspan else ''
    shading = f'<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="{bg}"/>'
    align = '<w:jc w:val="center"/>' if center else ''
    fmt = ''
    if bold: fmt += '<w:b/>'
    if italic: fmt += '<w:i/>'
    return (
        f'<w:tc><w:tcPr>{span}<w:tcW w:w="{width}" w:type="dxa"/>'
        f'{border_xml()}{shading}'
        f'<w:tcMar><w:top w:w="50" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="50" w:type="dxa"/>'
        f'<w:left w:w="100" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="100" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar>'
        f'</w:tcPr>'
        f'<w:p><w:pPr>{align}</w:pPr>'
        f'<w:r><w:rPr>{fmt}<w:color w:val="{color}"/><w:sz w:val="{font_size}"/><w:szCs w:val="{font_size}"/><w:rFonts w:ascii="{font}" w:hAnsi="{font}"/></w:rPr>'
        f'<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:tc>'
    )

def header_cell(text, width, bg=BLUE, color="FFFFFF"):
    return cell(text, width, bold=True, bg=bg, color=color, center=True)

def row(cells_xml, is_header=False):
    hdr = '<w:trPr><w:tblHeader/></w:trPr>' if is_header else '<w:trPr/>'
    return f'<w:tr>{hdr}{cells_xml}</w:tr>'

# Table width = 9360 DXA total
# Columns: No (400), Nama Kolom (2200), Tipe Data (1800), Nilai Contoh (4960)
W_NO   = 400
W_COL  = 2500
W_TYPE = 1800
W_EX   = 4660

def make_row(no, kolom, tipe, contoh, bg="FFFFFF"):
    return row(
        cell(no,     W_NO,   center=True, bg=bg, color="555555") +

        f'<w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="{width}" w:type="dxa"/>'

The user is asking about whether UNF can already have some tables (less than 10), not just one flat table. This is a valid question about normalization theory.

In normalization theory:
- UNF doesn't mean "one single table" — it means data that hasn't been normalized yet, which can include multiple tables that still have repeating groups, multi-value attributes, etc.
- So yes, you CAN have multiple tables in UNF as long as they still violate normalization rules (have repeating groups, etc.)

This is actually more realistic for a real system where you might start with some basic tables but they're still messy.Pertanyaan yang sangat bagus — dan jawabannya adalah **boleh!** 😊

UNF itu bukan berarti harus satu tabel. UNF artinya **data yang belum memenuhi aturan normalisasi apapun** — bisa satu tabel, bisa beberapa tabel, selama di dalamnya masih ada pelanggaran seperti repeating groups, multi-value, atau data redundan.

---

**Jadi alur yang paling realistis dan tetap valid secara akademis:**

```
UNF      →  ~6 tabel kasar (ada repeating groups, data campur)
  ↓
1NF      →  13 tabel (repeating groups dipecah)
  ↓
2NF      →  13 tabel (tidak ada perubahan struktural, klarifikasi saja)
  ↓
3NF      →  18 tabel final (transitive dependency dipisah)
```

---

**Contoh 6 tabel di UNF yang masih "kotor":**

| Tabel UNF | Masalah yang masih ada |
|---|---|

| `data_notifikasi_dan_log` | notifikasi, log pencarian, log login masih digabung |

Tabel-tabel ini sudah "ada tapi masih berantakan" — itulah UNF. Baru setelah 1NF semua dipecah lebih rapi.

Key things that would make it look more realistic:

1. **UNF tables should have actual sample data rows** - not just column lists. Real normalization starts with looking at actual data rows, not just column names.

2. **Show the "before and after" for each normal form** - don't just say "we split this table", show the actual columns that moved.

3. **Show violations explicitly** - highlight which specific cells/values violate the rules before fixing them.


4. **The progression should feel like discovering problems and solving them** - presenting functional dependencies explicitly with proper notation, then walking through why 2NF doesn't require changes with all single-column primary keys, and identifying specific transitive dependencies in the 3NF analysis.
5. **Sample data should visually demonstrate the issues** - like repeating kandidat information across rows or missing values for optional fields like pengalaman_2.
6. **Anomalies need concrete examples** - showing how deleting a row loses unrelated data, or how updating a single value requires touching dozens of records.
7. **The narrative should explain the "why" at each step** - grounding the normalization decisions in actual data patterns rather than just applying rules mechanically.Ini yang menurut saya paling penting untuk membuat dokumennya benar-benar meyakinkan:

---

**1. Tambahkan baris data contoh di UNF (yang paling penting)**

Saat ini UNF hanya menampilkan daftar kolom. Normalisasi yang nyata selalu dimulai dari **melihat data aktual**, bukan hanya nama kolom. Tampilkan 2-3 baris data nyata sehingga masalahnya langsung terlihat — kolom pengalaman_2 penuh NULL, nama HR berulang persis sama di dua baris, dsb.

---

**2. Tunjukkan anomali yang ditemukan sebelum dinormalisasi**

Inilah alasan utama mengapa normalisasi dilakukan. Perlu ada bagian kecil yang menjelaskan:
- **Anomali insert** — tidak bisa tambah kategori baru tanpa harus ada lowongan dulu
- **Anomali update** — kalau nama HR berubah, harus update di 50 baris sekaligus
- **Anomali delete** — kalau satu-satunya lowongan dihapus, data kategorinya ikut hilang

The current section 1 essentially describes the UNF state, which overlaps with section 2 (normalisasi).
   
   There's definitely redundancy here—the identifikasi tabel section previews the UNF tables, then section 2 repeats them with more detail. I think the intent was for section 1 to show the initial 5 UNF tables as a starting point, but the way it's structured creates overlap rather than a clear progression from initial identification to final normalized design.

2. **

Normalisasi - Missing aturan 1NF point**: The 1NF section covers the main rules about atomic values and unique primary keys, though it's missing the explicit mention of "no repeating groups"—which is a standard 1NF requirement, though the concept is somewhat implied.

3. **The 3NF numbering issue**: After 2NF, it jumps to "4. Normalisasi 3NF" instead of following the proper numbering sequence. This is a clear numbering error in the document structure.

4. **The identifikasi tabel and UNF overlap**: The first section describing the 5 UNF tables gets repeated in much greater detail in section 2.1, creating significant redundancy. The initial identifikasi tabel section doesn't add much value since it's essentially summarized again later.

5. **INSERT data is just examples**: Only 3 sample inserts are shown for users, job_postings, and applications—not a complete dataset. This might be insufficient depending on what the presentation needs to demonstrate.

6. **No BCNF mention**: The requirements explicitly ask for coverage through BCNF, but the document stops at 3NF. BCNF normalization isn't addressed at all.

7. **The 40-page concern**: I'm wondering if 40 pages is too lengthy for a presentation and what could realistically be trimmed without losing essential content.

Looking at what's actually working well though—all three main components are present, the UNF tables are clearly defined, and the overall structure follows the normalization progression. 2.2 Normalisasi 1NF

Sebuah tabel memenuhi First Normal Form (1NF) apabila:

1.  Setiap sel berisi tepat satu nilai — tidak boleh ada daftar atau
    kumpulan nilai dalam

satu sel

2.  Setiap baris memiliki primary key yang unik dan jelas

  Pemecahan Tabel UNF ke 1NF

Dari 5 tabel awal (UNF), setelah dilakukan normalisasi terhadap data
yang, dihasilkan total 13 tabel yang lebih terstruktur.

1.  data_pelamar terbagi menjadi data_pengguna, work_experiences,
    educations,

applicant_skills, applicant_cvs

Tabel data_pelamar dipecah karena di dalamnya terdapat beberapa jenis
data yang berbeda dan disimpan secara berulang, seperti pengalaman
kerja, pendidikan, skill, dan CV.

2. data_hr_dan_lowongan terbagi menjadi data_pengguna, job_postings,
saved_jobs

Tabel ini dipecah karena menggabungkan dua jenis data, yaitu data HR dan
data lowongan pekerjaan.

3. data_rekrutmen terbagi menjadi applications, application_status_logs,
interviews

Tabel data_rekrutmen dipecah karena berisi beberapa jenis data yang
berbeda dalam satu tabel.

4. data_sistem terbagi menjadi notifications, job_search_logs

Tabel data_sistem dipecah karena berisi data yang tidak saling
berkaitan.

5. data_keamanan terbagi menjadi password_reset_tokens, login_attempts

Tabel data_keamanan dipecah karena menggabungkan dua jenis data yang
berbeda.

2.3 Normalisasi 2NF

Sebuah tabel memenuhi Second Normal Form (2NF) apabila:

1. Sudah memenuhi 1NF

2. Tidak ada partial dependency setiap kolom non-key harus bergantung
pada seluruh

primary key, bukan hanya sebagian

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Tabel                      Jenis Primary Ada Partial  Keterangan
                             Key           Dep?         
  -------------------------- ------------- ------------ ---------------------------
  data_pengguna,             Single PK (id Tidak ada    Otomatis memenuhi 2NF
  work_experiences,          BIGINT)                    karena PK hanya satu kolom
  educations,                                           — partial dependency tidak
  applicant_skills,                                     mungkin terjadi
  applicant_cvs,                                        
  job_postings,                                         
  applications,                                         
  application_status_logs,                              
  interviews, notifications,                            
  job_search_logs,                                      
  saved_jobs,                                           
  password_reset_tokens                                 

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Kesimpulan 2NF: Semua 13 tabel menggunakan single primary key (id
  BIGINT AUTO INCREMENT), sehingga seluruh tabel otomatis memenuhi 2NF
  tanpa perlu perubahan struktural.

3. Implementasi Ke Dalam Bentuk Kode SQL

3.1 Pengaturan Awal

Sebelum membuat tabel, dilakukan pengaturan mode SQL dan zona waktu
untuk memastikan konsistensi data:

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| -- Pengaturan mode SQL                                                |
|                                                                       |
| SET SQL_MODE = 'NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO';                               |
|                                                                       |
| START TRANSACTION;                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| SET time_zone = '+00:00';                                             |
|                                                                       |
| -- Pengaturan character set                                           |
|                                                                       |
| SET NAMES utf8mb4;                                                    |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

3.2 Pembuatan Database

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `e_recruitment`                         |
|                                                                       |
| DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4                                         |
|                                                                       |
| COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;                                           |
|                                                                       |
| USE `e_recruitment`;                                                  |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

1. Sudah memenuhi 1NF

2. Tidak ada partial dependency setiap kolom non-key harus bergantung
pada seluruh

primary key, bukan hanya sebagian

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Tabel                      Jenis Primary Ada Partial  Keterangan
                             Key           Dep?         
  -------------------------- ------------- ------------ ---------------------------
  data_pengguna,             Single PK (id Tidak ada    Otomatis memenuhi 2NF
  work_experiences,          BIGINT)                    karena PK hanya satu kolom
  educations,                                           — partial dependency tidak
  applicant_skills,                                     mungkin terjadi
  applicant_cvs,                                        
  job_postings,

3. Implementasi Ke Dalam Bentuk Kode SQL

3.1 Pengaturan Awal

Sebelum membuat tabel, dilakukan pengaturan mode SQL dan zona waktu
untuk memastikan konsistensi data:

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| -- Pengaturan mode SQL                                                |
|                                                                       |
| SET SQL_MODE = 'NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO';                               |
|                                                                       |
| START TRANSACTION;                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| SET time_zone = '+00:00';                                             |
|                                                                       |
| -- Pengaturan character set                                           |
|                                                                       |
| SET NAMES utf8mb4;                                                    |
+=======================================================================+
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

3.2 Pembuatan Database

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `e_recruitment`                         |
|                                                                       |
| DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4                                         |
|                                                                       |

Section 1 (Identifikasi Tabel) mendeskripsikan 5 tabel UNF, lalu Section 2.1 (UNF) mengulangi lagi 5 tabel yang sama dengan lebih detail. Jadi Section 1 terasa seperti pengantar yang mubazir — pembaca membaca hal yang sama dua kali.

Di dokumen tertulis **"4. Normalisasi 3NF"** — harusnya **"2.4 Normalisasi 3NF"** karena masih bagian dari Bab 2 Normalisasi.

Di gambar requirement dosen tertulis jelas *"Tahapan lengkap mulai dari UNF, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, hingga BCNF"* — tapi di dokumen tidak ada BCNF sama sekali. Ini yang paling berisiko ditanya dosen.

---

Yang paling mendesak adalah **BCNF** karena disebutkan eksplisit di requirement. Mau saya bantu tambahkan bagian BCNF ke dokumen? Isinya tidak perlu panjang — cukup jelaskan bahwa database sudah memenuhi BCNF dan alasannya. 😊

The user is asking about the requirements/conditions for tables to be joined in SQL. This is a straightforward database question.Syarat utama agar tabel bisa di-JOIN ada tiga:

---

**1. Ada kolom yang nilainya sama antar tabel**
Biasanya berupa Foreign Key di satu tabel yang merujuk ke Primary Key di tabel lain. Contoh: `applications.user_id` dan `users.id` punya nilai yang sama, jadi bisa di-JOIN.

**2. Tipe data kolom yang di-JOIN harus kompatibel**
Tidak harus sama persis, tapi harus bisa dibandingkan. Contoh: `BIGINT` dengan `BIGINT` bisa, `VARCHAR` dengan `INT` tidak bisa.

**3. Ada relasi logis antar tabel**
Secara teknis JOIN bisa dilakukan antara tabel manapun selama ada kolom yang cocok, tapi hasilnya hanya bermakna kalau memang ada hubungan logis. JOIN tabel yang tidak berkaitan akan menghasilkan data yang tidak masuk akal.

---

**Contoh dari database kita:**

```sql
-- Bisa di-JOIN karena applications.user_id = users.id
SELECT users.name, applications.status
FROM applications
JOIN users ON applications.user_id = users.id;

-- Bisa di-JOIN berantai karena ada relasi bertingkat
SELECT users.name, job_postings.title, applications.status
FROM applications
JOIN users ON applications.user_id = users.id
JOIN job_postings ON applications.job_id = job_postings.id;
```

---

**Singkatnya:** tabel bisa di-JOIN kalau punya **titik temu** berupa kolom dengan nilai yang sama — dan di database yang sudah dinormalisasi seperti punya kita, titik temu itu selalu berupa hubungan FK → PK. 😊

The user wants the UI/UX section from the PRD in plain text format so they can copy-paste it into Stitch (likely Google's Stitch design tool or similar). Let me write out the UI/UX requirements in plain text.Ini versi teks lengkapnya, tinggal copas ke Stitch:

---

# UI/UX REQUIREMENTS — Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals

## ATURAN DASAR FRONTEND
- Tidak ada PHP di view. Blade hanya render shell HTML kosong
- Semua data diambil via AJAX (Fetch API) dari endpoint /api/...
- Response JSON dari API dirender oleh JavaScript ke dalam DOM
- Loading state wajib ada — tampilkan spinner saat data sedang diambil
- Error handling wajib ada — tampilkan pesan jelas jika API gagal
- Token Sanctum disimpan di localStorage dan dikirim via header Authorization: Bearer

---

## HALAMAN PUBLIK (tanpa login)

**1. Beranda / Home — URL: /**
- Hero section dengan tagline dan tombol Cari Lowongan
- Statistik singkat: total lowongan aktif, total pelamar, total kategori
- Grid lowongan terbaru (6 card)
- Grid kategori populer dengan ikon
- Tombol Lihat Semua Lowongan

**2. Daftar Lowongan — URL: /jobs**
- Sidebar filter di kiri: kategori (checkbox), tipe kerja (radio: full-time/part-time/contract/internship), tipe lokasi (radio: onsite/remote/hybrid), tombol Apply Filter dan Reset
- Search bar di atas dengan debounce 500ms
- Grid card lowongan 12 per halaman
- Pagination di bawah
- Setiap card menampilkan: judul posisi, nama perusahaan, kategori, tipe kerja, tipe lokasi, range gaji (jika show_salary=true), deadline, tombol simpan (toggle)

**3. Detail Lowongan — URL: /jobs/{slug}**
- Header: judul posisi, badge kategori, badge tipe kerja, badge tipe lokasi
- Info gaji (jika ditampilkan), kuota, deadline
- Tab atau section: Deskripsi, Persyaratan, Benefit
- Sidebar kanan: tombol Lamar Sekarang (jika sudah login sebagai pelamar), tombol Simpan Lowongan (toggle)
- Jika belum login: tombol Lamar diarahkan ke halaman login

**4. Login — URL: /login**
- Form: input email, input password (dengan toggle show/hide)
- Tombol Login
- Link ke halaman Register
- Link ke halaman Lupa Password

**5. Register — URL: /register**
- Form: input nama lengkap, input email, input nomor telepon, input password, input konfirmasi password
- Tombol Daftar
- Link ke halaman Login
- Role default otomatis: applicant

**6. Lupa Password — URL: /forgot-password**
- Form: input email
- Tombol Kirim Link Reset
- Pesan konfirmasi setelah submit: "Link reset telah dikirim ke email Anda"

**7. Reset Password — URL: /reset-password**
- Form: input password baru, input konfirmasi password baru
- Token dari URL otomatis diambil
- Tombol Reset Password

---

## HALAMAN PELAMAR (perlu login sebagai applicant)

**1. Dashboard Pelamar — URL: /applicant/dashboard**
- Kartu ringkasan: total lamaran, lamaran aktif, jadwal wawancara mendatang
- Daftar notifikasi terbaru (5 terakhir) dengan badge unread
- Daftar lowongan rekomendasi berdasarkan kategori yang pernah dilamar
- Shortcut navigasi: Cari Lowongan, Lihat Lamaran, Kelola CV

**2. Profil Pelamar — URL: /applicant/profile**
- Section foto profil dengan tombol upload
- Form edit data akun: nama, email, nomor telepon
- Form edit profil detail: bio, alamat, kota, provinsi, tanggal lahir, jenis kelamin, URL LinkedIn, URL portfolio
- Tombol Simpan untuk masing-masing section

**3. Pengalaman Kerja — URL: /applicant/experiences**
- Daftar card pengalaman kerja yang sudah diisi
- Setiap card: nama perusahaan, posisi, periode (bulan/tahun), badge "Masih Bekerja" jika is_current=true
- Tombol Edit dan Hapus di setiap card
- Tombol Tambah Pengalaman Kerja (buka modal form)
- Modal form: nama perusahaan, posisi/jabatan, tanggal mulai, tanggal selesai, toggle masih bekerja, deskripsi tugas

**4. Riwayat Pendidikan — URL: /applicant/educations**
- Daftar card pendidikan yang sudah diisi
- Setiap card: nama institusi, jenjang (badge), jurusan, tahun masuk-lulus, IPK
- Tombol Edit dan Hapus di setiap card
- Tombol Tambah Pendidikan (buka modal form)
- Modal form: nama institusi, jenjang (dropdown: SMA/D3/S1/S2/S3), jurusan, IPK, tahun masuk, tahun lulus

**5. Skill — URL: /applicant/skills**
- Tiga tab atau section: Technical, Soft Skill, Language
- Setiap skill ditampilkan sebagai chip/tag dengan badge level (beginner/intermediate/expert)
- Tombol hapus di setiap chip
- Tombol Tambah Skill (buka modal form)
- Modal form: nama skill, kategori (dropdown), level (dropdown), nama sertifikat (opsional), URL sertifikat (opsional)

**6. CV Saya — URL: /applicant/cvs**
- Grid card CV yang sudah dibuat
- Setiap card: judul CV, nama template, badge "CV Utama" jika is_primary=true
- Tombol: Edit, Hapus, Set sebagai Utama
- Tombol Buat CV Baru (buka halaman atau modal)
- Form CV: judul CV, pilih template (grid preview template), isi data CV

**7. Lamaran Saya — URL: /applicant/applications**
- Tabel atau list semua lamaran
- Setiap baris: judul lowongan, tanggal melamar, status (badge berwarna)
- Filter status: semua, applied, reviewed, shortlisted, interview, offered, rejected, withdrawn
- Klik baris untuk ke halaman detail lamaran

**8. Detail Lamaran — URL: /applicant/applications/{id}**
- Header: judul lowongan, nama perusahaan, status saat ini (badge berwarna besar)
- Section timeline status: urutan perubahan status dari applied hingga terkini, dengan timestamp dan alasan perubahan
- Section info lamaran: cover letter yang dikirim, CV yang dilampirkan
- Section wawancara (jika ada): jadwal, tipe, link/lokasi, status wawancara
- Tombol Tarik Lamaran (jika status masih applied/reviewed, muncul modal konfirmasi)

**9. Lowongan Tersimpan — URL: /applicant/saved-jobs**
- Grid card lowongan yang di-bookmark
- Setiap card sama seperti job card di halaman daftar lowongan
- Tombol hapus bookmark di setiap card
- Tombol Lamar jika lowongan masih open

**10. Jadwal Wawancara — URL: /applicant/interviews**
- List jadwal wawancara mendatang dan yang sudah lewat
- Setiap item: nama lowongan, tanggal dan jam, tipe wawancara (badge), lokasi atau link, status wawancara
- Badge status: scheduled (biru), completed (hijau), cancelled (merah), rescheduled (oranye)

**11. Notifikasi — URL: /applicant/notifications**
- List semua notifikasi, terbaru di atas
- Notifikasi belum dibaca: background lebih gelap atau ada titik biru
- Setiap notifikasi: ikon sesuai tipe, judul, pesan singkat, waktu relatif (contoh: "2 jam yang lalu")
- Tombol Tandai Semua Sudah Dibaca
- Klik notifikasi otomatis tandai sebagai dibaca dan arahkan ke halaman terkait

---

## HALAMAN HR (perlu login sebagai HR)

**1. Dashboard HR — URL: /hr/dashboard**
- Kartu statistik: total lowongan aktif, total lamaran masuk hari ini, total wawancara hari ini, total kandidat shortlisted
- Grafik sederhana: jumlah lamaran per hari dalam 7 hari terakhir
- Tabel wawancara hari ini: nama kandidat, posisi, jam, tipe
- Tabel lamaran terbaru masuk: nama kandidat, posisi yang dilamar, waktu masuk

**2. Manajemen Lowongan — URL: /hr/jobs**
- Tabel daftar lowongan yang dibuat HR ini
- Kolom: judul, kategori, tipe kerja, jumlah pelamar, status (badge), deadline
- Filter status: semua, draft, open, closed, expired
- Tombol Buat Lowongan Baru
- Tombol aksi di setiap baris: Lihat, Edit, Ubah Status

**3. Buat/Edit Lowongan — URL: /hr/jobs/create atau /hr/jobs/{id}/edit**
- Form lengkap:
  - Judul posisi
  - Kategori (dropdown)
  - Tipe kerja (radio: full-time/part-time/contract/internship)
  - Tipe lokasi (radio: onsite/remote/hybrid)
  - Lokasi (text, muncul jika onsite atau hybrid)
  - Deskripsi pekerjaan (textarea)
  - Persyaratan (textarea)
  - Benefit (textarea)
  - Gaji minimum (number, opsional)
  - Gaji maksimum (number, opsional)
  - Toggle tampilkan gaji ke pelamar
  - Kuota posisi (number)
  - Deadline (date picker, opsional)
  - Status awal (draft atau langsung open)
- Tombol Simpan sebagai Draft dan Simpan & Publikasikan

**4. Detail Lowongan HR — URL: /hr/jobs/{id}**
- Info lengkap lowongan di bagian atas
- Statistik: total pelamar, pelamar per status
- Tabel daftar pelamar dengan kolom: nama, tanggal melamar, status (badge), aksi
- Filter status pelamar
- Tombol ubah status lowongan (Tutup Lowongan, Buka Kembali)

**5. Semua Lamaran — URL: /hr/applications**
- Tabel semua lamaran dari semua lowongan HR ini
- Kolom: nama kandidat, posisi yang dilamar, tanggal masuk, status (badge)
- Filter: per lowongan, per status
- Search by nama kandidat
- Klik baris untuk ke detail lamaran

**6. Detail Lamaran HR — URL: /hr/applications/{id}**
- Section profil kandidat: foto (jika ada), nama, email, telepon, kota
- Section CV yang dilampirkan dengan tombol lihat CV
- Section cover letter
- Section riwayat status (timeline)
- Section catatan HR (textarea yang bisa diedit, tidak terlihat kandidat)
- Panel aksi di kanan: tombol ubah status (Tinjau, Shortlist, Tolak, dll) sesuai status saat ini
- Modal konfirmasi setiap ubah status dengan input alasan (opsional untuk sebagian besar, wajib untuk rejected)

**7. Manajemen Wawancara — URL: /hr/interviews**
- Tabel semua jadwal wawancara
- Kolom: nama kandidat, posisi, jadwal, tipe, status
- Filter: status, tanggal
- Tombol Buat Jadwal Wawancara Baru

**8. Buat Jadwal Wawancara — URL: /hr/interviews/create**
- Dropdown pilih lamaran (hanya yang statusnya shortlisted)
- Tanggal dan jam wawancara (datetime picker)
- Durasi dalam menit (default 60)
- Tipe wawancara (radio: online/offline/phone)
- Link meeting (muncul jika online)
- Alamat/lokasi (muncul jika offline)
- Catatan untuk kandidat (textarea, opsional)
- Tombol Jadwalkan Wawancara

**9. Input Hasil Wawancara — URL: /hr/interviews/{id}/result**
- Info jadwal wawancara di atas (read only)
- Form penilaian:
  - Nilai (slider atau input angka 0-100)
  - Feedback/catatan (textarea)
  - Rekomendasi (radio: Lanjutkan/Hold/Tolak)
- Tombol Simpan Hasil

**10. Kategori Pekerjaan — URL: /hr/categories**
- Tabel daftar kategori dengan kolom: nama, slug, status aktif
- Toggle aktif/nonaktif langsung dari tabel
- Tombol Tambah Kategori (modal form: nama)
- Tombol Edit dan Hapus di setiap baris

**11. Template CV — URL: /hr/cv-templates**
- Grid card template dengan preview gambar
- Badge aktif/nonaktif di setiap card
- Tombol Tambah Template, Edit, Toggle Aktif

---

# UI/UX REQUIREMENTS — Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals

## ATURAN DASAR FRONTEND
- Tidak ada PHP di view. Blade hanya render shell HTML kosong
- Semua data diambil via AJAX (Fetch API) dari endpoint /api/...
- Response JSON dari API dirender oleh JavaScript ke dalam DOM
- Loading state wajib ada — tampilkan spinner saat data sedang diambil
- Error handling wajib ada — tampilkan pesan jelas jika API gagal
- Token Sanctum disimpan di localStorage dan dikirim via header Authorization: Bearer

---

## HALAMAN PUBLIK (tanpa login)

**1. Beranda / Home — URL: /**
- Hero section dengan tagline dan tombol Cari Lowongan
- Statistik singkat: total lowongan aktif, total pelamar, total kategori
- Grid lowongan terbaru (6 card)
- Grid kategori populer dengan ikon
- Tombol Lihat Semua Lowongan

**2. Daftar Lowongan — URL: /jobs**
- Sidebar filter di kiri: kategori (checkbox), tipe kerja (radio: full-time/part-time/contract/internship), tipe lokasi (radio: onsite/remote/hybrid), tombol Apply Filter dan Reset
- Search bar di atas dengan debounce 500ms
- Grid card lowongan 12 per halaman
- Pagination di bawah
- Setiap card menampilkan: judul posisi, nama perusahaan, kategori, tipe kerja, tipe lokasi, range gaji (jika show_salary=true), deadline, tombol simpan (toggle)

**3. Detail Lowongan — URL: /jobs/{slug}**
- Header: judul posisi, badge kategori, badge tipe kerja, badge tipe lokasi
- Info gaji (jika ditampilkan), kuota, deadline
- Tab atau section: Deskripsi, Persyaratan, Benefit
- Sidebar kanan: tombol Lamar Sekarang (jika sudah login sebagai pelamar), tombol Simpan Lowongan (toggle)
- Jika belum login: tombol Lamar diarahkan ke halaman login

**4. Login — URL: /login**
- Form: input email, input password (dengan toggle show/hide)
- Tombol Login
- Link ke halaman Register
- Link ke halaman Lupa Password

**5. Register — URL: /register**
- Form: input nama lengkap, input email, input nomor telepon, input password, input konfirmasi password
- Tombol Daftar
- Link ke halaman Login
- Role default otomatis: applicant

**6. Lupa Password — URL: /forgot-password**
- Form: input email
- Tombol Kirim Link Reset
- Pesan konfirmasi setelah submit: "Link reset telah dikirim ke email Anda"

**7. Reset Password — URL: /reset-password**
- Form: input password baru, input konfirmasi password baru
- Token dari URL otomatis diambil
- Tombol Reset Password

---

## HALAMAN PELAMAR (perlu login sebagai applicant)

**1. Dashboard Pelamar — URL: /applicant/dashboard**
- Kartu ringkasan: total lamaran, lamaran aktif, jadwal wawancara mendatang
- Daftar notifikasi terbaru (5 terakhir) dengan badge unread
- Daftar lowongan rekomendasi berdasarkan kategori yang pernah dilamar
- Shortcut navigasi: Cari Lowongan, Lihat Lamaran, Kelola CV

**2. Profil Pelamar — URL: /applicant/profile**
- Section foto profil dengan tombol upload
- Form edit data akun: nama, email, nomor telepon
- Form edit profil detail: bio, alamat, kota, provinsi, tanggal lahir, jenis kelamin, URL LinkedIn, URL portfolio
- Tombol Simpan untuk masing-masing section

**3. Pengalaman Kerja — URL: /applicant/experiences**
- Daftar card pengalaman kerja yang sudah diisi
- Setiap card: nama perusahaan, posisi, periode (bulan/tahun), badge "Masih Bekerja" jika is_current=true
- Tombol Edit dan Hapus di setiap card
- Tombol Tambah Pengalaman Kerja (buka modal form)
- Modal form: nama perusahaan, posisi/jabatan, tanggal mulai, tanggal selesai, toggle masih bekerja, deskripsi tugas

**4. Riwayat Pendidikan — URL: /applicant/educations**
- Daftar card pendidikan yang sudah diisi
- Setiap card: nama institusi, jenjang (badge), jurusan, tahun masuk-lulus, IPK
- Tombol Edit dan Hapus di setiap card
- Tombol Tambah Pendidikan (buka modal form)
- Modal form: nama institusi, jenjang (dropdown: SMA/D3/S1/S2/S3), jurusan, IPK, tahun masuk, tahun lulus

**5. Skill — URL: /applicant/skills**
- Tiga tab atau section: Technical, Soft Skill, Language
- Setiap skill ditampilkan sebagai chip/tag dengan badge level (beginner/intermediate/expert)
- Tombol hapus di setiap chip
- Tombol Tambah Skill (buka modal form)
- Modal form: nama skill, kategori (dropdown), level (dropdown), nama sertifikat (opsional), URL sertifikat (opsional)

**6. CV Saya — URL: /applicant/cvs**
- Grid card CV yang sudah dibuat
- Setiap card: judul CV, nama template, badge "CV Utama" jika is_primary=true
- Tombol: Edit, Hapus, Set sebagai Utama
- Tombol Buat CV Baru (buka halaman atau modal)
- Form CV: judul CV, pilih template (grid preview template), isi data CV

**7. Lamaran Saya — URL: /applicant/applications**
- Tabel atau list semua lamaran
- Setiap baris: judul lowongan, tanggal melamar, status (badge berwarna)
- Filter status: semua, applied, reviewed, shortlisted, interview, offered, rejected, withdrawn
- Klik baris untuk ke halaman detail lamaran

**8. Detail Lamaran — URL: /applicant/applications/{id}**
- Header: judul lowongan, nama perusahaan, status saat ini (badge berwarna besar)
- Section timeline status: urutan perubahan status dari applied hingga terkini, dengan timestamp dan alasan perubahan
- Section info lamaran: cover letter yang dikirim, CV yang dilampirkan
- Section wawancara (jika ada): jadwal, tipe, link/lokasi, status wawancara
- Tombol Tarik Lamaran (jika status masih applied/reviewed, muncul modal konfirmasi)

**9. Lowongan Tersimpan — URL: /applicant/saved-jobs**
- Grid card lowongan yang di-bookmark
- Setiap card sama seperti job card di halaman daftar lowongan
- Tombol hapus bookmark di setiap card
- Tombol Lamar jika lowongan masih open

**10. Jadwal Wawancara — URL: /applicant/interviews**
- List jadwal wawancara mendatang dan yang sudah lewat
- Setiap item: nama lowongan, tanggal dan jam, tipe wawancara (badge), lokasi atau link, status wawancara
- Badge status: scheduled (biru), completed (hijau), cancelled (merah), rescheduled (oranye)

**11. Notifikasi — URL: /applicant/notifications**
- List semua notifikasi, terbaru di atas
- Notifikasi belum dibaca: background lebih gelap atau ada titik biru
- Setiap notifikasi: ikon sesuai tipe, judul, pesan singkat, waktu relatif (contoh: "2 jam yang lalu")
- Tombol Tandai Semua Sudah Dibaca
- Klik notifikasi otomatis tandai sebagai dibaca dan arahkan ke halaman terkait

---

## HALAMAN HR (perlu login sebagai HR)

**1. Dashboard HR — URL: /hr/dashboard**
- Kartu statistik: total lowongan aktif, total lamaran masuk hari ini, total wawancara hari ini, total kandidat shortlisted
- Grafik sederhana: jumlah lamaran per hari dalam 7 hari terakhir
- Tabel wawancara hari ini: nama kandidat, posisi, jam, tipe
- Tabel lamaran terbaru masuk: nama kandidat, posisi yang dilamar, waktu masuk

**2. Manajemen Lowongan — URL: /hr/jobs**
- Tabel daftar lowongan yang dibuat HR ini
- Kolom: judul, kategori, tipe kerja, jumlah pelamar, status (badge), deadline
- Filter status: semua, draft, open, closed, expired
- Tombol Buat Lowongan Baru
- Tombol aksi di setiap baris: Lihat, Edit, Ubah Status

**3. Buat/Edit Lowongan — URL: /hr/jobs/create atau /hr/jobs/{id}/edit**
- Form lengkap:
  - Judul posisi
  - Kategori (dropdown)
  - Tipe kerja (radio: full-time/part-time/contract/internship)
  - Tipe lokasi (radio: onsite/remote/hybrid)
  - Lokasi (text, muncul jika onsite atau hybrid)
  - Deskripsi pekerjaan (textarea)
  - Persyaratan (textarea)
  - Benefit (textarea)
  - Gaji minimum (number, opsional)
  - Gaji maksimum (number, opsional)
  - Toggle tampilkan gaji ke pelamar
  - Kuota posisi (number)
  - Deadline (date picker, opsional)
  - Status awal (draft atau langsung open)
- Tombol Simpan sebagai Draft dan Simpan & Publikasikan

**4. Detail Lowongan HR — URL: /hr/jobs/{id}**
- Info lengkap lowongan di bagian atas
- Statistik: total pelamar, pelamar per status
- Tabel daftar pelamar dengan kolom: nama, tanggal melamar, status (badge), aksi
- Filter status pelamar
- Tombol ubah status lowongan (Tutup Lowongan, Buka Kembali)

**5. Semua Lamaran — URL: /hr/applications**
- Tabel semua lamaran dari semua lowongan HR ini
- Kolom: nama kandidat, posisi yang dilamar, tanggal masuk, status (badge)
- Filter: per lowongan, per status
- Search by nama kandidat
- Klik baris untuk ke detail lamaran

**6. Detail Lamaran HR — URL: /hr/applications/{id}**
- Section profil kandidat: foto (jika ada), nama, email, telepon, kota
- Section CV yang dilampirkan dengan tombol lihat CV
- Section cover letter
- Section riwayat status (timeline)
- Section catatan HR (textarea yang bisa diedit, tidak terlihat kandidat)
- Panel aksi di kanan: tombol ubah status (Tinjau, Shortlist, Tolak, dll) sesuai status saat ini
- Modal konfirmasi setiap ubah status dengan input alasan (opsional untuk sebagian besar, wajib untuk rejected)

**7. Manajemen Wawancara — URL: /hr/interviews**
- Tabel semua jadwal wawancara
- Kolom: nama kandidat, posisi, jadwal, tipe, status
- Filter: status, tanggal
- Tombol Buat Jadwal Wawancara Baru

**8. Buat Jadwal Wawancara — URL: /hr/interviews/create**
- Dropdown pilih lamaran (hanya yang statusnya shortlisted)
- Tanggal dan jam wawancara (datetime picker)
- Durasi dalam menit (default 60)
- Tipe wawancara (radio: online/offline/phone)
- Link meeting (muncul jika online)
- Alamat/lokasi (muncul jika offline)
- Catatan untuk kandidat (textarea, opsional)
- Tombol Jadwalkan Wawancara

**9. Input Hasil Wawancara — URL: /hr/interviews/{id}/result**
- Info jadwal wawancara di atas (read only)
- Form penilaian:
  - Nilai (slider atau input angka 0-100)
  - Feedback/catatan (textarea)
  - Rekomendasi (radio: Lanjutkan/Hold/Tolak)
- Tombol Simpan Hasil

**10. Kategori Pekerjaan — URL: /hr/categories**
- Tabel daftar kategori dengan kolom: nama, slug, status aktif
- Toggle aktif/nonaktif langsung dari tabel
- Tombol Tambah Kategori (modal form: nama)
- Tombol Edit dan Hapus di setiap baris

**11. Template CV — URL: /hr/cv-templates**
- Grid card template dengan preview gambar
- Badge aktif/nonaktif di setiap card
- Tombol Tambah Template, Edit, Toggle Aktif

**Kemungkinan penyebabnya:**

# Cek apakah file masih ada di disk tapi tidak di git

git stash list
```

Kalau file memang benar-benar hilang dari disk, kita masih bisa rebuild dari yang kita punya karena:

**Cara ganti balik ke HeidiSQL:**

mysql -u root e_recruitment < "C:\path\to\e_recruitment.sql"

Cara terminal ini paling cepat dan tidak perlu buka GUI apapun! 😊

chat_messages.text:
Bagus! 🎉

---

**Apa itu Session?**

Session adalah cara Laravel menyimpan data sementara tentang pengguna yang sedang menggunakan aplikasi. Contohnya: siapa yang sedang login, token autentikasi, pesan flash notifikasi, dll.

---

**Perbedaan Session Driver:**

| Driver | Data disimpan di | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | File di folder `storage/framework/sessions/` | Development / local |
| `database` | Tabel `sessions` di MySQL | Production |
| `cookie` | Browser pengguna | Aplikasi sederhana |
| `redis` | Redis server | Production skala besar |

---

**Kenapa kita pakai `file` sekarang?**

Karena tabel `sessions` tidak ada di database kita — file SQL yang kita import dari project lama tidak menyertakan tabel itu. 

Untuk **development dan presentasi besok**, `file` sudah lebih dari cukup dan tidak ada bedanya dari sisi tampilan dan fungsi.

---

**Kalau nanti mau pakai `database`** tinggal:

```bash
php artisan session:table
php artisan migrate
```

Lalu ubah `.env` balik ke:
```
SESSION_DRIVER=database
```

---

Untuk sekarang biarkan `file` dulu — yang penting project jalan dan kita bisa lanjut ke design! Siap lanjut? 😊

MySQL tidak bisa start karena file `component_reference_cache.dll` tidak ditemukan. Ini masalah cache MySQL yang corrupt.

**Fix cepat:**

**Langkah 1 — Buka folder MySQL:**
```
C:\laragon\bin\mysql\
```

Cari folder MySQL yang ada (biasanya namanya seperti `mysql-8.0.30-winx64`)

**Langkah 2 — Masuk ke folder tersebut, cari dan hapus file:**
```
component_reference_cache.dll
```

Atau cari di:
```
C:\laragon\bin\mysql\mysql-8.0.30-winx64\
```

**Langkah 3 — Klik OK** pada popup error

**Langkah 4 — Klik Reload** di Laragon

---

Kalau tidak ketemu file itu, coba cara lain:

**Buka Terminal Laragon dan jalankan:**
```bash
cd C:\laragon\bin\mysql\mysql-8.0.30-winx64
del component_reference_cache.dll
```

Lalu Reload Laragon.

---

File itu adalah cache otomatis MySQL — aman untuk dihapus, MySQL akan membuat ulang sendiri saat restart. Coba dan kirim hasilnya! 😊

cd C:\laragon\bin\mysql\mysql-8.0.30-winx64

```

This is because the GitHub repo only has README.md (as we saw earlier), so the Laravel files were never pushed to GitHub.Masalahnya jelas — **file Laravel tidak pernah di-push ke GitHub!**

Ingat tadi repo GitHub-nya hanya berisi `README.md` saja. Jadi yang di-clone orang lain hanya README kosong, bukan project Laravel-nya.

---

**Yang perlu dilakukan — push project Laravel ke GitHub:**

**Langkah 1 — Masuk ke folder project:**
```bash
cd C:\laragon\laravel\e-recruitment
```

**Langkah 2 — Cek status git:**
```bash
git status
```

**Langkah 3 — Pastikan .gitignore sudah benar, lalu add semua file:**
```bash
git add .
```

**Langkah 4 — Commit:**
```bash
git commit -m "initial project laravel e-recruitment"
```

**Langkah 5 — Push ke GitHub:**
```bash
git push origin main
```

---

**Catatan penting — file yang TIDAK boleh di-push:**

Pastikan `.gitignore` sudah mengecualikan:
```
/vendor
.env
/node_modules
```

File `.env` tidak boleh di-push karena berisi password dan konfigurasi lokal. Yang di-push adalah `.env.example` saja.

---

**Untuk orang yang clone, setelah clone jalankan:**
```bash
composer install
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
```

Lalu setup `.env` masing-masing sesuai konfigurasi lokal mereka.

Coba push dulu dan kirim hasilnya! 😊

const {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  AlignmentType, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
  LevelFormat, PageBreak, VerticalAlign
} = require('docx');
const fs = require('fs');

const C = {
  BLUE:"1F4E79", BLUE_MID:"2E75B6", BLUE_LIGHT:"D6E4F0",
  GREEN:"1D6A4E", GREEN_LIGHT:"D6EAE0",
  ORANGE:"B45309", ORANGE_LIGHT:"FDEBD0",
  RED:"B91C1C", RED_LIGHT:"FADBD8",
  PURPLE:"5B2D8E", TEAL:"0F766E",
  GRAY:"F5F5F5", BORDER:"CCCCCC"
};

const bdr={style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:4,color:C.BORDER};
const bdrs={top:bdr,bottom:bdr,left:bdr,right:bdr};
const noBdr={style:BorderStyle.NONE,size:0,color:"FFFFFF"};
const noBdrs={top:noBdr,bottom:noBdr,left:noBdr,right:noBdr};

const h1=t=>new Paragraph({heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_1,spacing:{before:360,after:200},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:32,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE})]});
const h2=t=>new Paragraph({heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_2,spacing:{before:260,after:140},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:26,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE_MID})]});
const h3=t=>new Paragraph({heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_3,spacing:{before:200,after:100},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:23,font:"Arial",color:"333333"})]});
const h4=t=>new Paragraph({spacing:{before:160,after:80},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:22,font:"Arial",color:C.TEAL})]});
const para=t=>new Paragraph({spacing:{before:80,after:80},alignment:AlignmentType.JUSTIFIED,children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:22,font:"Arial",color:"333333"})]});
const spacer=(n=1)=>new Paragraph({spacing:{before:0,after:n*80},children:[new TextRun("")]});
const pb=()=>new Paragraph({children:[new PageBreak()]});
const bullet=t=>new Paragraph({numbering:{reference:"bullets",level:0},spacing:{before:60,after:60},children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:22,font:"Arial"})]});

const tHdr=(cols,widths,bg=C.BLUE)=>new TableRow({tableHeader:true,children:cols.map((c,i)=>new TableCell({
  borders:bdrs,width:{size:widths[i],type:WidthType.DXA},
  shading:{fill:bg,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
  margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:120,right:120},
  children:[new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,children:[new TextRun({text:c,bold:true,size:19,font:"Arial",color:"FFFFFF"})]})]
}))});

const tRow=(cells,widths,bg="FFFFFF")=>new TableRow({children:cells.map((c,i)=>new TableCell({
  borders:bdrs,width:{size:widths[i],type:WidthType.DXA},
  shading:{fill:bg,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
  margins:{top:60,bottom:60,left:120,right:120},
  children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:c,size:19,font:"Arial",color:"333333"})]})]
}))});

function banner(label,color=C.BLUE){
  return new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[9360],
    rows:[new TableRow({children:[new TableCell({
      borders:noBdrs,shading:{fill:color,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:130,bottom:130,left:280,right:280},
      children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:label,bold:true,size:26,font:"Arial",color:"FFFFFF"})]})]
    })]})]
  });
}

function alertBox(t,bg,tc){
  return new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[9360],
    rows:[new TableRow({children:[new TableCell({
      borders:noBdrs,shading:{fill:bg,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:130,bottom:130,left:240,right:240},
      children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:21,font:"Arial",color:tc,bold:true})]})]
    })]})]
  });
}

function note(t,left=C.ORANGE){
  return new Paragraph({
    spacing:{before:120,after:120},
    border:{left:{style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:14,color:left}},
    indent:{left:400},
    children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:20,font:"Arial",color:"555555",italics:true})]
  });
}

function sql(lines){
  const allLines = Array.isArray(lines) ? lines : lines.split('\n');
  return new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[9360],
    rows:[new TableRow({children:[new TableCell({
      borders:noBdrs,
      shading:{fill:"1E2A3A",type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:140,bottom:140,left:220,right:220},
      children:allLines.map(l=>{
        const isComment = l.trim().startsWith('--');
        const isKeyword = /^(CREATE|ALTER|DROP|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|SELECT|FROM|WHERE|JOIN|ON|GROUP|ORDER|HAVING|LIMIT|INNER|LEFT|RIGHT|AND|OR|NOT|IN|EXISTS|UNION|AS|SET|VALUES|INTO|TABLE|DATABASE|INDEX|PRIMARY|FOREIGN|KEY|REFERENCES|UNIQUE|ENGINE|DEFAULT|NULL|AUTO_INCREMENT|CONSTRAINT|ADD|MODIFY|RENAME|IF)/i.test(l.trim());
        return new Paragraph({
          spacing:{before:0,after:0},
          children:[new TextRun({
            text:l,
            size:18,
            font:"Courier New",
            color:isComment?"6A9955":isKeyword?"569CD6":"A8D8EA"
          })]
        });
      })
    })]})]}
  ));
}

const children = [];

// ── COVER ──
children.push(
  spacer(2),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:100},children:[new TextRun({text:"LAPORAN PRAKTIKUM BASIS DATA",size:24,font:"Arial",color:"888888",bold:true})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:200},border:{bottom:{style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:8,color:C.BLUE_MID}},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"DDL, DML & Query Lanjutan",bold:true,size:44,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:200,after:120},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"Implementasi Normalisasi 1NF → 2NF → 3NF → BCNF",size:26,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE_MID})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:80},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals",size:22,font:"Arial",color:"555555"})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:80},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"PBL TRPL-212 — Politeknik Batam — 2025",size:22,font:"Arial",color:"888888"})]}),
  spacer(3),
  new Table({
    width:{size:5040,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[3240,1800],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Nama Anggota","NIM"],[3240,1800],C.BLUE_MID),
      ...[
        ["Khayra Sakilla Ramona","4342501073"],
        ["Faizal Kahfi Lubis","4342501077"],
        ["Faiz Annabil","4342501071"],
        ["Mufti","4342501084"],
        ["Rasya' Defiya Putri Salsabila","4342501062"],
      ].map((r,i)=>tRow(r,[3240,1800],i%2===0?"FFFFFF":C.BLUE_LIGHT))
    ]
  }),
  pb()
);

// ── BAB 1: PENGANTAR ──
children.push(
  h1("BAB 1 — PENGANTAR NORMALISASI SQL"),
  h2("1.1 Alur Normalisasi"),
  para("Normalisasi database dilakukan secara bertahap melalui 4 tahap. Setiap tahap menghasilkan perubahan struktur DDL yang spesifik:"),
  spacer(1),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[1200,2200,2960,2800],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Tahap","Masalah yang Diselesaikan","Perubahan DDL","Contoh di DB Kita"],[1200,2200,2960,2800]),
      tRow(["1NF","Repeating groups — kolom berulang","Pecah tabel besar menjadi tabel-tabel kecil dengan FK","data_pelamar → users + work_experiences + educations + skills + cvs"],[1200,2200,2960,2800]),
      tRow(["2NF","Partial dependency — kolom bergantung pada sebagian PK composite","Pisahkan kolom yang bergantung pada sebagian PK ke tabel baru","applications: pisahkan nama_pelamar (→ users) dan judul_lowongan (→ job_postings)"],[1200,2200,2960,2800],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["3NF","Transitive dependency — kolom bergantung pada kolom non-key","Pisahkan kolom transitive ke tabel baru","job_postings: pisahkan nama_kategori (→ job_categories)"],[1200,2200,2960,2800]),
      tRow(["BCNF","Setiap determinan harus candidate key","Verifikasi dan restrukturisasi jika ada determinan bukan candidate key","Semua tabel kita sudah memenuhi BCNF setelah 3NF"],[1200,2200,2960,2800],C.GRAY),
    ]
  }),
  spacer(),
  h2("1.2 Jenis Perintah SQL"),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[1400,2000,5960],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Kategori","Perintah","Fungsi"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DDL","CREATE TABLE","Membuat tabel baru"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DDL","ALTER TABLE","Mengubah struktur tabel yang sudah ada"],[1400,2000,5960],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["DDL","DROP TABLE","Menghapus tabel"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DML","INSERT INTO","Menambah data baru ke tabel"],[1400,2000,5960],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["DML","UPDATE","Mengubah data yang sudah ada"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DML","DELETE","Menghapus data dari tabel"],[1400,2000,5960],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["Query","SELECT","Mengambil dan menampilkan data"],[1400,2000,5960]),
    ]
  }),
  pb()
);

// ── BAB 2: 1NF ──
children.push(
  h1("BAB 2 — FIRST NORMAL FORM (1NF)"),
  banner("Aturan 1NF: Tidak boleh ada repeating groups. Setiap kolom harus atomik (satu nilai). Setiap baris harus punya Primary Key.",C.BLUE),

  h3("INNER JOIN — Ambil data yang ada di kedua tabel"),

    "-- Daftar semua lamaran beserta nama pelamar dan judul lowongan",

    "  u.name          AS nama_pelamar,",
    "  u.email         AS email_pelamar,",
    "  jp.title        AS judul_lowongan,",
    "  jc.name         AS kategori,",
    "  a.status        AS status_lamaran,",
    "  a.created_at    AS tanggal_melamar",
    "FROM applications a",
    "INNER JOIN users u         ON a.user_id    = u.id",
    "INNER JOIN job_postings jp ON a.job_id     = jp.id",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",

    "  COUNT(DISTINCT jp.id)                                    AS total_lowongan_aktif,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)                                     AS total_lamaran_masuk,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status = 'shortlisted'",

    "  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status = 'interview'",

    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "LEFT JOIN applications a   ON jp.id = a.job_id",

    "-- Kategori yang memiliki lebih dari 5 pelamar (HAVING)",
