    "ORDER BY total_pelamar DESC;",
    "",
    "-- Rata-rata nilai wawancara per lowongan (hanya yang sudah ada hasilnya)",
    "SELECT",
    "  jp.title,",
    "  COUNT(ir.id)        AS jumlah_sesi,",
    "  ROUND(AVG(ir.score),2) AS rata_nilai,",
    "  MAX(ir.score)       AS nilai_max,",
    "  MIN(ir.score)       AS nilai_min",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN applications a     ON jp.id = a.job_id",
    "INNER JOIN interviews i       ON a.id  = i.application_id",
    "INNER JOIN interview_results ir ON i.id = ir.interview_id",
    "GROUP BY jp.id, jp.title",
    "HAVING COUNT(ir.id) >= 1",
    "ORDER BY rata_nilai DESC;",
  ]),
  spacer(),

  h2("7.5 FULLTEXT Search"),
  sql([
    "-- Pencarian lowongan menggunakan FULLTEXT INDEX",
    "-- Index dibuat pada: title, description, requirements, benefits",
    "",
    "-- Cara 1: NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE (default)",
    "SELECT",
    "  jp.title,",
    "  jc.name AS kategori,",
    "  jp.location,",
    "  jp.salary_min,",
    "  jp.salary_max,",
    "  MATCH(jp.title, jp.description, jp.requirements, jp.benefits)",
    "    AGAINST('laravel backend developer' IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS relevance",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",
    "WHERE MATCH(jp.title, jp.description, jp.requirements, jp.benefits)",
    "      AGAINST('laravel backend developer' IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)",
    "  AND jp.status = 'open'",
    "ORDER BY relevance DESC;",
    "",
    "-- Cara 2: BOOLEAN MODE (lebih fleksibel)",
    "SELECT jp.title, jc.name AS kategori, jp.status",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",
    "WHERE MATCH(jp.title, jp.description, jp.requirements, jp.benefits)",
    "      AGAINST('+laravel +backend -frontend' IN BOOLEAN MODE)",
    "  AND jp.status = 'open';",
    "-- +laravel  = HARUS ada kata 'laravel'",
    "-- +backend  = HARUS ada kata 'backend'",
    "-- -frontend = TIDAK BOLEH ada kata 'frontend'",
  ]),
  spacer(),

  h2("7.6 Query Statistik Dashboard HR"),
  sql([
    "-- Dashboard HR: rekap lengkap untuk satu HR",
    "SELECT",
    "  u.name                                                      AS nama_hr,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT jp.id)                                       AS total_lowongan,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jp.status = 'open'",
    "                 THEN jp.id END)                              AS lowongan_aktif,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)                                        AS total_lamaran,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status = 'shortlisted'",
    "                 THEN a.id END)                               AS kandidat_shortlisted,",
    "  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.scheduled_at >= CURDATE()",
    "                 AND i.status = 'scheduled'",
    "                 THEN i.id END)                               AS wawancara_mendatang",
    "FROM users u",
    "LEFT JOIN job_postings jp ON u.id = jp.hr_user_id",
    "LEFT JOIN applications a  ON jp.id = a.job_id",
    "LEFT JOIN interviews i    ON a.id = i.application_id",
    "WHERE u.role = 'hr' AND u.id = 1",
    "GROUP BY u.id, u.name;",
    "",
    "-- Timeline status lamaran (riwayat lengkap satu lamaran)",
    "SELECT",
    "  asl.id,",
    "  asl.old_status,",
    "  asl.new_status,",
    "  asl.reason,",
    "  u.name    AS diubah_oleh,",
    "  asl.created_at AS waktu_perubahan",
    "FROM application_status_logs asl",
    "INNER JOIN users u ON asl.changed_by = u.id",
    "WHERE asl.application_id = 1",
    "ORDER BY asl.created_at ASC;",
  ]),
  spacer(),

  h2("7.7 Query dengan ORDER BY dan LIMIT"),
  sql([
    "-- 10 lowongan terbaru yang masih open",
    "SELECT jp.title, jc.name AS kategori, jp.salary_min, jp.salary_max, jp.deadline",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",
    "WHERE jp.status = 'open'",
    "ORDER BY jp.created_at DESC",
    "LIMIT 10;",
    "",
    "-- Pelamar dengan nilai wawancara tertinggi",
    "SELECT",
    "  u.name        AS nama_kandidat,",
    "  jp.title      AS posisi,",
    "  ir.score      AS nilai,",
    "  ir.recommendation AS rekomendasi",
    "FROM interview_results ir",
    "INNER JOIN interviews i    ON ir.interview_id = i.id",
    "INNER JOIN applications a  ON i.application_id = a.id",
    "INNER JOIN users u         ON a.user_id = u.id",
    "INNER JOIN job_postings jp ON a.job_id  = jp.id",
    "ORDER BY ir.score DESC",
    "LIMIT 5;",
    "",
    "-- Pagination: lowongan halaman 2 (12 per halaman)",
    "SELECT jp.title, jc.name AS kategori, jp.status",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",
    "WHERE jp.status = 'open'",
    "ORDER BY jp.created_at DESC",
    "LIMIT 12 OFFSET 12;  -- halaman 2: skip 12 baris pertama",
  ]),
  pb()
);

// ── BAB 8: RINGKASAN ──
children.push(
  h1("BAB 8 — RINGKASAN"),
  h2("8.1 Perjalanan Normalisasi"),
  spacer(1),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[1000,1200,2800,4360],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Tahap","Jumlah Tabel","Perubahan DDL Utama","Masalah yang Diselesaikan"],[1000,1200,2800,4360]),
      tRow(["UNF","5 tabel","CREATE TABLE dengan repeating groups","Data mentah, belum terstruktur"],[1000,1200,2800,4360]),
      tRow(["1NF","13 tabel","CREATE TABLE baru + FK untuk setiap repeating group","Menghilangkan kolom berulang (pengalaman_1, pengalaman_2, dst)"],[1000,1200,2800,4360],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["2NF","13 tabel","Tidak ada perubahan struktural","Verifikasi: semua tabel pakai single PK, otomatis 2NF"],[1000,1200,2800,4360]),
      tRow(["3NF","18 tabel","CREATE TABLE baru + ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN + ADD CONSTRAINT FK","Memisahkan: job_categories, cv_templates, user_profiles, interview_results, login_attempts"],[1000,1200,2800,4360],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["BCNF","18 tabel","Tidak ada perubahan struktural","Verifikasi: semua determinan adalah candidate key"],[1000,1200,2800,4360]),
    ]
  }),
  spacer(2),
  h2("8.2 Perintah DDL yang Digunakan"),
  spacer(1),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[2500,6860],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Perintah DDL","Kapan Digunakan"],[2500,6860]),
      tRow(["CREATE TABLE","Membuat tabel baru saat normalisasi membutuhkan pemecahan entitas"],[2500,6860]),
      tRow(["ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN","Menghapus kolom yang transitive/redundan setelah dipindah ke tabel baru"],[2500,6860],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT FOREIGN KEY","Menambahkan relasi FK setelah tabel referensi dibuat"],[2500,6860]),
      tRow(["ALTER TABLE ... ADD UNIQUE KEY","Menambahkan constraint unik untuk menjaga integritas data"],[2500,6860],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX","Membuat index pencarian teks untuk fitur search lowongan"],[2500,6860]),
    ]
  }),
  spacer(2),
  h2("8.3 Perintah DML yang Digunakan"),
  spacer(1),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[2000,3500,3860],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Perintah DML","Contoh Penggunaan","Catatan Khusus"],[2000,3500,3860]),
      tRow(["INSERT INTO","Menambah user, lowongan, lamaran, notifikasi","application_status_logs hanya boleh INSERT"],[2000,3500,3860]),
      tRow(["UPDATE","Mengubah status lowongan, profil, catatan HR","Selalu sertakan updated_at = NOW()"],[2000,3500,3860],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["DELETE","Hapus token expired, notifikasi lama, bookmark","application_status_logs TIDAK BOLEH dihapus"],[2000,3500,3860]),
    ]
  }),
  spacer(2),
  alertBox("Database Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals telah memenuhi BCNF dengan 18 tabel, 22 relasi FK, bebas redundansi dan anomali data.",C.BLUE_LIGHT,C.BLUE)
);

// ── BUILD ──
const doc = new Document({
  numbering:{config:[
    {reference:"bullets",levels:[{level:0,format:LevelFormat.BULLET,text:"\u2022",alignment:AlignmentType.LEFT,style:{paragraph:{indent:{left:720,hanging:360}}}}]},
  ]},
  styles:{
    default:{document:{run:{font:"Arial",size:22}}},
    paragraphStyles:[
      {id:"Heading1",name:"Heading 1",basedOn:"Normal",next:"Normal",quickFormat:true,run:{size:32,bold:true,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE},paragraph:{spacing:{before:360,after:200},outlineLevel:0}},
      {id:"Heading2",name:"Heading 2",basedOn:"Normal",next:"Normal",quickFormat:true,run:{size:26,bold:true,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE_MID},paragraph:{spacing:{before:260,after:140},outlineLevel:1}},
      {id:"Heading3",name:"Heading 3",basedOn:"Normal",next:"Normal",quickFormat:true,run:{size:23,bold:true,font:"Arial",color:"333333"},paragraph:{spacing:{before:200,after:100},outlineLevel:2}},
    ]
  },
  sections:[{properties:{page:{size:{width:11906,height:16838},margin:{top:1440,right:1440,bottom:1440,left:1800}}},children}]
});

Packer.toBuffer(doc).then(b=>{
  fs.writeFileSync('/home/claude/DDL_DML_Normalisasi.docx',b);
  console.log('Done!');
}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});

{"language": "javascript", "code": "const {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  AlignmentType, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
  LevelFormat, PageBreak, VerticalAlign
} = require('docx');
const fs = require('fs');

const C = {
  BLUE:"1F4E79", BLUE_MID:"2E75B6", BLUE_LIGHT:"D6E4F0",
  GREEN:"1D6A4E", GREEN_LIGHT:"D6EAE0",
  ORANGE:"B45309", ORANGE_LIGHT:"FDEBD0",
  RED:"B91C1C", RED_LIGHT:"FADBD8",
  PURPLE:"5B2D8E", TEAL:"0F766E",
  GRAY:"F5F5F5", BORDER:"CCCCCC"
};

const bdr={style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:4,color:C.BORDER};
const bdrs={top:bdr,bottom:bdr,left:bdr,right:bdr};
const noBdr={style:BorderStyle.NONE,size:0,color:"FFFFFF"};
const noBdrs={top:noBdr,bottom:noBdr,left:noBdr,right:noBdr};

const h1=t=>new Paragraph({heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_1,spacing:{before:360,after:200},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:32,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE})]});
const h2=t=>new Paragraph({heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_2,spacing:{before:260,after:140},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:26,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE_MID})]});
const h3=t=>new Paragraph({heading:HeadingLevel.HEADING_3,spacing:{before:200,after:100},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:23,font:"Arial",color:"333333"})]});
const h4=t=>new Paragraph({spacing:{before:160,after:80},children:[new TextRun({text:t,bold:true,size:22,font:"Arial",color:C.TEAL})]});
const para=t=>new Paragraph({spacing:{before:80,after:80},alignment:AlignmentType.JUSTIFIED,children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:22,font:"Arial",color:"333333"})]});
const spacer=(n=1)=>new Paragraph({spacing:{before:0,after:n*80},children:[new TextRun("")]});
const pb=()=>new Paragraph({children:[new PageBreak()]});
const bullet=t=>new Paragraph({numbering:{reference:"bullets",level:0},spacing:{before:60,after:60},children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:22,font:"Arial"})]});

const tHdr=(cols,widths,bg=C.BLUE)=>new TableRow({tableHeader:true,children:cols.map((c,i)=>new TableCell({
  borders:bdrs,width:{size:widths[i],type:WidthType.DXA},
  shading:{fill:bg,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
  margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:120,right:120},
  children:[new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,children:[new TextRun({text:c,bold:true,size:19,font:"Arial",color:"FFFFFF"})]})]
}))});

const tRow=(cells,widths,bg="FFFFFF")=>new TableRow({children:cells.map((c,i)=>new TableCell({
  borders:bdrs,width:{size:widths[i],type:WidthType.DXA},
  shading:{fill:bg,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
  margins:{top:60,bottom:60,left:120,right:120},
  children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:c,size:19,font:"Arial",color:"333333"})]})]
}))});

function banner(label,color=C.BLUE){
  return new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[9360],
    rows:[new TableRow({children:[new TableCell({
      borders:noBdrs,shading:{fill:color,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:130,bottom:130,left:280,right:280},
      children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:label,bold:true,size:26,font:"Arial",color:"FFFFFF"})]})]
    })]})]
  });
}

function alertBox(t,bg,tc){
  return new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[9360],
    rows:[new TableRow({children:[new TableCell({
      borders:noBdrs,shading:{fill:bg,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:130,bottom:130,left:240,right:240},
      children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:21,font:"Arial",color:tc,bold:true})]})]
    })]})]
  });
}

function note(t,left=C.ORANGE){
  return new Paragraph({
    spacing:{before:120,after:120},
    border:{left:{style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:14,color:left}},
    indent:{left:400},
    children:[new TextRun({text:t,size:20,font:"Arial",color:"555555",italics:true})]
  });
}

function sql(lines){
  const allLines = Array.isArray(lines) ? lines : lines.split('\n');
  return new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[9360],
    rows:[new TableRow({children:[new TableCell({
      borders:noBdrs,
      shading:{fill:"1E2A3A",type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:140,bottom:140,left:220,right:220},
      children:allLines.map(l=>{
        const isComment = l.trim().startsWith('--');
        const isKeyword = /^(CREATE|ALTER|DROP|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|SELECT|FROM|WHERE|JOIN|ON|GROUP|ORDER|HAVING|LIMIT|INNER|LEFT|RIGHT|AND|OR|NOT|IN|EXISTS|UNION|AS|SET|VALUES|INTO|TABLE|DATABASE|INDEX|PRIMARY|FOREIGN|KEY|REFERENCES|UNIQUE|ENGINE|DEFAULT|NULL|AUTO_INCREMENT|CONSTRAINT|ADD|MODIFY|RENAME|IF)/i.test(l.trim());
        return new Paragraph({
          spacing:{before:0,after:0},
          children:[new TextRun({
            text:l,
            size:18,
            font:"Courier New",
            color:isComment?"6A9955":isKeyword?"569CD6":"A8D8EA"
          })]
        });
      })
    })]})]}
  ));
}

const children = [];

// ── COVER ──
children.push(
  spacer(2),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:100},children:[new TextRun({text:"LAPORAN PRAKTIKUM BASIS DATA",size:24,font:"Arial",color:"888888",bold:true})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:200},border:{bottom:{style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:8,color:C.BLUE_MID}},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"DDL, DML & Query Lanjutan",bold:true,size:44,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:200,after:120},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"Implementasi Normalisasi 1NF → 2NF → 3NF → BCNF",size:26,font:"Arial",color:C.BLUE_MID})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:80},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals",size:22,font:"Arial",color:"555555"})]}),
  new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,spacing:{before:0,after:80},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"PBL TRPL-212 — Politeknik Batam — 2025",size:22,font:"Arial",color:"888888"})]}),
  spacer(3),
  new Table({
    width:{size:5040,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[3240,1800],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Nama Anggota","NIM"],[3240,1800],C.BLUE_MID),
      ...[
        ["Khayra Sakilla Ramona","4342501073"],
        ["Faizal Kahfi Lubis","4342501077"],
        ["Faiz Annabil","4342501071"],
        ["Mufti","4342501084"],
        ["Rasya' Defiya Putri Salsabila","4342501062"],
      ].map((r,i)=>tRow(r,[3240,1800],i%2===0?"FFFFFF":C.BLUE_LIGHT))
    ]
  }),
  pb()
);

// ── BAB 1: PENGANTAR ──
children.push(
  h1("BAB 1 — PENGANTAR NORMALISASI SQL"),
  h2("1.1 Alur Normalisasi"),
  para("Normalisasi database dilakukan secara bertahap melalui 4 tahap. Setiap tahap menghasilkan perubahan struktur DDL yang spesifik:"),
  spacer(1),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[1200,2200,2960,2800],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Tahap","Masalah yang Diselesaikan","Perubahan DDL","Contoh di DB Kita"],[1200,2200,2960,2800]),
      tRow(["1NF","Repeating groups — kolom berulang","Pecah tabel besar menjadi tabel-tabel kecil dengan FK","data_pelamar → users + work_experiences + educations + skills + cvs"],[1200,2200,2960,2800]),
      tRow(["2NF","Partial dependency — kolom bergantung pada sebagian PK composite","Pisahkan kolom yang bergantung pada sebagian PK ke tabel baru","applications: pisahkan nama_pelamar (→ users) dan judul_lowongan (→ job_postings)"],[1200,2200,2960,2800],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["3NF","Transitive dependency — kolom bergantung pada kolom non-key","Pisahkan kolom transitive ke tabel baru","job_postings: pisahkan nama_kategori (→ job_categories)"],[1200,2200,2960,2800]),
      tRow(["BCNF","Setiap determinan harus candidate key","Verifikasi dan restrukturisasi jika ada determinan bukan candidate key","Semua tabel kita sudah memenuhi BCNF setelah 3NF"],[1200,2200,2960,2800],C.GRAY),
    ]
  }),
  spacer(),
  h2("1.2 Jenis Perintah SQL"),
  new Table({
    width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA},columnWidths:[1400,2000,5960],
    rows:[
      tHdr(["Kategori","Perintah","Fungsi"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DDL","CREATE TABLE","Membuat tabel baru"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DDL","ALTER TABLE","Mengubah struktur tabel yang sudah ada"],[1400,2000,5960],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["DDL","DROP TABLE","Menghapus tabel"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DML","INSERT INTO","Menambah data baru ke tabel"],[1400,2000,5960],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["DML","UPDATE","Mengubah data yang sudah ada"],[1400,2000,5960]),
      tRow(["DML","DELETE","Menghapus data dari tabel"],[1400,2000,5960],C.GRAY),
      tRow(["Query","SELECT","Mengambil dan menampilkan data"],[1400,2000,5960]),
    ]
  }),
  pb()
);

// ── BAB 2: 1NF ──
children.push(
  h1("BAB 2 — FIRST NORMAL FORM (1NF)"),
  banner("Aturan 1NF: Tidak boleh ada repeating groups. Setiap kolom harus atomik (satu nilai). Setiap baris harus punya Primary Key.",C.BLUE),
  spacer(),
  h2("2.1 Kondisi Sebelum 1NF — Tabel UNF"),
  para("Sebelum normalisasi, semua data rekrutmen digabung dalam satu tabel besar. Kolom pengalaman kerja, pendidikan, dan skill berulang membentuk repeating groups:"),
  spacer(1),
  sql([
    "-- ============================================================",
    "-- KONDISI UNF: SEBELUM NORMALISASI",
    "-- Satu tabel besar dengan repeating groups",
    "-- ============================================================",
    "CREATE TABLE data_pelamar (",
    "  kandidat_id        BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,",
    "  nama               VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,",
    "  email              VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,",
    "  password           VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",
    "  telepon            VARCHAR(20),",
    "",
    "  -- REPEATING GROUP: Pengalaman Kerja",
    "  pengalaman_1_perusahaan    VARCHAR(150),",
    "  pengalaman_1_jabatan       VARCHAR(100),",
    "  pengalaman_1_mulai         DATE,",
    "  pengalaman_1_selesai       DATE,",
    "  pengalaman_2_perusahaan    VARCHAR(150),  -- NULL jika hanya 1",
    "  pengalaman_2_jabatan       VARCHAR(100),  -- NULL jika hanya 1",
    "  pengalaman_2_mulai         DATE,",
    "  pengalaman_2_selesai       DATE,",
    "",
    "  -- REPEATING GROUP: Pendidikan",
    "  pendidikan_1_institusi     VARCHAR(200),",
    "  pendidikan_1_jenjang       VARCHAR(10),",
    "  pendidikan_1_jurusan       VARCHAR(150),",
    "  pendidikan_1_ipk           DECIMAL(3,2),",
    "",
    "  -- REPEATING GROUP: Skill",
    "  skill_1_nama       VARCHAR(100),",
    "  skill_1_kategori   VARCHAR(20),",
    "  skill_2_nama       VARCHAR(100),  -- NULL jika hanya 1 skill",
    "  skill_2_kategori   VARCHAR(20),",
    "",
    "  -- REDUNDAN: nama_template bergantung pada template_id bukan kandidat",
    "  cv_1_template_id      BIGINT,",
    "  cv_1_nama_template    VARCHAR(100),  -- REDUNDAN",
    "  cv_1_preview_template VARCHAR(500),  -- REDUNDAN",
    "",
    "  PRIMARY KEY (kandidat_id)",
    ");",
    "",
    "-- MASALAH:",
    "-- 1. Jika kandidat punya 5 pengalaman kerja, kolom _3, _4, _5 harus ditambah manual",
    "-- 2. Kandidat dengan 1 pengalaman: kolom pengalaman_2_* semua NULL (boros)",
    "-- 3. nama_template berulang di setiap kandidat yang pakai template sama",
  ]),
  spacer(),
  h2("2.2 Penerapan 1NF — Pecah Repeating Groups"),
  para("Setiap repeating group dipisah menjadi tabel tersendiri dengan foreign key yang menghubungkan ke tabel induknya:"),
  spacer(1),

  h3("Tabel 1: users (dari data_pelamar — data dasar)"),
  sql([
    "-- 1NF: Tabel users — hanya data dasar pengguna",
    "CREATE TABLE users (",
    "  id                 BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,",
    "  name               VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,",
    "  email              VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,",

    "-- Cara 1: NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE (default)",
    "SELECT",
    "  jp.title,",
    "  jc.name AS kategori,",
    "  jp.location,",
    "  jp.salary_min,",
    "  jp.salary_max,",
    "  MATCH(jp.title, jp.description, jp.requirements, jp.benefits)",
    "    AGAINST('laravel backend developer' IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS relevance",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",
    "WHERE MATCH(jp.title, jp.description, jp.requirements, jp.benefits)",
    "      AGAINST('laravel backend developer' IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)",
    "  AND jp.status = 'open'",
    "ORDER BY relevance DESC;",
    "",
    "-- Cara 2: BOOLEAN MODE (lebih fleksibel)",
    "SELECT jp.title, jc.name AS kategori, jp.status",
    "FROM job_postings jp",
    "INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.category_id = jc.id",
    "WHERE MATCH(jp.title, jp.description, jp.requirements, jp.benefits)",

    "  AND jp.status = 'open';",

input.file_text:
-- ============================================================
-- LAPORAN PROGRESS PROJECT PBL PART-2
-- PEMROGRAMAN BASIS DATA
-- Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals
-- PBL TRPL-212 | TRPL 2C Pagi | Politeknik Batam 2025
-- ============================================================
-- Anggota:
-- 4342501073 Khayra Sakilla Ramona
-- 4342501077 Faizal Kahfi Lubis
-- 4342501071 Faiz Annabil
-- 4342501084 Mufti
-- 4342501062 Rasya' Defiya Putri Salsabila
-- ============================================================
-- CATATAN: File ini menggunakan database TERPISAH (e_recruitment_laporan)
-- agar tidak mengganggu database utama (e_recruitment)
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- SETUP AWAL
-- ============================================================

CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `e_recruitment_laporan`
  DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
  COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

USE `e_recruitment_laporan`;

SET SQL_MODE = 'NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO';
SET time_zone = '+00:00';
SET NAMES utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================
-- A. NORMALISASI - DDL
-- Menunjukkan proses normalisasi melalui DDL
-- UNF -> 1NF -> 2NF -> 3NF -> BCNF
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. UNF (Unnormalized Form)
-- Tabel mentah sebelum dinormalisasi
-- ============================================================

-- Tabel UNF: data_pelamar
-- Masalah: repeating groups (pengalaman_1_*, skill_1_*, cv_1_*)
CREATE TABLE `data_pelamar` (
  `kandidat_id`             BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nama`                    VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `email`                   VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `password`                VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `telepon`                 VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Pengalaman Kerja
  `pengalaman_1_perusahaan` VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_1_jabatan`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_1_mulai`      DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_1_selesai`    DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_2_perusahaan` VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_2_jabatan`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Skill
  `skill_1_nama`            VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skill_1_kategori`        VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skill_2_nama`            VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skill_2_kategori`        VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP + REDUNDAN: CV
  `cv_1_template_id`        BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cv_1_nama_template`      VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cv_1_preview_template`   VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`kandidat_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_hr_dan_lowongan
-- Masalah: data HR berulang, lowongan_1_* adalah repeating group
CREATE TABLE `data_hr_dan_lowongan` (
  `hr_id`                   BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nama_hr`                 VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `email_hr`                VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `password_hr`             VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Lowongan
  `lowongan_1_judul`        VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_1_kategori_id`  BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_1_nama_kategori`VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_2_judul`        VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_2_kategori_id`  BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_2_nama_kategori`VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`hr_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_rekrutmen
-- Masalah: riwayat_1_*, wawancara_1_* adalah repeating group
CREATE TABLE `data_rekrutmen` (
  `lamaran_id`              BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `kandidat_id`             BIGINT(20) NOT NULL,
  `lowongan_id`             BIGINT(20) NOT NULL,
  `status_lamaran`          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Riwayat Status
  `riwayat_1_status_lama`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_1_status_baru`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_1_alasan`        TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_2_status_lama`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_2_status_baru`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Wawancara
  `wawancara_1_tipe`        VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `wawancara_1_waktu`       DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
  `hasil_wawancara_1_nilai` TINYINT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lamaran_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_sistem
-- Masalah: 3 jenis data berbeda digabung, banyak kolom NULL
CREATE TABLE `data_sistem` (
  `sistem_id`         BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`           BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis_data`        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  `notif_tipe`        VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notif_judul`       VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notif_pesan`       TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `cari_keyword`      VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cari_jumlah_hasil` INT DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_email`       VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_ip`          VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_berhasil`    TINYINT(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`        TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`sistem_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_keamanan
-- Masalah: token reset dan log login digabung
CREATE TABLE `data_keamanan` (
  `keamanan_id`         BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`             BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis`               VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  `token_reset`         VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_kadaluarsa`    TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_sudah_dipakai` TINYINT(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_email`         VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_ip`            VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_berhasil`      TINYINT(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`          TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`keamanan_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- ============================================================
-- 2. 1NF (First Normal Form)
-- Pecah semua repeating groups menjadi tabel terpisah
-- Hasil: 13 tabel
-- ============================================================

-- Tabel 1NF: data_pengguna
-- Gabungan HR dan pelamar dalam satu tabel, dibedakan kolom role
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: kolom profil detail akan dipisah di 3NF
CREATE TABLE `data_pengguna` (
  `id`                BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nama`              VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `email`             VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `password`          VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `role`              ENUM('hr','applicant') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'applicant',
  `telepon`           VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- Kolom profil detail masih di sini (akan dipindah ke user_profiles di 3NF)
  `foto`              VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio`               TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `alamat`            TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `kota`              VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `provinsi`          VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tanggal_lahir`     DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis_kelamin`     ENUM('male','female') DEFAULT NULL,
  `linkedin_url`      VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `portfolio_url`     VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active`         TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at`        TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at`        TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `data_pengguna_email_unique` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: work_experiences
-- Repeating group pengalaman_1_*, pengalaman_2_* dipecah
CREATE TABLE `work_experiences_1nf` (
  `id`           BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `company_name` VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `position`     VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `start_date`   DATE NOT NULL,
  `end_date`     DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_current`   TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `description`  TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_we_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_we_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: educations
-- Repeating group pendidikan dipecah
CREATE TABLE `educations_1nf` (
  `id`          BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `institution` VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  `degree`      ENUM('SMA','D3','S1','S2','S3') NOT NULL,
  `major`       VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gpa`         DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_year`  YEAR NOT NULL,
  `end_year`    YEAR DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`  TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_edu_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_edu_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: applicant_skills
-- Repeating group skill_1_*, skill_2_* dipecah
CREATE TABLE `applicant_skills_1nf` (
  `id`         BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`    BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `skill_name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `category`   ENUM('technical','soft','language') NOT NULL,
  `level`      ENUM('beginner','intermediate','expert') NOT NULL,
  `cert_name`  VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cert_url`   VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_skill_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_skill_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: applicant_cvs
-- Repeating group cv_1_* dipecah
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: nama_template transitive dependency (akan diperbaiki di 3NF)
CREATE TABLE `applicant_cvs_1nf` (
  `id`               BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`          BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `template_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `nama_template`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada template_id
  `preview_template` VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada template_id
  `title`            VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `cv_data`          JSON DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_primary`       TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at`       TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_cv_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cv_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: job_postings
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: nama_kategori transitive dependency
CREATE TABLE `job_postings_1nf` (
  `id`              BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `hr_user_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `category_id`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `nama_kategori`   VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada category_id
  `slug_kategori`   VARCHAR(120) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada category_id
  `title`           VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  `slug`            VARCHAR(220) NOT NULL,
  `description`     TEXT NOT NULL,
  `requirements`    TEXT NOT NULL,
  `employment_type` ENUM('full-time','part-time','contract','internship') NOT NULL,

-- Tabel 1NF: applications
CREATE TABLE `applications_1nf` (
  `id`           BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `job_id`       BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `cv_id`        BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `cover_letter` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `status`       ENUM('applied','reviewed','shortlisted','interview',
                      'offered','rejected','withdrawn') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'applied',
  `hr_notes`     TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`   TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `app_user_job_unique_1nf` (`user_id`,`job_id`),
  KEY `fk_app_job` (`job_id`),
  KEY `fk_app_cv` (`cv_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_app_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_app_job_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`job_id`) REFERENCES `job_postings_1nf` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_app_cv_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`cv_id`) REFERENCES `applicant_cvs_1nf` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: application_status_logs
-- Repeating group riwayat_1_*, riwayat_2_* dipecah
CREATE TABLE `application_status_logs_1nf` (
  `id`             BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `application_id` BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `changed_by`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `old_status`     ENUM('applied','reviewed','shortlisted','interview',
                        'offered','rejected','withdrawn') NOT NULL,
  `new_status`     ENUM('applied','reviewed','shortlisted','interview',
                        'offered','rejected','withdrawn') NOT NULL,
  `reason`         TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_asl_app` (`application_id`),
  KEY `fk_asl_by` (`changed_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asl_app_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`application_id`) REFERENCES `applications_1nf` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asl_by_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`changed_by`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: interviews
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: nilai, rekomendasi harus dipisah ke tabel lain
CREATE TABLE `interviews_1nf` (
  `id`               BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `application_id`   BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `scheduled_by`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `scheduled_at`     DATETIME NOT NULL,
  `duration_minutes` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
  `interview_type`   ENUM('online','offline','phone') NOT NULL,

  `nilai`            TINYINT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `feedback`         TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `rekomendasi`      ENUM('proceed','hold','reject') DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`       TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_int_app` (`application_id`),
  KEY `fk_int_by` (`scheduled_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_int_app_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`application_id`) REFERENCES `applications_1nf` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_int_by_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`scheduled_by`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: job_search_logs (dari data_sistem)
CREATE TABLE `job_search_logs_1nf` (

-- ============================================================
-- 3. 2NF (Second Normal Form)
-- Tidak ada perubahan struktural
-- Semua tabel menggunakan single PK sehingga otomatis 2NF
-- ============================================================

-- Verifikasi: cek semua PK di database ini
SELECT
  TABLE_NAME,
  COLUMN_NAME,
  COLUMN_KEY
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'e_recruitment_laporan'
  AND COLUMN_KEY = 'PRI'
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

-- ============================================================
-- 4. 3NF (Third Normal Form)
-- Selesaikan transitive dependency
-- Tambah 5 tabel baru: job_categories, cv_templates,
-- user_profiles, interview_results, login_attempts
-- ============================================================

-- Tabel 3NF baru 1: job_categories
-- Dipisah dari job_postings_1nf karena nama_kategori bergantung
-- pada category_id bukan pada id lowongan
CREATE TABLE `job_categories` (
  `id`        BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name`      VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `slug`      VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  `icon`      VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `job_categories_slug_unique` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Hapus kolom transitive dari job_postings_1nf
ALTER TABLE `job_postings_1nf`
  DROP COLUMN `nama_kategori`,
  DROP COLUMN `slug_kategori`,
  ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_jp_category_3nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `job_categories` (`id`);

-- Tabel 3NF baru 2: cv_templates
-- Dipisah dari applicant_cvs_1nf karena nama_template bergantung
-- pada template_id bukan pada id CV
CREATE TABLE `cv_templates` (
  `id`          BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name`        VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `preview_url` VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active`   TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at`  TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Hapus kolom transitive dari applicant_cvs_1nf
ALTER TABLE `applicant_cvs_1nf`
  DROP COLUMN `nama_template`,
  DROP COLUMN `preview_template`,
  ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_cv_template_3nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`template_id`) REFERENCES `cv_templates` (`id`);

-- Tabel 3NF baru 3: user_profiles
-- Dipisah dari data_pengguna agar query login lebih ringan
-- Relasi 1:1 dengan data_pengguna
CREATE TABLE `user_profiles` (
  `id`            BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`       BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `bio`           TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `address`       VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city`          VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `province`      VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `birth_date`    DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `gender`        ENUM('male','female') DEFAULT NULL,
  `avatar_url`    VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `linkedin_url`  VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `portfolio_url` VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at`    TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_profiles_user_id_unique` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_up_user_3nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Hapus kolom profil dari data_pengguna
ALTER TABLE `data_pengguna`
  DROP COLUMN `foto`,
  DROP COLUMN `bio`,
  DROP COLUMN `alamat`,
  DROP COLUMN `kota`,
  DROP COLUMN `provinsi`,
  DROP COLUMN `tanggal_lahir`,
  DROP COLUMN `jenis_kelamin`,
  DROP COLUMN `linkedin_url`,
  DROP COLUMN `portfolio_url`;

-- Tabel 3NF baru 4: interview_results
-- Dipisah dari interviews_1nf karena jadwal dan hasil penilaian
-- adalah dua entitas berbeda. Relasi 1:1 dengan interviews
CREATE TABLE `interview_results` (
  `id`             BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `interview_id`   BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `reviewed_by`    BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `score`          TINYINT(3) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `feedback`       TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `recommendation` ENUM('proceed','hold','reject') NOT NULL,
  `created_at`     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ir_interview_unique` (`interview_id`),
  KEY `fk_ir_reviewer` (`reviewed_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ir_interview_3nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`interview_id`) REFERENCES `interviews_1nf` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ir_reviewer_3nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`reviewed_by`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Hapus kolom penilaian dari interviews_1nf
ALTER TABLE `interviews_1nf`
  DROP COLUMN `nilai`,
  DROP COLUMN `feedback`,
  DROP COLUMN `rekomendasi`;

-- Tabel 3NF baru 5: login_attempts
-- Dipisah karena bisa mencatat login tamu (user_id nullable)
CREATE TABLE `login_attempts` (
  `id`           BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email`        VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `ip_address`   VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_success`   TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `attempted_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

   'https://meet.google.com/eco-green-hr', 'scheduled', NOW(), NOW()),
  (3, 1, '2026-03-19 14:00:00', 90, 'offline',
   'Gedung HR PT Eco Green Lt.3', 'completed', NOW(), NOW());

-- 17. interview_results
INSERT INTO `interview_results`
  (`interview_id`, `reviewed_by`, `score`, `feedback`, `recommendation`)
VALUES
  (2, 1, 82,
   'Kandidat memiliki pemahaman akuntansi yang baik dan komunikasi yang lancar.',
   'proceed');

-- 18. notifications
INSERT INTO `notifications_1nf`
  (`user_id`, `type`, `title`, `message`)
VALUES
  (3, 'status_changed', 'Lamaran Anda Diperbarui',
   'Selamat! Lamaran Anda untuk posisi Backend Developer telah masuk tahap Shortlisted.'),
  (3, 'application_received', 'Lamaran Berhasil Dikirim',
   'Lamaran Anda untuk posisi Frontend Developer telah berhasil dikirim.'),
  (4, 'interview_scheduled', 'Undangan Wawancara',
   'Anda dijadwalkan wawancara untuk posisi Staff Keuangan pada 29 Maret 2026.');

-- ============================================================
-- C. QUERY LANJUTAN
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. AGGREGATE FUNCTION
-- ============================================================

-- a) Menghitung total lamaran yang masuk
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lamaran
FROM applications_1nf;

-- b) Menghitung jumlah lowongan yang aktif
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lowongan_aktif
FROM job_postings_1nf
WHERE status = 'open';

-- c) Menghitung rata-rata, nilai tertinggi, dan nilai terendah wawancara
SELECT
  COUNT(*)             AS total_wawancara,
  ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS rata_nilai,
  MAX(score)           AS nilai_tertinggi,
  MIN(score)           AS nilai_terendah
FROM interview_results;

-- d) Menghitung jumlah pelamar per lowongan
SELECT
  jp.title            AS judul_lowongan,
  COUNT(a.id)         AS jumlah_pelamar
FROM job_postings_1nf jp
LEFT JOIN applications_1nf a ON jp.id = a.job_id
GROUP BY jp.id, jp.title
ORDER BY jumlah_pelamar DESC;

-- e) Menghitung jumlah skill per pelamar
SELECT
  dp.name        AS nama_pelamar,
  COUNT(s.id)    AS jumlah_skill
FROM data_pengguna dp
LEFT JOIN applicant_skills_1nf s ON dp.id = s.user_id
WHERE dp.role = 'applicant'
GROUP BY dp.id, dp.name
ORDER BY jumlah_skill DESC;

-- ============================================================
-- 2. SUBQUERY
-- ============================================================

-- a) Menampilkan pelamar yang melamar lebih dari 1 lowongan
SELECT name, email
FROM data_pengguna
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM applications_1nf
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- b) Menampilkan lowongan yang belum ada pelamarnya
SELECT title, status, deadline
FROM job_postings_1nf
WHERE id NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM applications_1nf
)
AND status = 'open';

-- c) Menampilkan kandidat yang nilai wawancaranya di atas rata-rata
SELECT
  dp.name     AS nama_kandidat,
  ir.score    AS nilai
FROM interview_results ir
INNER JOIN interviews_1nf i   ON ir.interview_id = i.id
INNER JOIN applications_1nf a ON i.application_id = a.id
INNER JOIN data_pengguna dp   ON a.user_id = dp.id
WHERE ir.score > (
  SELECT AVG(score) FROM interview_results
);

-- ============================================================
-- 3. CONSTRAINT
-- ============================================================

-- 1. Primary Key
-- Contoh pada tabel data_pengguna
SHOW CREATE TABLE data_pengguna;

-- 2. Foreign Key
-- Contoh pada tabel applications_1nf
SHOW CREATE TABLE applications_1nf;

-- 3. NOT NULL - Cek kolom yang NOT NULL
SELECT
  TABLE_NAME,
  COLUMN_NAME,
  IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'e_recruitment_laporan'
  AND IS_NULLABLE = 'NO'
  AND TABLE_NAME = 'job_postings_1nf'
ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION;

-- 4. UNIQUE Constraint
ALTER TABLE `data_pengguna`
  ADD UNIQUE KEY `uq_email_pengguna` (`email`);

-- Cek UNIQUE yang sudah ada
SELECT
  TABLE_NAME,
  CONSTRAINT_NAME,
  COLUMN_NAME
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'e_recruitment_laporan'
  AND CONSTRAINT_NAME LIKE '%unique%'
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME;

-- ============================================================
-- 4. STORED PROCEDURE & FUNCTION
-- ============================================================

-- a) Stored Procedure: tambah lamaran baru
DELIMITER //

CREATE PROCEDURE tambah_lamaran(
  IN p_user_id    BIGINT,
  IN p_job_id     BIGINT,
  IN p_cv_id      BIGINT,
  IN p_cover      TEXT
)
BEGIN
  DECLARE v_app_id BIGINT;

  INSERT INTO applications_1nf(user_id, job_id, cv_id, cover_letter, status, created_at, updated_at)
  VALUES(p_user_id, p_job_id, p_cv_id, p_cover, 'applied', NOW(), NOW());

  SET v_app_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();

  INSERT INTO application_status_logs_1nf
    (application_id, changed_by, old_status, new_status, reason)
  VALUES(v_app_id, p_user_id, 'applied', 'applied', 'Lamaran baru dikirim oleh pelamar');

  SELECT * FROM applications_1nf WHERE id = v_app_id;
END //

DELIMITER ;

-- Cara memanggil procedure tambah_lamaran:
CALL tambah_lamaran(5, 3, 3, 'Saya tertarik dengan posisi Staff Keuangan ini.');

-- b) Stored Procedure: ubah status lamaran
DELIMITER //

CREATE PROCEDURE ubah_status_lamaran(
  IN p_application_id BIGINT,
  IN p_changed_by     BIGINT,
  IN p_new_status     VARCHAR(20),
  IN p_reason         TEXT
)
BEGIN
  DECLARE v_old_status VARCHAR(20);

  SELECT status INTO v_old_status
  FROM applications_1nf
  WHERE id = p_application_id;

  UPDATE applications_1nf
  SET status = p_new_status, updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_application_id;

  INSERT INTO application_status_logs_1nf
    (application_id, changed_by, old_status, new_status, reason)
  VALUES(p_application_id, p_changed_by, v_old_status, p_new_status, p_reason);

  SELECT * FROM application_status_logs_1nf
  WHERE application_id = p_application_id
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
END //

DELIMITER ;

-- Cara memanggil procedure ubah_status_lamaran:
CALL ubah_status_lamaran(1, 1, 'interview', 'Kandidat dipanggil untuk wawancara teknis.');

{"language": "sql", "code": "-- ============================================================
-- LAPORAN PROGRESS PROJECT PBL PART-2
-- PEMROGRAMAN BASIS DATA
-- Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals
-- PBL TRPL-212 | TRPL 2C Pagi | Politeknik Batam 2025
-- ============================================================
-- Anggota:
-- 4342501073 Khayra Sakilla Ramona
-- 4342501077 Faizal Kahfi Lubis
-- 4342501071 Faiz Annabil
-- 4342501084 Mufti
-- 4342501062 Rasya' Defiya Putri Salsabila
-- ============================================================
-- CATATAN: File ini menggunakan database TERPISAH (e_recruitment_laporan)
-- agar tidak mengganggu database utama (e_recruitment)
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- SETUP AWAL
-- ============================================================

CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `e_recruitment_laporan`
  DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
  COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

USE `e_recruitment_laporan`;

SET SQL_MODE = 'NO_AUTO_VALUE_ON_ZERO';
SET time_zone = '+00:00';
SET NAMES utf8mb4;

-- ============================================================
-- A. NORMALISASI - DDL
-- Menunjukkan proses normalisasi melalui DDL
-- UNF -> 1NF -> 2NF -> 3NF -> BCNF
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. UNF (Unnormalized Form)
-- Tabel mentah sebelum dinormalisasi
-- ============================================================

-- Tabel UNF: data_pelamar
-- Masalah: repeating groups (pengalaman_1_*, skill_1_*, cv_1_*)
CREATE TABLE `data_pelamar` (
  `kandidat_id`             BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nama`                    VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `email`                   VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `password`                VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `telepon`                 VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Pengalaman Kerja
  `pengalaman_1_perusahaan` VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_1_jabatan`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_1_mulai`      DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_1_selesai`    DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_2_perusahaan` VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pengalaman_2_jabatan`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Skill
  `skill_1_nama`            VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skill_1_kategori`        VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skill_2_nama`            VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `skill_2_kategori`        VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP + REDUNDAN: CV
  `cv_1_template_id`        BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cv_1_nama_template`      VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cv_1_preview_template`   VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`kandidat_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_hr_dan_lowongan
-- Masalah: data HR berulang, lowongan_1_* adalah repeating group
CREATE TABLE `data_hr_dan_lowongan` (
  `hr_id`                   BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nama_hr`                 VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `email_hr`                VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `password_hr`             VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Lowongan
  `lowongan_1_judul`        VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_1_kategori_id`  BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_1_nama_kategori`VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_2_judul`        VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_2_kategori_id`  BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lowongan_2_nama_kategori`VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`hr_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_rekrutmen
-- Masalah: riwayat_1_*, wawancara_1_* adalah repeating group
CREATE TABLE `data_rekrutmen` (
  `lamaran_id`              BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `kandidat_id`             BIGINT(20) NOT NULL,
  `lowongan_id`             BIGINT(20) NOT NULL,
  `status_lamaran`          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Riwayat Status
  `riwayat_1_status_lama`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_1_status_baru`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_1_alasan`        TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_2_status_lama`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `riwayat_2_status_baru`   VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- REPEATING GROUP: Wawancara
  `wawancara_1_tipe`        VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `wawancara_1_waktu`       DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
  `hasil_wawancara_1_nilai` TINYINT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lamaran_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_sistem
-- Masalah: 3 jenis data berbeda digabung, banyak kolom NULL
CREATE TABLE `data_sistem` (
  `sistem_id`         BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`           BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis_data`        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  `notif_tipe`        VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notif_judul`       VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notif_pesan`       TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `cari_keyword`      VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cari_jumlah_hasil` INT DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_email`       VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_ip`          VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_berhasil`    TINYINT(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`        TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`sistem_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel UNF: data_keamanan
-- Masalah: token reset dan log login digabung
CREATE TABLE `data_keamanan` (
  `keamanan_id`         BIGINT(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`             BIGINT(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis`               VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  `token_reset`         VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_kadaluarsa`    TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_sudah_dipakai` TINYINT(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_email`         VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_ip`            VARCHAR(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `login_berhasil`      TINYINT(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`          TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`keamanan_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- ============================================================
-- 2. 1NF (First Normal Form)
-- Pecah semua repeating groups menjadi tabel terpisah
-- Hasil: 13 tabel
-- ============================================================

-- Tabel 1NF: data_pengguna
-- Gabungan HR dan pelamar dalam satu tabel, dibedakan kolom role
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: kolom profil detail akan dipisah di 3NF
CREATE TABLE `data_pengguna` (
  `id`                BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nama`              VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `email`             VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `password`          VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `role`              ENUM('hr','applicant') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'applicant',
  `telepon`           VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  -- Kolom profil detail masih di sini (akan dipindah ke user_profiles di 3NF)
  `foto`              VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio`               TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `alamat`            TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `kota`              VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `provinsi`          VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `tanggal_lahir`     DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `jenis_kelamin`     ENUM('male','female') DEFAULT NULL,
  `linkedin_url`      VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `portfolio_url`     VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active`         TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at`        TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at`        TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `data_pengguna_email_unique` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: work_experiences
-- Repeating group pengalaman_1_*, pengalaman_2_* dipecah
CREATE TABLE `work_experiences_1nf` (
  `id`           BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `company_name` VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `position`     VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `start_date`   DATE NOT NULL,
  `end_date`     DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_current`   TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `description`  TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_we_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_we_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: educations
-- Repeating group pendidikan dipecah
CREATE TABLE `educations_1nf` (
  `id`          BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `institution` VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  `degree`      ENUM('SMA','D3','S1','S2','S3') NOT NULL,
  `major`       VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gpa`         DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `start_year`  YEAR NOT NULL,
  `end_year`    YEAR DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`  TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_edu_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_edu_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: applicant_skills
-- Repeating group skill_1_*, skill_2_* dipecah
CREATE TABLE `applicant_skills_1nf` (
  `id`         BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`    BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `skill_name` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `category`   ENUM('technical','soft','language') NOT NULL,
  `level`      ENUM('beginner','intermediate','expert') NOT NULL,
  `cert_name`  VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cert_url`   VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_skill_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_skill_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: applicant_cvs
-- Repeating group cv_1_* dipecah
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: nama_template transitive dependency (akan diperbaiki di 3NF)
CREATE TABLE `applicant_cvs_1nf` (
  `id`               BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`          BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `template_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `nama_template`    VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada template_id
  `preview_template` VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada template_id
  `title`            VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  `cv_data`          JSON DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_primary`       TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at`       TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_cv_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cv_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: job_postings
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: nama_kategori transitive dependency
CREATE TABLE `job_postings_1nf` (
  `id`              BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `hr_user_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `category_id`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `nama_kategori`   VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada category_id
  `slug_kategori`   VARCHAR(120) DEFAULT NULL, -- TRANSITIVE DEP: bergantung pada category_id
  `title`           VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  `slug`            VARCHAR(220) NOT NULL,
  `description`     TEXT NOT NULL,
  `requirements`    TEXT NOT NULL,
  `employment_type` ENUM('full-time','part-time','contract','internship') NOT NULL,
  `location_type`   ENUM('onsite','remote','hybrid') NOT NULL,
  `location`        VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  `salary_min`      DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `salary_max`      DECIMAL(12,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status`          ENUM('draft','open','closed','expired') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `deadline`        DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`      TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `jp_slug_unique_1nf` (`slug`),
  KEY `fk_jp_hr` (`hr_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_jp_hr_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`hr_user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: applications
CREATE TABLE `applications_1nf` (
  `id`           BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id`      BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `job_id`       BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `cv_id`        BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `cover_letter` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `status`       ENUM('applied','reviewed','shortlisted','interview',
                      'offered','rejected','withdrawn') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'applied',
  `hr_notes`     TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`   TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `app_user_job_unique_1nf` (`user_id`,`job_id`),
  KEY `fk_app_job` (`job_id`),
  KEY `fk_app_cv` (`cv_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_app_user_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_app_job_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`job_id`) REFERENCES `job_postings_1nf` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_app_cv_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`cv_id`) REFERENCES `applicant_cvs_1nf` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: application_status_logs
-- Repeating group riwayat_1_*, riwayat_2_* dipecah
CREATE TABLE `application_status_logs_1nf` (
  `id`             BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `application_id` BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `changed_by`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `old_status`     ENUM('applied','reviewed','shortlisted','interview',
                        'offered','rejected','withdrawn') NOT NULL,
  `new_status`     ENUM('applied','reviewed','shortlisted','interview',
                        'offered','rejected','withdrawn') NOT NULL,
  `reason`         TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`     TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_asl_app` (`application_id`),
  KEY `fk_asl_by` (`changed_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asl_app_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`application_id`) REFERENCES `applications_1nf` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_asl_by_1nf`
    FOREIGN KEY (`changed_by`) REFERENCES `data_pengguna` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabel 1NF: interviews
-- MASIH BERMASALAH: nilai, rekomendasi harus dipisah ke tabel lain
CREATE TABLE `interviews_1nf` (
  `id`               BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `application_id`   BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `scheduled_by`     BIGINT(20) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  `scheduled_at`     DATETIME NOT NULL,
  `duration_minutes` INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
  `interview_type`   ENUM('online','offline','phone') NOT NULL,
  `location_or_link` VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status`           ENUM('scheduled','completed','cancelled','rescheduled')
                     NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
  `notes`            TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  -- MASIH BERMASALAH: hasil penilaian harus dipisah
  `nilai`            TINYINT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL,
  `feedback`         TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `rekomendasi`      ENUM('proceed','hold','reject') DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at`       TIMESTAMP NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_int_app` (`application_id`),
  KEY `fk_int_by` (`scheduled_by`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_int_app_1nf`

-- C. QUERY LANJUTAN
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. AGGREGATE FUNCTION
-- ============================================================

-- a) Menghitung total lamaran yang masuk
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lamaran
FROM applications_1nf;

-- b) Menghitung jumlah lowongan yang aktif
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lowongan_aktif
FROM job_postings_1nf
WHERE status = 'open';

-- c) Menghitung rata-rata, nilai tertinggi, dan nilai terendah wawancara
SELECT
  COUNT(*)             AS total_wawancara,
  ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS rata_nilai,
  MAX(score)           AS nilai_tertinggi,
  MIN(score)           AS nilai_terendah
FROM interview_results;

-- d) Menghitung jumlah pelamar per lowongan
SELECT
  jp.title            AS judul_lowongan,
  COUNT(a.id)         AS jumlah_pelamar
FROM job_postings_1nf jp
LEFT JOIN applications_1nf a ON jp.id = a.job_id
GROUP BY jp.id, jp.title
ORDER BY jumlah_pelamar DESC;

-- e) Menghitung jumlah skill per pelamar
SELECT
  dp.name        AS nama_pelamar,
  COUNT(s.id)    AS jumlah_skill
FROM data_pengguna dp
LEFT JOIN applicant_skills_1nf s ON dp.id = s.user_id
WHERE dp.role = 'applicant'
GROUP BY dp.id, dp.name
ORDER BY jumlah_skill DESC;

-- ============================================================
-- 2. SUBQUERY
-- ============================================================

-- a) Menampilkan pelamar yang melamar lebih dari 1 lowongan
SELECT name, email
FROM data_pengguna
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM applications_1nf
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- b) Menampilkan lowongan yang belum ada pelamarnya
SELECT title, status, deadline
FROM job_postings_1nf
WHERE id NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM applications_1nf
)
AND status = 'open';

-- c) Menampilkan kandidat yang nilai wawancaranya di atas rata-rata
SELECT
  dp.name     AS nama_kandidat,
  ir.score    AS nilai
FROM interview_results ir
INNER JOIN interviews_1nf i   ON ir.interview_id = i.id
INNER JOIN applications_1nf a ON i.application_id = a.id
INNER JOIN data_pengguna dp   ON a.user_id = dp.id
WHERE ir.score > (
  SELECT AVG(score) FROM interview_results
);

# M5-tugas1-stack.py
# Program untuk memeriksa pasangan kurung buka '(' dan kurung tutup ')'
# menggunakan struktur data Stack

# ===================== IMPLEMENTASI STACK =====================

stack = []  # Stack menggunakan list Python

def push(item):
    """Menambahkan elemen ke atas stack (PUSH)"""
    stack.append(item)

def pop():
    """Mengeluarkan elemen dari atas stack (POP)"""
    if not is_empty():
        return stack.pop()
    return None

def is_empty():
    """Memeriksa apakah stack kosong"""
    return len(stack) == 0

def reset_stack():
    """Mengosongkan stack sebelum proses baru"""
    stack.clear()

# ===================== FUNGSI UTAMA =====================

def periksa_kurung(ekspresi):
    """
    Memeriksa apakah kurung buka '(' dan kurung tutup ')'
    dalam ekspresi aritmetika saling berpasangan dengan benar.
    
    Algoritma:
    - Telusuri karakter satu per satu
    - Jika '(' -> PUSH ke stack
    - Jika ')' -> cek stack:
        * Jika stack ada isi  -> POP (pasangan ditemukan)
        * Jika stack kosong   -> SALAH (kurung tutup tanpa pasangan)
    - Setelah semua karakter ditelusuri:
        * Stack kosong -> BENAR
        * Stack masih ada isi -> SALAH (kurung buka tanpa pasangan)
    """
    reset_stack()  # Kosongkan stack sebelum mulai

    for karakter in ekspresi:
        if karakter == '(':
            push(karakter)          # Kurung buka -> PUSH

        elif karakter == ')':
            if is_empty():
                return "SALAH"      # Stack kosong, tidak ada pasangan
            else:
                pop()               # Pasangan ditemukan -> POP

    # Setelah semua karakter ditelusuri
    if is_empty():
        return "BENAR"              # Semua kurung sudah berpasangan
    else:
        return "SALAH"              # Masih ada kurung buka yang belum berpasangan

# ===================== PROGRAM UTAMA =====================

# M5-tugas2-stack.py
# Program untuk memeriksa pasangan kurung:
# '(' dengan ')', '[' dengan ']', '{' dengan '}'
# menggunakan struktur data Stack

# ===================== IMPLEMENTASI STACK =====================

stack = []  # Stack menggunakan list Python

def push(item):
    """Menambahkan elemen ke atas stack (PUSH)"""
    stack.append(item)

def pop():
    """Mengeluarkan elemen dari atas stack (POP)"""
    if not is_empty():
        return stack.pop()
    return None

def is_empty():
    """Memeriksa apakah stack kosong"""
    return len(stack) == 0

def reset_stack():
    """Mengosongkan stack sebelum proses baru"""
    stack.clear()

# ===================== FUNGSI UTAMA =====================

# Kamus pasangan kurung buka -> kurung tutup
KURUNG_BUKA  = {'(', '[', '{'}
KURUNG_TUTUP = {')', ']', '}'}

# Pasangan yang valid: kurung tutup -> kurung buka yang sesuai
PASANGAN = {
    ')': '(',
    ']': '[',
    '}': '{'
}

def periksa_kurung(ekspresi):
    """
    Memeriksa apakah semua kurung buka dan kurung tutup
    dalam ekspresi aritmetika saling berpasangan dengan benar.

    Jenis kurung yang diperiksa:
    - Kurung biasa : '(' dan ')'
    - Kurung kotak : '[' dan ']'
    - Kurung kurawal: '{' dan '}'

    Algoritma:
    - Telusuri karakter satu per satu
    - Jika kurung buka ('(', '[', '{') -> PUSH ke stack
    - Jika kurung tutup (')', ']', '}') -> cek stack:
        * Stack kosong         -> SALAH (tidak ada pasangan)
        * POP lalu cek apakah jenis kurungnya cocok:
            - Cocok   -> lanjut
            - Tidak cocok -> SALAH (jenis kurung berbeda)
    - Setelah semua karakter ditelusuri:
        * Stack kosong -> BENAR
        * Stack ada isi -> SALAH (kurung buka tanpa pasangan)
    """
    reset_stack()  # Kosongkan stack sebelum mulai

    for karakter in ekspresi:
        if karakter in KURUNG_BUKA:
            push(karakter)              # Kurung buka -> PUSH

        elif karakter in KURUNG_TUTUP:
            if is_empty():
                return "SALAH"          # Stack kosong, tidak ada pasangan

            buka = pop()                # Ambil kurung buka teratas

            # Periksa apakah jenis kurung cocok
            if buka != PASANGAN[karakter]:
                return "SALAH"          # Jenis kurung tidak cocok

    # Setelah semua karakter ditelusuri
    if is_empty():
        return "BENAR"                  # Semua kurung sudah berpasangan
    else:
        return "SALAH"                  # Masih ada kurung buka yang belum berpasangan

# ===================== PROGRAM UTAMA =====================

print("  PEMERIKSA PASANGAN KURUNG LENGKAP  ()  []  {}")
print("=" * 50)
