chat_messages.text:
The error is because the trigger is trying to UPDATE the pembelian table while it's being triggered by an INSERT on the pembelian table. MySQL doesn't allow this.

The fix is to use `NEW.bonus` instead of updating the pembelian table separately.

But wait - can we set NEW.bonus in an AFTER INSERT trigger? No, we can only use NEW in BEFORE triggers to modify values.

So the solution is to change the trigger to BEFORE INSERT, then we can set NEW.bonus directly.Ini error klasik! 😊 Masalahnya adalah trigger mencoba **UPDATE tabel pembelian** padahal trigger itu sendiri dipicu oleh INSERT ke tabel pembelian — jadi MySQL panik karena tabel yang sama dipakai dua kali sekaligus.

---

## Solusinya — Ganti AFTER jadi BEFORE

Dengan **BEFORE INSERT**, kita bisa langsung set nilai `NEW.bonus` sebelum data masuk, jadi tidak perlu UPDATE tabel pembelian lagi!

**Hapus trigger lama dulu:**
```sql
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS updateStok;
```

**Buat ulang dengan BEFORE INSERT:**
```sql
DELIMITER //
CREATE TRIGGER updateStok
BEFORE INSERT ON pembelian
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    DECLARE p_bonus INT DEFAULT 0;

    -- Hitung bonus
    IF NEW.jml_beli > 50 AND NEW.jml_beli < 100 THEN
        SET p_bonus = 5;
    ELSEIF NEW.jml_beli > 100 AND NEW.jml_beli < 150 THEN
        SET p_bonus = 10;
    ELSEIF NEW.jml_beli > 150 THEN
        SET p_bonus = 20;
    END IF;

    -- Langsung set bonus ke NEW (tidak perlu UPDATE lagi)
    SET NEW.bonus = p_bonus;

    -- Kurangi stok barang
    UPDATE barang SET stok = stok - NEW.jml_beli
    WHERE id_brg = NEW.id_brg;
END //
DELIMITER ;
```

**Test lagi:**
```sql
INSERT INTO pembelian (id_pem, id_brg, jml_beli) VALUES (1, 'A10', 65);

-- Cek pembelian (bonus harusnya 5)
SELECT * FROM pembelian;

-- Cek barang (stok A10 harusnya 100 - 65 = 35)
SELECT * FROM barang;
```

---

## Kenapa BEFORE bisa, AFTER tidak?

| | BEFORE | AFTER |
|---|---|---|
| Bisa set `NEW.kolom`? | ✅ Ya | ❌ Tidak |
| Data sudah masuk ke tabel? | ❌ Belum | ✅ Sudah |
| Bisa UPDATE tabel yang sama? | ❌ Tidak | ❌ Tidak |

> 💡 **Intinya:** `NEW.bonus = p_bonus` di BEFORE INSERT itu artinya kita **langsung mengisi nilai bonus sebelum data disimpan** — jadi tidak perlu UPDATE lagi dan tidak ada konflik! 😊

Coba jalankan dan kabari hasilnya!

The user wants me to help them complete the practical module 6 (Transaction Control Language) and explain it simply. Let me go through all the steps from the module.# Modul Praktikum 6 — Transaction Control Language 🏦

Sebelum mulai, pahami dulu konsepnya dengan analogi sederhana!

---

## 🧠 Konsep Dasar Transaction

> Bayangkan kamu transfer uang ke teman lewat ATM. Ada 2 proses:
> 1. Saldo kamu **berkurang**
> 2. Saldo teman **bertambah**
>
> Kalau proses 1 berhasil tapi proses 2 gagal (listrik mati, ATM crash) — uang kamu hilang tapi teman tidak terima. Ini masalah!
>
> **Solusinya = Transaction** — kalau salah satu gagal, **semua dibatalkan** seolah tidak pernah terjadi.

---

## 3 Perintah Utama Transaction

| Perintah | Fungsi | Analogi |
|---|---|---|
| `START TRANSACTION` | Mulai mencatat semua perubahan | Mulai nulis di kertas buram |
| `COMMIT` | Simpan semua perubahan secara permanen | Tanda tangan kontrak → resmi |
| `ROLLBACK` | Batalkan semua perubahan | Robek kertas buram → kembali ke awal |

---

## LANGKAH 1 — Buat Tabel `trans_demo`

```sql
CREATE TABLE trans_demo (
    nama VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (nama)
) ENGINE = INNODB;
```

> 💡 **Kenapa harus ENGINE = INNODB?**
> Transaction hanya bisa berjalan di engine InnoDB. Engine lain seperti MyISAM tidak mendukung transaction sama sekali.

Kalau sudah punya tabel lama dengan engine yang salah, ubah dengan:
```sql
ALTER TABLE trans_demo ENGINE = "InnoDB";
```

---

## LANGKAH 2 — COMMIT (Tanpa COMMIT dulu)

**Buat procedure `trans1` versi pertama — TANPA COMMIT:**

```sql
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE trans1()
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("MySQL"),("Oracle");
    SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
END //
DELIMITER ;
```

**Panggil:**
```sql
CALL trans1;
```

**Hasil saat CALL:** MySQL dan Oracle muncul ✅

**Tapi cek tabel langsung:**
```sql
SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
```

**Hasil:** Tabel **KOSONG** ❌

> 💡 **Kenapa kosong?**
> Karena tidak ada `COMMIT` — MySQL menganggap transaksi belum selesai dan otomatis membatalkannya (ROLLBACK implisit) saat procedure selesai. Ibarat nulis di kertas buram lalu kertasnya dibuang sendiri.

---

## LANGKAH 3 — COMMIT (Dengan COMMIT)

**Ubah procedure `trans1` — TAMBAH COMMIT:**

```sql
-- Hapus procedure lama dulu
DROP PROCEDURE trans1;

DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE trans1()
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("MySQL"),("Oracle");
    COMMIT;
    SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
END //
DELIMITER ;
```

**Panggil:**
```sql
CALL trans1;
```

**Cek tabel:**
```sql
SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
```

**Hasil:** MySQL dan Oracle **tersimpan permanen** ✅

> 💡 **Kenapa sekarang tersimpan?**
> Karena ada `COMMIT` — ibarat kamu tanda tangan kontrak, data resmi disimpan selamanya.

---

## LANGKAH 4 — Autocommit Mode

Selain `START TRANSACTION`, ada cara lain yaitu mematikan autocommit dengan `SET @@autocommit = 0`.

> 💡 **Autocommit itu apa?**
> Secara default MySQL langsung menyimpan setiap perintah secara otomatis (autocommit = 1). Kalau kita set autocommit = 0, MySQL akan menunggu perintah COMMIT dari kita sebelum menyimpan.

**Ubah procedure `trans1` lagi:**

```sql
DROP PROCEDURE trans1;

DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE trans1()
BEGIN
    SET @@autocommit = 0;
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("MongoDB");
    SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
END //
DELIMITER ;
```

**Panggil:**
```sql
CALL trans1;
```

**Cek tabel:**
```sql
SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
```

**Hasil:** MongoDB **tersimpan permanen** ✅

> 💡 `SET @@autocommit = 0` artinya kita matikan autocommit, lalu data langsung disimpan karena tidak ada ROLLBACK yang dipanggil.

---

## LANGKAH 5 — ROLLBACK

**Buat procedure baru bernama `roll`:**

```sql
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE roll()
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("PostgreSQL");
    ROLLBACK;
    SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
END //
DELIMITER ;
```

**Panggil:**
```sql
CALL roll;
```

**Hasil saat CALL:** PostgreSQL muncul sementara

**Cek tabel:**
```sql
SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
```

**Hasil:** PostgreSQL **TIDAK ADA** di tabel ❌

> 💡 **Kenapa tidak tersimpan?**
> Karena ada `ROLLBACK` — ibarat kamu sudah nulis di kertas buram, tapi kertas itu dirobek sebelum sempat disalin ke kontrak resmi.

---

## LANGKAH 6 — SAVEPOINT (Checkpointing)

Ini fitur paling menarik! SAVEPOINT ibarat **titik simpan di game** — kalau gagal, kamu tidak mulai dari awal, tapi dari titik simpan terakhir.

**Buat procedure `cekpoint`:**

```sql
DELIMITER //
CREATE PROCEDURE cekpoint()
BEGIN
    START TRANSACTION;

    -- Data 1: PostgreSQL masuk
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("PostgreSQL");
    SAVEPOINT point1;  -- Titik simpan dibuat disini

    -- Data 2: NoSQL masuk tapi dibatalkan sampai point1
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("NoSQL");
    ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT point1;  -- Kembali ke titik simpan, NoSQL dibatalkan

    -- Data 3: FireBird masuk dan di-COMMIT
    INSERT INTO trans_demo VALUES("FireBird");
    COMMIT;  -- PostgreSQL dan FireBird tersimpan permanen

    SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
END //
DELIMITER ;
```

**Panggil:**
```sql
CALL cekpoint;
```

**Cek tabel:**
```sql
SELECT * FROM trans_demo;
```

**Hasil akhir tabel:**

| nama |
|---|
| FireBird |
| MongoDB |
| MySQL |
| Oracle |
| PostgreSQL |

> **NoSQL tidak ada** karena di-ROLLBACK ke SAVEPOINT point1 sebelum NoSQL masuk.

---

## Ringkasan Alur SAVEPOINT

```
START TRANSACTION
    ↓
INSERT PostgreSQL ✅
    ↓
SAVEPOINT point1 ← titik simpan
    ↓
INSERT NoSQL
    ↓
ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT point1 ← mundur ke titik simpan (NoSQL hilang)
    ↓
INSERT FireBird ✅
    ↓
COMMIT ← PostgreSQL + FireBird tersimpan permanen
```

---

## Ringkasan Semua Konsep

| Konsep | Fungsi | Hasil |
|---|---|---|
| `START TRANSACTION` | Mulai transaksi | Data belum tersimpan |
| `COMMIT` | Simpan permanen | Data tersimpan ✅ |
| `ROLLBACK` | Batalkan semua | Data tidak tersimpan ❌ |
| `SAVEPOINT` | Buat titik simpan | Bisa rollback sebagian |
| `ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT` | Kembali ke titik tertentu | Hanya sebagian yang dibatalkan |
| `SET @@autocommit = 0` | Matikan simpan otomatis | Perlu COMMIT manual |

Semangat mengerjakan! 🎉

```
INSERT PostgreSQL ✅
    ↓
SAVEPOINT point1 ← titik simpan
    ↓
INSERT NoSQL
    ↓
ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT point1 ← mundur ke titik simpan (NoSQL hilang)
    ↓
INSERT FireBird ✅
    ↓
COMMIT ← PostgreSQL + FireBird tersimpan permanen
```

---

## Ringkasan Semua Konsep

| Konsep | Fungsi | Hasil |
|---|---|---|
| `START TRANSACTION` | Mulai transaksi | Data belum tersimpan |
| `COMMIT` | Simpan permanen | Data tersimpan ✅ |
| `ROLLBACK` | Batalkan semua | Data tidak tersimpan ❌ |
| `SAVEPOINT` | Buat titik simpan | Bisa rollback sebagian |
| `ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT` | Kembali ke titik tertentu | Hanya sebagian yang dibatalkan |
| `SET @@autocommit = 0` | Matikan simpan otomatis | Perlu COMMIT manual |

The user is asking about AJAX in JavaScript, based on the context from the document.## AJAX dalam JavaScript

**AJAX** = **Asynchronous JavaScript and XML**

Ini adalah teknik di JavaScript untuk **mengirim & menerima data dari server tanpa perlu me-reload halaman**.

---

## Analogi Sederhana

Bayangkan kamu di restoran:
- **Tanpa AJAX** → Setiap kamu memesan makanan, kamu harus **keluar dan masuk restoran lagi** (halaman reload)
- **Dengan AJAX** → Pelayan datang ke mejamu, ambil pesanan, lalu kembali bawa makanan — **kamu tetap duduk di tempat** (halaman tidak reload)

---

## Cara Kerja AJAX

```
Browser → (request data) → Server
Browser ← (terima data)  ← Server
         ↓
   Halaman diperbarui sebagian
   (tanpa full reload)
```

---

## Contoh Nyata di Aplikasi E-Recruitment

Misalnya pelamar mengklik tombol **"Lamar Sekarang"**:

```javascript
// Tanpa AJAX (cara lama) → halaman reload
<form action="/lamar" method="POST">...</form>

// Dengan AJAX → halaman TIDAK reload
fetch('/lamar', {
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({ job_id: 5 })
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(data => {
  // Tampilkan notifikasi "Lamaran berhasil dikirim!"
  // tanpa reload halaman
});
```

---

## Kenapa Klien Minta Pakai AJAX?

Sesuai jawaban wawancara no. 4, klien ingin **HTML tetap bersih** (tidak campur PHP). Dengan AJAX:

- HTML hanya mengurus **tampilan**
- JavaScript mengurus **pengiriman & penerimaan data**
- Laravel/Controller mengurus **logika & database**

Ini selaras dengan prinsip **MVC** yang tadi dibahas — setiap bagian punya tugasnya masing-masing.

8. `CountByGender()` – kombinasi IN + OUT
9. `DemoIF()` – percabangan IF/ELSE dalam stored procedure
10. `DemoLOOP()` – perulangan WHILE dalam stored procedure

**Part 2 – Trigger (5 bagian):**
1. Trigger `BEFORE INSERT` – inkremen stok otomatis
2. Trigger `AFTER INSERT` dengan keyword `NEW` – update stok saat pembelian
3. Trigger `AFTER DELETE` dengan keyword `OLD` – cascade delete ke tabel pembelian
4. Trigger `AFTER UPDATE` dengan `NEW` dan `OLD` – selisih update stok
5. Trigger kompleks dengan `IF NOT EXISTS` – audit data barang

1	---
     2	name: docx
     3	description: "Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation."
     4	license: Proprietary. LICENSE.txt has complete terms
     5	---
     6	
     7	# DOCX creation, editing, and analysis
     8	
     9	## Overview
    10	
    11	A .docx file is a ZIP archive containing XML files.
    12	
    13	## Quick Reference
    14	
    15	| Task | Approach |
    16	|------|----------|
    17	| Read/analyze content | `pandoc` or unpack for raw XML |
    18	| Create new document | Use `docx-js` - see Creating New Documents below |
    19	| Edit existing document | Unpack → edit XML → repack - see Editing Existing Documents below |
    20	
    21	### Converting .doc to .docx
    22	
    23	Legacy `.doc` files must be converted before editing:
    24	
    25	```bash
    26	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to docx document.doc
    27	```
    28	
    29	### Reading Content
    30	
    31	```bash
    32	# Text extraction with tracked changes
    33	pandoc --track-changes=all document.docx -o output.md
    34	
    35	# Raw XML access
    36	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
    37	```
    38	
    39	### Converting to Images
    40	
    41	```bash
    42	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to pdf document.docx
    43	pdftoppm -jpeg -r 150 document.pdf page
    44	```
    45	
    46	### Accepting Tracked Changes
    47	
    48	To produce a clean document with all tracked changes accepted (requires LibreOffice):
    49	
    50	```bash
    51	python scripts/accept_changes.py input.docx output.docx
    52	```
    53	
    54	---
    55	
    56	## Creating New Documents
    57	
    58	Generate .docx files with JavaScript, then validate. Install: `npm install -g docx`
    59	
    60	### Setup
    61	```javascript
    62	const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, ImageRun,
    63	        Header, Footer, AlignmentType, PageOrientation, LevelFormat, ExternalHyperlink,
    64	        InternalHyperlink, Bookmark, FootnoteReferenceRun, PositionalTab,
    65	        PositionalTabAlignment, PositionalTabRelativeTo, PositionalTabLeader,
    66	        TabStopType, TabStopPosition, Column, SectionType,
    67	        TableOfContents, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
    68	        VerticalAlign, PageNumber, PageBreak } = require('docx');
    69	
    70	const doc = new Document({ sections: [{ children: [/* content */] }] });
    71	Packer.toBuffer(doc).then(buffer => fs.writeFileSync("doc.docx", buffer));
    72	```
    73	
    74	### Validation
    75	After creating the file, validate it. If validation fails, unpack, fix the XML, and repack.
    76	```bash
    77	python scripts/office/validate.py doc.docx
    78	```
    79	
    80	### Page Size
    81	
    82	```javascript
    83	// CRITICAL: docx-js defaults to A4, not US Letter
    84	// Always set page size explicitly for consistent results
    85	sections: [{
    86	  properties: {
    87	    page: {
    88	      size: {
    89	        width: 12240,   // 8.5 inches in DXA
    90	        height: 15840   // 11 inches in DXA
    91	      },
    92	      margin: { top: 1440, right: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1440 } // 1 inch margins
    93	    }
    94	  },
    95	  children: [/* content */]
    96	}]
    97	```
    98	
    99	**Common page sizes (DXA units, 1440 DXA = 1 inch):**
   100	
   101	| Paper | Width | Height | Content Width (1" margins) |
   102	|-------|-------|--------|---------------------------|
   103	| US Letter | 12,240 | 15,840 | 9,360 |
   104	| A4 (default) | 11,906 | 16,838 | 9,026 |
   105	
   106	**Landscape orientation:** docx-js swaps width/height internally, so pass portrait dimensions and let it handle the swap:
   107	```javascript
   108	size: {
   109	  width: 12240,   // Pass SHORT edge as width
   110	  height: 15840,  // Pass LONG edge as height
   111	  orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE  // docx-js swaps them in the XML
   112	},
   113	// Content width = 15840 - left margin - right margin (uses the long edge)
   114	```
   115	
   116	### Styles (Override Built-in Headings)
   117	
   118	Use Arial as the default font (universally supported). Keep titles black for readability.
   119	
   120	```javascript
   121	const doc = new Document({
   122	  styles: {
   123	    default: { document: { run: { font: "Arial", size: 24 } } }, // 12pt default
   124	    paragraphStyles: [
   125	      // IMPORTANT: Use exact IDs to override built-in styles
   126	      { id: "Heading1", name: "Heading 1", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   127	        run: { size: 32, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   128	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 240, after: 240 }, outlineLevel: 0 } }, // outlineLevel required for TOC
   129	      { id: "Heading2", name: "Heading 2", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   130	        run: { size: 28, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   131	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 180, after: 180 }, outlineLevel: 1 } },
   132	    ]
   133	  },
   134	  sections: [{
   135	    children: [
   136	      new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, children: [new TextRun("Title")] }),
   137	    ]
   138	  }]
   139	});
   140	```
   141	
   142	### Lists (NEVER use unicode bullets)
   143	
   144	```javascript
   145	// ❌ WRONG - never manually insert bullet characters
   146	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("• Item")] })  // BAD
   147	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("\u2022 Item")] })  // BAD
   148	
   149	// ✅ CORRECT - use numbering config with LevelFormat.BULLET
   150	const doc = new Document({
   151	  numbering: {
   152	    config: [
   153	      { reference: "bullets",
   154	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.BULLET, text: "•", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   155	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   156	      { reference: "numbers",
   157	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.DECIMAL, text: "%1.", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   158	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   159	    ]
   160	  },
   161	  sections: [{
   162	    children: [
   163	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "bullets", level: 0 },
   164	        children: [new TextRun("Bullet item")] }),
   165	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "numbers", level: 0 },
   166	        children: [new TextRun("Numbered item")] }),
   167	    ]
   168	  }]
   169	});
   170	
   171	// ⚠️ Each reference creates INDEPENDENT numbering
   172	// Same reference = continues (1,2,3 then 4,5,6)
   173	// Different reference = restarts (1,2,3 then 1,2,3)
   174	```
   175	
   176	### Tables
   177	
   178	**CRITICAL: Tables need dual widths** - set both `columnWidths` on the table AND `width` on each cell. Without both, tables render incorrectly on some platforms.
   179	
   180	```javascript
   181	// CRITICAL: Always set table width for consistent rendering
   182	// CRITICAL: Use ShadingType.CLEAR (not SOLID) to prevent black backgrounds
   183	const border = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "CCCCCC" };
   184	const borders = { top: border, bottom: border, left: border, right: border };
   185	
   186	new Table({
   187	  width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Always use DXA (percentages break in Google Docs)
   188	  columnWidths: [4680, 4680], // Must sum to table width (DXA: 1440 = 1 inch)
   189	  rows: [
   190	    new TableRow({
   191	      children: [
   192	        new TableCell({
   193	          borders,
   194	          width: { size: 4680, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Also set on each cell
   195	          shading: { fill: "D5E8F0", type: ShadingType.CLEAR }, // CLEAR not SOLID
   196	          margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }, // Cell padding (internal, not added to width)
   197	          children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("Cell")] })]
   198	        })
   199	      ]
   200	    })
   201	  ]
   202	})
   203	```
   204	
   205	**Table width calculation:**
   206	
   207	Always use `WidthType.DXA` — `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` breaks in Google Docs.
   208	
   209	```javascript
   210	// Table width = sum of columnWidths = content width
   211	// US Letter with 1" margins: 12240 - 2880 = 9360 DXA
   212	width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA },
   213	columnWidths: [7000, 2360]  // Must sum to table width
   214	```
   215	
   216	**Width rules:**
	< truncated lines 217-374 >
   375	}]
   376	```
   377	
   378	### Critical Rules for docx-js
   379	
   380	- **Set page size explicitly** - docx-js defaults to A4; use US Letter (12240 x 15840 DXA) for US documents
   381	- **Landscape: pass portrait dimensions** - docx-js swaps width/height internally; pass short edge as `width`, long edge as `height`, and set `orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE`
   382	- **Never use `\n`** - use separate Paragraph elements
   383	- **Never use unicode bullets** - use `LevelFormat.BULLET` with numbering config
   384	- **PageBreak must be in Paragraph** - standalone creates invalid XML
   385	- **ImageRun requires `type`** - always specify png/jpg/etc
   386	- **Always set table `width` with DXA** - never use `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` (breaks in Google Docs)
   387	- **Tables need dual widths** - `columnWidths` array AND cell `width`, both must match
   388	- **Table width = sum of columnWidths** - for DXA, ensure they add up exactly
   389	- **Always add cell margins** - use `margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }` for readable padding
   390	- **Use `ShadingType.CLEAR`** - never SOLID for table shading
   391	- **Never use tables as dividers/rules** - cells have minimum height and render as empty boxes (including in headers/footers); use `border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "2E75B6", space: 1 } }` on a Paragraph instead. For two-column footers, use tab stops (see Tab Stops section), not tables
   392	- **TOC requires HeadingLevel only** - no custom styles on heading paragraphs
   393	- **Override built-in styles** - use exact IDs: "Heading1", "Heading2", etc.
   394	- **Include `outlineLevel`** - required for TOC (0 for H1, 1 for H2, etc.)
   395	
   396	---
   397	
   398	## Editing Existing Documents
   399	
   400	**Follow all 3 steps in order.**
   401	
   402	### Step 1: Unpack
   403	```bash
   404	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
   405	```
   406	Extracts XML, pretty-prints, merges adjacent runs, and converts smart quotes to XML entities (`“` etc.) so they survive editing. Use `--merge-runs false` to skip run merging.
   407	
   408	### Step 2: Edit XML
   409	
   410	Edit files in `unpacked/word/`. See XML Reference below for patterns.
   411	
   412	**Use "Claude" as the author** for tracked changes and comments, unless the user explicitly requests use of a different name.
   413	
   414	**Use the Edit tool directly for string replacement. Do not write Python scripts.** Scripts introduce unnecessary complexity. The Edit tool shows exactly what is being replaced.
   415	
   416	**CRITICAL: Use smart quotes for new content.** When adding text with apostrophes or quotes, use XML entities to produce smart quotes:
   417	```xml
   418	<!-- Use these entities for professional typography -->
   419	<w:t>Here’s a quote: “Hello”</w:t>
   420	```
   421	| Entity | Character |
   422	|--------|-----------|
   423	| `‘` | ‘ (left single) |
   424	| `’` | ’ (right single / apostrophe) |
   425	| `“` | “ (left double) |
   426	| `”` | ” (right double) |
   427	
   428	**Adding comments:** Use `comment.py` to handle boilerplate across multiple XML files (text must be pre-escaped XML):
   429	```bash
   430	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Comment text with & and ’"
   431	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 1 "Reply text" --parent 0  # reply to comment 0
   432	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Text" --author "Custom Author"  # custom author name
   433	```
   434	Then add markers to document.xml (see Comments in XML Reference).
   435	
   436	### Step 3: Pack
   437	```bash
   438	python scripts/office/pack.py unpacked/ output.docx --original document.docx
   439	```
   440	Validates with auto-repair, condenses XML, and creates DOCX. Use `--validate false` to skip.
   441	
   442	**Auto-repair will fix:**
   443	- `durableId` >= 0x7FFFFFFF (regenerates valid ID)
   444	- Missing `xml:space="preserve"` on `<w:t>` with whitespace
   445	
   446	**Auto-repair won't fix:**
   447	- Malformed XML, invalid element nesting, missing relationships, schema violations
   448	
   449	### Common Pitfalls
   450	
   451	- **Replace entire `<w:r>` elements**: When adding tracked changes, replace the whole `<w:r>...</w:r>` block with `<w:del>...<w:ins>...` as siblings. Don't inject tracked change tags inside a run.
   452	- **Preserve `<w:rPr>` formatting**: Copy the original run's `<w:rPr>` block into your tracked change runs to maintain bold, font size, etc.
   453	
   454	---
   455	
   456	## XML Reference
   457	
   458	### Schema Compliance
   459	
   460	- **Element order in `<w:pPr>`**: `<w:pStyle>`, `<w:numPr>`, `<w:spacing>`, `<w:ind>`, `<w:jc>`, `<w:rPr>` last
   461	- **Whitespace**: Add `xml:space="preserve"` to `<w:t>` with leading/trailing spaces
   462	- **RSIDs**: Must be 8-digit hex (e.g., `00AB1234`)
   463	
   464	### Tracked Changes
   465	
   466	**Insertion:**
   467	```xml
   468	<w:ins w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   469	  <w:r><w:t>inserted text</w:t></w:r>
   470	</w:ins>
   471	```
   472	
   473	**Deletion:**
   474	```xml
   475	<w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   476	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   477	</w:del>
   478	```
   479	
   480	**Inside `<w:del>`**: Use `<w:delText>` instead of `<w:t>`, and `<w:delInstrText>` instead of `<w:instrText>`.
   481	
   482	**Minimal edits** - only mark what changes:
   483	```xml
   484	<!-- Change "30 days" to "60 days" -->
   485	<w:r><w:t>The term is </w:t></w:r>
   486	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   487	  <w:r><w:delText>30</w:delText></w:r>
   488	</w:del>
   489	<w:ins w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   490	  <w:r><w:t>60</w:t></w:r>
   491	</w:ins>
   492	<w:r><w:t> days.</w:t></w:r>
   493	```
   494	
   495	**Deleting entire paragraphs/list items** - when removing ALL content from a paragraph, also mark the paragraph mark as deleted so it merges with the next paragraph. Add `<w:del/>` inside `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`:
   496	```xml
   497	<w:p>
   498	  <w:pPr>
   499	    <w:numPr>...</w:numPr>  <!-- list numbering if present -->
   500	    <w:rPr>
   501	      <w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"/>
   502	    </w:rPr>
   503	  </w:pPr>
   504	  <w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   505	    <w:r><w:delText>Entire paragraph content being deleted...</w:delText></w:r>
   506	  </w:del>
   507	</w:p>
   508	```
   509	Without the `<w:del/>` in `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`, accepting changes leaves an empty paragraph/list item.
   510	
   511	**Rejecting another author's insertion** - nest deletion inside their insertion:
   512	```xml
   513	<w:ins w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   514	  <w:del w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   515	    <w:r><w:delText>their inserted text</w:delText></w:r>
   516	  </w:del>
   517	</w:ins>
   518	```
   519	
   520	**Restoring another author's deletion** - add insertion after (don't modify their deletion):
   521	```xml
   522	<w:del w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   523	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   524	</w:del>
   525	<w:ins w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   526	  <w:r><w:t>deleted text</w:t></w:r>
   527	</w:ins>
   528	```
   529	
   530	### Comments
   531	
   532	After running `comment.py` (see Step 2), add markers to document.xml. For replies, use `--parent` flag and nest markers inside the parent's.
   533	
   534	**CRITICAL: `<w:commentRangeStart>` and `<w:commentRangeEnd>` are siblings of `<w:r>`, never inside `<w:r>`.**
   535	
   536	```xml
   537	<!-- Comment markers are direct children of w:p, never inside w:r -->
   538	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   539	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   540	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted</w:delText></w:r>
   541	</w:del>
   542	<w:r><w:t> more text</w:t></w:r>
   543	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   544	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   545	
   546	<!-- Comment 0 with reply 1 nested inside -->
   547	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   548	  <w:commentRangeStart w:id="1"/>
   549	  <w:r><w:t>text</w:t></w:r>
   550	  <w:commentRangeEnd w:id="1"/>
   551	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   552	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   553	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="1"/></w:r>
   554	```
   555	
   556	### Images
   557	
   558	1. Add image file to `word/media/`
   559	2. Add relationship to `word/_rels/document.xml.rels`:
   560	```xml
   561	<Relationship Id="rId5" Type=".../image" Target="media/image1.png"/>
   562	```
   563	3. Add content type to `[Content_Types].xml`:
   564	```xml
   565	<Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/>
   566	```
   567	4. Reference in document.xml:
   568	```xml
   569	<w:drawing>
   570	  <wp:inline>
   571	    <wp:extent cx="914400" cy="914400"/>  <!-- EMUs: 914400 = 1 inch -->
   572	    <a:graphic>
   573	      <a:graphicData uri=".../picture">
   574	        <pic:pic>
   575	          <pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId5"/></pic:blipFill>
   576	        </pic:pic>
   577	      </a:graphicData>
   578	    </a:graphic>
   579	  </wp:inline>
   580	</w:drawing>
   581	```
   582	
   583	---
   584	
   585	## Dependencies
   586	
   587	- **pandoc**: Text extraction
   588	- **docx**: `npm install -g docx` (new documents)
   589	- **LibreOffice**: PDF conversion (auto-configured for sandboxed environments via `scripts/office/soffice.py`)
   590	- **Poppler**: `pdftoppm` for images
   591

const {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  AlignmentType, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
  LevelFormat, PageNumber, NumberFormat
} = require('docx');
const fs = require('fs');

const border = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "AAAAAA" };
const borders = { top: border, bottom: border, left: border, right: border };

const headerBorder = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "2E74B5" };
const headerBorders = { top: headerBorder, bottom: headerBorder, left: headerBorder, right: headerBorder };

function heading1(text) {
  return new Paragraph({
    heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1,
    children: [new TextRun({ text, bold: true, size: 30, color: "1F3864" })],
    spacing: { before: 320, after: 160 },
    border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "2E74B5", space: 1 } }
  });
}

function heading2(text) {
  return new Paragraph({
    heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2,
    children: [new TextRun({ text, bold: true, size: 26, color: "2E74B5" })],
    spacing: { before: 240, after: 120 }
  });
}

function heading3(text) {
  return new Paragraph({
    children: [new TextRun({ text, bold: true, size: 24, color: "2E74B5", underline: {} })],
    spacing: { before: 200, after: 80 }
  });
}

function normalText(text) {
  return new Paragraph({
    children: [new TextRun({ text, size: 22 })],
    spacing: { before: 60, after: 60 }
  });
}

function codeBlock(lines) {
  const rows = lines.map(line =>
    new TableRow({
      children: [new TableCell({
        borders,
        width: { size: 9026, type: WidthType.DXA },
        shading: { fill: "1E1E2E", type: ShadingType.CLEAR },
        margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 160, right: 160 },
        children: [new Paragraph({
          children: [new TextRun({ text: line, font: "Courier New", size: 19, color: "A8FF78" })],
          spacing: { before: 20, after: 20 }
        })]
      })]

1	---
     2	name: docx
     3	description: "Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation."
     4	license: Proprietary. LICENSE.txt has complete terms
     5	---
     6	
     7	# DOCX creation, editing, and analysis
     8	
     9	## Overview
    10	
    11	A .docx file is a ZIP archive containing XML files.
    12	
    13	## Quick Reference
    14	
    15	| Task | Approach |
    16	|------|----------|
    17	| Read/analyze content | `pandoc` or unpack for raw XML |
    18	| Create new document | Use `docx-js` - see Creating New Documents below |
    19	| Edit existing document | Unpack → edit XML → repack - see Editing Existing Documents below |
    20	
    21	### Converting .doc to .docx
    22	
    23	Legacy `.doc` files must be converted before editing:
    24	
    25	```bash
    26	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to docx document.doc
    27	```
    28	
    29	### Reading Content
    30	
    31	```bash
    32	# Text extraction with tracked changes
    33	pandoc --track-changes=all document.docx -o output.md
    34	
    35	# Raw XML access
    36	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
    37	```
    38	
    39	### Converting to Images
    40	
    41	```bash
    42	python scripts/office/soffice.py --headless --convert-to pdf document.docx
    43	pdftoppm -jpeg -r 150 document.pdf page
    44	```
    45	
    46	### Accepting Tracked Changes
    47	
    48	To produce a clean document with all tracked changes accepted (requires LibreOffice):
    49	
    50	```bash
    51	python scripts/accept_changes.py input.docx output.docx
    52	```
    53	
    54	---
    55	
    56	## Creating New Documents
    57	
    58	Generate .docx files with JavaScript, then validate. Install: `npm install -g docx`
    59	
    60	### Setup
    61	```javascript
    62	const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell, ImageRun,
    63	        Header, Footer, AlignmentType, PageOrientation, LevelFormat, ExternalHyperlink,
    64	        InternalHyperlink, Bookmark, FootnoteReferenceRun, PositionalTab,
    65	        PositionalTabAlignment, PositionalTabRelativeTo, PositionalTabLeader,
    66	        TabStopType, TabStopPosition, Column, SectionType,
    67	        TableOfContents, HeadingLevel, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType,
    68	        VerticalAlign, PageNumber, PageBreak } = require('docx');
    69	
    70	const doc = new Document({ sections: [{ children: [/* content */] }] });
    71	Packer.toBuffer(doc).then(buffer => fs.writeFileSync("doc.docx", buffer));
    72	```
    73	
    74	### Validation
    75	After creating the file, validate it. If validation fails, unpack, fix the XML, and repack.
    76	```bash
    77	python scripts/office/validate.py doc.docx
    78	```
    79	
    80	### Page Size
    81	
    82	```javascript
    83	// CRITICAL: docx-js defaults to A4, not US Letter
    84	// Always set page size explicitly for consistent results
    85	sections: [{
    86	  properties: {
    87	    page: {
    88	      size: {
    89	        width: 12240,   // 8.5 inches in DXA
    90	        height: 15840   // 11 inches in DXA
    91	      },
    92	      margin: { top: 1440, right: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1440 } // 1 inch margins
    93	    }
    94	  },
    95	  children: [/* content */]
    96	}]
    97	```
    98	
    99	**Common page sizes (DXA units, 1440 DXA = 1 inch):**
   100	
   101	| Paper | Width | Height | Content Width (1" margins) |
   102	|-------|-------|--------|---------------------------|
   103	| US Letter | 12,240 | 15,840 | 9,360 |
   104	| A4 (default) | 11,906 | 16,838 | 9,026 |
   105	
   106	**Landscape orientation:** docx-js swaps width/height internally, so pass portrait dimensions and let it handle the swap:
   107	```javascript
   108	size: {
   109	  width: 12240,   // Pass SHORT edge as width
   110	  height: 15840,  // Pass LONG edge as height
   111	  orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE  // docx-js swaps them in the XML
   112	},
   113	// Content width = 15840 - left margin - right margin (uses the long edge)
   114	```
   115	
   116	### Styles (Override Built-in Headings)
   117	
   118	Use Arial as the default font (universally supported). Keep titles black for readability.
   119	
   120	```javascript
   121	const doc = new Document({
   122	  styles: {
   123	    default: { document: { run: { font: "Arial", size: 24 } } }, // 12pt default
   124	    paragraphStyles: [
   125	      // IMPORTANT: Use exact IDs to override built-in styles
   126	      { id: "Heading1", name: "Heading 1", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   127	        run: { size: 32, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   128	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 240, after: 240 }, outlineLevel: 0 } }, // outlineLevel required for TOC
   129	      { id: "Heading2", name: "Heading 2", basedOn: "Normal", next: "Normal", quickFormat: true,
   130	        run: { size: 28, bold: true, font: "Arial" },
   131	        paragraph: { spacing: { before: 180, after: 180 }, outlineLevel: 1 } },
   132	    ]
   133	  },
   134	  sections: [{
   135	    children: [
   136	      new Paragraph({ heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, children: [new TextRun("Title")] }),
   137	    ]
   138	  }]
   139	});
   140	```
   141	
   142	### Lists (NEVER use unicode bullets)
   143	
   144	```javascript
   145	// ❌ WRONG - never manually insert bullet characters
   146	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("• Item")] })  // BAD
   147	new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("\u2022 Item")] })  // BAD
   148	
   149	// ✅ CORRECT - use numbering config with LevelFormat.BULLET
   150	const doc = new Document({
   151	  numbering: {
   152	    config: [
   153	      { reference: "bullets",
   154	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.BULLET, text: "•", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   155	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   156	      { reference: "numbers",
   157	        levels: [{ level: 0, format: LevelFormat.DECIMAL, text: "%1.", alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
   158	          style: { paragraph: { indent: { left: 720, hanging: 360 } } } }] },
   159	    ]
   160	  },
   161	  sections: [{
   162	    children: [
   163	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "bullets", level: 0 },
   164	        children: [new TextRun("Bullet item")] }),
   165	      new Paragraph({ numbering: { reference: "numbers", level: 0 },
   166	        children: [new TextRun("Numbered item")] }),
   167	    ]
   168	  }]
   169	});
   170	
   171	// ⚠️ Each reference creates INDEPENDENT numbering
   172	// Same reference = continues (1,2,3 then 4,5,6)
   173	// Different reference = restarts (1,2,3 then 1,2,3)
   174	```
   175	
   176	### Tables
   177	
   178	**CRITICAL: Tables need dual widths** - set both `columnWidths` on the table AND `width` on each cell. Without both, tables render incorrectly on some platforms.
   179	
   180	```javascript
   181	// CRITICAL: Always set table width for consistent rendering
   182	// CRITICAL: Use ShadingType.CLEAR (not SOLID) to prevent black backgrounds
   183	const border = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "CCCCCC" };
   184	const borders = { top: border, bottom: border, left: border, right: border };
   185	
   186	new Table({
   187	  width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Always use DXA (percentages break in Google Docs)
   188	  columnWidths: [4680, 4680], // Must sum to table width (DXA: 1440 = 1 inch)
   189	  rows: [
   190	    new TableRow({
   191	      children: [
   192	        new TableCell({
   193	          borders,
   194	          width: { size: 4680, type: WidthType.DXA }, // Also set on each cell
   195	          shading: { fill: "D5E8F0", type: ShadingType.CLEAR }, // CLEAR not SOLID
   196	          margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }, // Cell padding (internal, not added to width)
   197	          children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("Cell")] })]
   198	        })
   199	      ]
   200	    })
   201	  ]
   202	})
   203	```
   204	
   205	**Table width calculation:**
   206	
   207	Always use `WidthType.DXA` — `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` breaks in Google Docs.
   208	
   209	```javascript
   210	// Table width = sum of columnWidths = content width
   211	// US Letter with 1" margins: 12240 - 2880 = 9360 DXA
   212	width: { size: 9360, type: WidthType.DXA },
   213	columnWidths: [7000, 2360]  // Must sum to table width
   214	```
   215	
   216	**Width rules:**
	< truncated lines 217-374 >
   375	}]
   376	```
   377	
   378	### Critical Rules for docx-js
   379	
   380	- **Set page size explicitly** - docx-js defaults to A4; use US Letter (12240 x 15840 DXA) for US documents
   381	- **Landscape: pass portrait dimensions** - docx-js swaps width/height internally; pass short edge as `width`, long edge as `height`, and set `orientation: PageOrientation.LANDSCAPE`
   382	- **Never use `\n`** - use separate Paragraph elements
   383	- **Never use unicode bullets** - use `LevelFormat.BULLET` with numbering config
   384	- **PageBreak must be in Paragraph** - standalone creates invalid XML
   385	- **ImageRun requires `type`** - always specify png/jpg/etc
   386	- **Always set table `width` with DXA** - never use `WidthType.PERCENTAGE` (breaks in Google Docs)
   387	- **Tables need dual widths** - `columnWidths` array AND cell `width`, both must match
   388	- **Table width = sum of columnWidths** - for DXA, ensure they add up exactly
   389	- **Always add cell margins** - use `margins: { top: 80, bottom: 80, left: 120, right: 120 }` for readable padding
   390	- **Use `ShadingType.CLEAR`** - never SOLID for table shading
   391	- **Never use tables as dividers/rules** - cells have minimum height and render as empty boxes (including in headers/footers); use `border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: "2E75B6", space: 1 } }` on a Paragraph instead. For two-column footers, use tab stops (see Tab Stops section), not tables
   392	- **TOC requires HeadingLevel only** - no custom styles on heading paragraphs
   393	- **Override built-in styles** - use exact IDs: "Heading1", "Heading2", etc.
   394	- **Include `outlineLevel`** - required for TOC (0 for H1, 1 for H2, etc.)
   395	
   396	---
   397	
   398	## Editing Existing Documents
   399	
   400	**Follow all 3 steps in order.**
   401	
   402	### Step 1: Unpack
   403	```bash
   404	python scripts/office/unpack.py document.docx unpacked/
   405	```
   406	Extracts XML, pretty-prints, merges adjacent runs, and converts smart quotes to XML entities (`“` etc.) so they survive editing. Use `--merge-runs false` to skip run merging.
   407	
   408	### Step 2: Edit XML
   409	
   410	Edit files in `unpacked/word/`. See XML Reference below for patterns.
   411	
   412	**Use "Claude" as the author** for tracked changes and comments, unless the user explicitly requests use of a different name.
   413	
   414	**Use the Edit tool directly for string replacement. Do not write Python scripts.** Scripts introduce unnecessary complexity. The Edit tool shows exactly what is being replaced.
   415	
   416	**CRITICAL: Use smart quotes for new content.** When adding text with apostrophes or quotes, use XML entities to produce smart quotes:
   417	```xml
   418	<!-- Use these entities for professional typography -->
   419	<w:t>Here’s a quote: “Hello”</w:t>
   420	```
   421	| Entity | Character |
   422	|--------|-----------|
   423	| `‘` | ‘ (left single) |
   424	| `’` | ’ (right single / apostrophe) |
   425	| `“` | “ (left double) |
   426	| `”` | ” (right double) |
   427	
   428	**Adding comments:** Use `comment.py` to handle boilerplate across multiple XML files (text must be pre-escaped XML):
   429	```bash
   430	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Comment text with & and ’"
   431	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 1 "Reply text" --parent 0  # reply to comment 0
   432	python scripts/comment.py unpacked/ 0 "Text" --author "Custom Author"  # custom author name
   433	```
   434	Then add markers to document.xml (see Comments in XML Reference).
   435	
   436	### Step 3: Pack
   437	```bash
   438	python scripts/office/pack.py unpacked/ output.docx --original document.docx
   439	```
   440	Validates with auto-repair, condenses XML, and creates DOCX. Use `--validate false` to skip.
   441	
   442	**Auto-repair will fix:**
   443	- `durableId` >= 0x7FFFFFFF (regenerates valid ID)
   444	- Missing `xml:space="preserve"` on `<w:t>` with whitespace
   445	
   446	**Auto-repair won't fix:**
   447	- Malformed XML, invalid element nesting, missing relationships, schema violations
   448	
   449	### Common Pitfalls
   450	
   451	- **Replace entire `<w:r>` elements**: When adding tracked changes, replace the whole `<w:r>...</w:r>` block with `<w:del>...<w:ins>...` as siblings. Don't inject tracked change tags inside a run.
   452	- **Preserve `<w:rPr>` formatting**: Copy the original run's `<w:rPr>` block into your tracked change runs to maintain bold, font size, etc.
   453	
   454	---
   455	
   456	## XML Reference
   457	
   458	### Schema Compliance
   459	
   460	- **Element order in `<w:pPr>`**: `<w:pStyle>`, `<w:numPr>`, `<w:spacing>`, `<w:ind>`, `<w:jc>`, `<w:rPr>` last
   461	- **Whitespace**: Add `xml:space="preserve"` to `<w:t>` with leading/trailing spaces
   462	- **RSIDs**: Must be 8-digit hex (e.g., `00AB1234`)
   463	
   464	### Tracked Changes
   465	
   466	**Insertion:**
   467	```xml
   468	<w:ins w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   469	  <w:r><w:t>inserted text</w:t></w:r>
   470	</w:ins>
   471	```
   472	
   473	**Deletion:**
   474	```xml
   475	<w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   476	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   477	</w:del>
   478	```
   479	
   480	**Inside `<w:del>`**: Use `<w:delText>` instead of `<w:t>`, and `<w:delInstrText>` instead of `<w:instrText>`.
   481	
   482	**Minimal edits** - only mark what changes:
   483	```xml
   484	<!-- Change "30 days" to "60 days" -->
   485	<w:r><w:t>The term is </w:t></w:r>
   486	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   487	  <w:r><w:delText>30</w:delText></w:r>
   488	</w:del>
   489	<w:ins w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="...">
   490	  <w:r><w:t>60</w:t></w:r>
   491	</w:ins>
   492	<w:r><w:t> days.</w:t></w:r>
   493	```
   494	
   495	**Deleting entire paragraphs/list items** - when removing ALL content from a paragraph, also mark the paragraph mark as deleted so it merges with the next paragraph. Add `<w:del/>` inside `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`:
   496	```xml
   497	<w:p>
   498	  <w:pPr>
   499	    <w:numPr>...</w:numPr>  <!-- list numbering if present -->
   500	    <w:rPr>
   501	      <w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"/>
   502	    </w:rPr>
   503	  </w:pPr>
   504	  <w:del w:id="2" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   505	    <w:r><w:delText>Entire paragraph content being deleted...</w:delText></w:r>
   506	  </w:del>
   507	</w:p>
   508	```
   509	Without the `<w:del/>` in `<w:pPr><w:rPr>`, accepting changes leaves an empty paragraph/list item.
   510	
   511	**Rejecting another author's insertion** - nest deletion inside their insertion:
   512	```xml
   513	<w:ins w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   514	  <w:del w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   515	    <w:r><w:delText>their inserted text</w:delText></w:r>
   516	  </w:del>
   517	</w:ins>
   518	```
   519	
   520	**Restoring another author's deletion** - add insertion after (don't modify their deletion):
   521	```xml
   522	<w:del w:author="Jane" w:id="5">
   523	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted text</w:delText></w:r>
   524	</w:del>
   525	<w:ins w:author="Claude" w:id="10">
   526	  <w:r><w:t>deleted text</w:t></w:r>
   527	</w:ins>
   528	```
   529	
   530	### Comments
   531	
   532	After running `comment.py` (see Step 2), add markers to document.xml. For replies, use `--parent` flag and nest markers inside the parent's.
   533	
   534	**CRITICAL: `<w:commentRangeStart>` and `<w:commentRangeEnd>` are siblings of `<w:r>`, never inside `<w:r>`.**
   535	
   536	```xml
   537	<!-- Comment markers are direct children of w:p, never inside w:r -->
   538	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   539	<w:del w:id="1" w:author="Claude" w:date="2025-01-01T00:00:00Z">
   540	  <w:r><w:delText>deleted</w:delText></w:r>
   541	</w:del>
   542	<w:r><w:t> more text</w:t></w:r>
   543	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   544	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   545	
   546	<!-- Comment 0 with reply 1 nested inside -->
   547	<w:commentRangeStart w:id="0"/>
   548	  <w:commentRangeStart w:id="1"/>
   549	  <w:r><w:t>text</w:t></w:r>
   550	  <w:commentRangeEnd w:id="1"/>
   551	<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="0"/>
   552	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>
   553	<w:r><w:rPr><w:rStyle w:val="CommentReference"/></w:rPr><w:commentReference w:id="1"/></w:r>
   554	```
   555	
   556	### Images
   557	
   558	1. Add image file to `word/media/`
   559	2. Add relationship to `word/_rels/document.xml.rels`:
   560	```xml
   561	<Relationship Id="rId5" Type=".../image" Target="media/image1.png"/>
   562	```
   563	3. Add content type to `[Content_Types].xml`:
   564	```xml
   565	<Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/>
   566	```
   567	4. Reference in document.xml:
   568	```xml
   569	<w:drawing>
   570	  <wp:inline>
   571	    <wp:extent cx="914400" cy="914400"/>  <!-- EMUs: 914400 = 1 inch -->
   572	    <a:graphic>
   573	      <a:graphicData uri=".../picture">
   574	        <pic:pic>
   575	          <pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId5"/></pic:blipFill>
   576	        </pic:pic>
   577	      </a:graphicData>
   578	    </a:graphic>
   579	  </wp:inline>
   580	</w:drawing>
   581	```
   582	
   583	---
   584	
   585	## Dependencies
   586	
   587	- **pandoc**: Text extraction
   588	- **docx**: `npm install -g docx` (new documents)
   589	- **LibreOffice**: PDF conversion (auto-configured for sandboxed environments via `scripts/office/soffice.py`)
   590	- **Poppler**: `pdftoppm` for images

## ✅ Rekap 11 Sequence Diagram E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals

| Elemen | Simbol PlantUML | Warna |
|---|---|---|

| Kode | Fitur | Aktor |
|---|---|---|
| **F001** | Melihat profil perusahaan | Pelamar |
| **F002** | Lihat daftar & detail lowongan (2 skenario) | Pelamar |
| **F003** | Registrasi akun (validasi email duplikat) | Pelamar |
| **F004** | Login pelamar (cek salah password) | Pelamar |
| **F005** | Kelola profil + upload CV (validasi file) | Pelamar |
| **F006** | Melamar pekerjaan (cek sudah melamar & CV) | Pelamar |
| **F007** | Lihat status lamaran + riwayat | Pelamar |
| **F008** | Login admin HR (catat log login) | HR/Admin |
| **F009** | Tambah, edit, nonaktifkan lowongan | HR/Admin |
| **F010** | Lihat daftar pelamar, download CV, keputusan | HR/Admin |
| **F011** | Ubah status + kirim notifikasi ke pelamar | HR/Admin + Pelamar |

STROKE = {'actor':'#1B5E20','actor_admin':'#4A148C','boundary':'#0D47A1',
          'control':'#E65100','model':'#BF360C','database':'#B71C1C','service':'#00695C'}

_cid = 2

def reset_cid(): global _cid; _cid = 2

def cid():
    global _cid
    v = _cid; _cid += 1; return str(v)

def xe(s):
    return str(s).replace('&','&').replace('<','<').replace('>','>').replace('"','"')

def pstyle(t):
    f, s = FILL[t], STROKE[t]
    base = f'fillColor={f};strokeColor={s};fontColor={s};fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;'
    if t in ('actor','actor_admin'): return 'shape=mxgraph.uml.actor;' + base
    if t == 'database':              return 'shape=mxgraph.uml.database;' + base
    if t == 'control':               return 'ellipse;' + base
    return 'rounded=1;' + base

def ll_style(t):
    return f'endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor={STROKE[t]};strokeWidth=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;'

# ── XML generator ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def make_diagram(d):
    reset_cid()
    parts = d['participants']
    msgs  = d['messages']
    n     = len(parts)

    x_centers = [START_X + i * GAP for i in range(n)]

    # calc total height needed
    total_y = MSG_Y0
    for m in msgs:
        total_y += SEP_DY if m[0] == 'sep' else MSG_DY
    ll_bot = total_y + LL_EXTRA

    cells = ['<mxCell id="0"/>', '<mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>']

    # Title
    tw = (n-1)*GAP + P_W
    tx = START_X - P_W//2
    cells.append(
        f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(d["name"])}" '
        f'style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;'
        f'verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" '
        f'vertex="1" parent="1">'
        f'<mxGeometry x="{tx}" y="0" width="{tw}" height="20" as="geometry"/></mxCell>'
    )

    # Participants + lifelines
    for i,(pname,ptype) in enumerate(parts):
        xc = x_centers[i]
        is_actor = ptype in ('actor','actor_admin')
        pw, ph = (A_W, A_H) if is_actor else (P_W, P_H)
        py = 20
        cells.append(
            f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(pname)}" '
            f'style="{pstyle(ptype)}" vertex="1" parent="1">'
            f'<mxGeometry x="{xc-pw//2}" y="{py}" width="{pw}" height="{ph}" as="geometry"/></mxCell>'
        )
        ll_top = py + ph
        cells.append(
            f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="" '
            f'style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor={STROKE[ptype]};strokeWidth=1;" '
            f'edge="1" parent="1">'
            f'<mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry">'
            f'<mxPoint x="{xc}" y="{ll_top}" as="sourcePoint"/>'
            f'<mxPoint x="{xc}" y="{ll_bot}" as="targetPoint"/>'
            f'</mxGeometry></mxCell>'
        )

    # Messages
    cur_y = MSG_Y0
    for m in msgs:
        if m[0] == 'sep':
            label = m[1]
            sw = (n-1)*GAP + P_W
            sx = START_X - P_W//2
            cells.append(
                f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="== {xe(label)} ==" '
                f'style="text;html=1;strokeColor=#AAAAAA;fillColor=#F5F5F5;align=center;'
                f'verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontStyle=2;fontSize=9;fontColor=#555555;rounded=1;" '
                f'vertex="1" parent="1">'

        elif mtype == 'sync':

# ── XML generator ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def make_diagram(d):
    reset_cid()
    parts = d['participants']
    msgs  = d['messages']
    n     = len(parts)

    x_centers = [START_X + i * GAP for i in range(n)]

    # calc total height needed
    total_y = MSG_Y0
    for m in msgs:
        total_y += SEP_DY if m[0] == 'sep' else MSG_DY
    ll_bot = total_y + LL_EXTRA

    cells = ['<mxCell id="0"/>', '<mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>']

    # Title
    tw = (n-1)*GAP + P_W
    tx = START_X - P_W//2
    cells.append(
        f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(d["name"])}" '
        f'style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;'
        f'verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" '
        f'vertex="1" parent="1">'
        f'<mxGeometry x="{tx}" y="0" width="{tw}" height="20" as="geometry"/></mxCell>'
    )

    # Participants + lifelines
    for i,(pname,ptype) in enumerate(parts):
        xc = x_centers[i]
        is_actor = ptype in ('actor','actor_admin')
        pw, ph = (A_W, A_H) if is_actor else (P_W, P_H)
        py = 20
        cells.append(
            f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(pname)}" '
            f'style="{pstyle(ptype)}" vertex="1" parent="1">'
            f'<mxGeometry x="{xc-pw//2}" y="{py}" width="{pw}" height="{ph}" as="geometry"/></mxCell>'
        )
        ll_top = py + ph
        cells.append(
            f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="" '
            f'style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor={STROKE[ptype]};strokeWidth=1;" '
            f'edge="1" parent="1">'
            f'<mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry">'
            f'<mxPoint x="{xc}" y="{ll_top}" as="sourcePoint"/>'
            f'<mxPoint x="{xc}" y="{ll_bot}" as="targetPoint"/>'
            f'</mxGeometry></mxCell>'
        )

    # Messages
    cur_y = MSG_Y0
    for m in msgs:
        if m[0] == 'sep':
            label = m[1]
            sw = (n-1)*GAP + P_W
            sx = START_X - P_W//2
            cells.append(
                f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="== {xe(label)} ==" '
                f'style="text;html=1;strokeColor=#AAAAAA;fillColor=#F5F5F5;align=center;'
                f'verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontStyle=2;fontSize=9;fontColor=#555555;rounded=1;" '
                f'vertex="1" parent="1">'
                f'<mxGeometry x="{sx}" y="{cur_y-10}" width="{sw}" height="20" as="geometry"/></mxCell>'
            )
            cur_y += SEP_DY
            continue

        fi, ti, label, mtype = m
        xf = x_centers[fi]
        xt = x_centers[ti]
        y  = cur_y

        if mtype == 'self':
            lw = 55
            lh = 30
            cells.append(
                f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(label)}" '
                f'style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;html=1;strokeColor=#333333;'
                f'fillColor=#333333;fontSize=9;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;entryX=1;entryY=0.5;" '
                f'edge="1" parent="1">'
                f'<mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry">'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xf}" y="{y}" as="sourcePoint"/>'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xf}" y="{y+lh}" as="targetPoint"/>'
                f'<Array as="points">'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xf+lw}" y="{y}"/>'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xf+lw}" y="{y+lh}"/>'
                f'</Array>'
                f'</mxGeometry></mxCell>'
            )
            cur_y += MSG_DY
        elif mtype == 'sync':
            cells.append(
                f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(label)}" '
                f'style="endArrow=block;endFill=1;html=1;strokeColor=#1a1a1a;'
                f'fillColor=#1a1a1a;fontSize=9;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;" '
                f'edge="1" parent="1">'
                f'<mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry">'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xf}" y="{y}" as="sourcePoint"/>'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xt}" y="{y}" as="targetPoint"/>'
                f'</mxGeometry></mxCell>'
            )
            cur_y += MSG_DY
        elif mtype == 'return':
            cells.append(
                f'<mxCell id="{cid()}" value="{xe(label)}" '
                f'style="endArrow=open;endFill=0;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;'
                f'fontSize=9;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;" '
                f'edge="1" parent="1">'
                f'<mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry">'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xf}" y="{y}" as="sourcePoint"/>'
                f'<mxPoint x="{xt}" y="{y}" as="targetPoint"/>'
                f'</mxGeometry></mxCell>'
            )
            cur_y += MSG_DY

    cells_xml = '\n      '.join(cells)
    return (
        f'<diagram name="{xe(d["name"])}">'
        f'<mxGraphModel dx="1422" dy="762" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" '
        f'tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" '
        f'pageWidth="1654" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0">'
        f'<root>\n      {cells_xml}\n    </root>'
        f'</mxGraphModel></diagram>'
    )

def main():
    pages = '\n  '.join(make_diagram(d) for d in DIAGRAMS)
    xml = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
        '<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" modified="2026-04-10T00:00:00.000Z" '
        'agent="draw.io" version="21.0.0" type="browser">\n  '
        + pages + '\n</mxfile>'
    )
    out = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/e_recruitment_sequence_diagrams.drawio'
    with open(out,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(xml)
    print(f'Done -> {out}')

main()
PYEOF

done
ls xml/

Looking at the functional requirements more carefully, I need Perusahaan for the company profile, Dokumen for CV uploads, and Notifikasi for status updates. I should also clarify whether HRD and Admin are the same role or if they need to be separate classes.

Now I'm mapping out the core classes with their attributes and methods. Pelamar needs registration and login functionality along with job application features, HRD handles recruitment operations like managing job postings and updating application statuses, and Lowongan stores the job listing details.

I'm also defining Lamaran to track individual applications with their status and notes, Profil to manage applicant background information like education and skills, and adding Dokumen as a new entity to store uploaded files like CVs.

Now I'm adding Notifikasi to handle system messages and alerts, plus Perusahaan to represent employer profiles with company details and branding. I'm starting to map out the relationships between these entities—Pelamar connects one-to-one with Profil and one-to-many with Lamaran.

Continuing with the relationships: Pelamar can have multiple Dokumen and receive many Notifikasi, HRD manages job postings and processes applications while sending notifications, Lowongan links to multiple Lamaran, and Perusahaan owns all the job postings. @startuml ClassDiagram_ERecruitment_EcoGreen
title Class Diagram - Sistem E-Recruitment PT Eco Green Oleochemicals

skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam classFontStyle bold
skinparam classBackgroundColor #FFFFEE
skinparam classBorderColor #888888
skinparam arrowColor #444444
skinparam linetype ortho

' ==================== KELAS PELAMAR ====================
class Pelamar {
  - id_pelamar : int
  - nama : String
  - email : String
  - password : String
  - no_telepon : String
  - tanggal_lahir : Date
  - jenis_kelamin : String
  - alamat : String
  - tanggal_registrasi : Date
  + register() : void
  + login() : boolean
  + logout() : void
  + lihatLowongan() : List<Lowongan>
  + melamar(id_lowongan: int) : Lamaran
  + lihatStatusLamaran() : List<Lamaran>
}

' ==================== KELAS HRD ====================
class HRD {
  - id_hrd : int
  - nama : String
  - email : String
  - password : String
  - jabatan : String
  - no_telepon : String
  + login() : boolean
  + logout() : void
  + tambahLowongan(lowongan: Lowongan) : void
  + editLowongan(id_lowongan: int) : void
  + hapusLowongan(id_lowongan: int) : void
  + lihatPelamar() : List<Pelamar>
  + seleksiPelamar(id_lamaran: int) : void
  + ubahStatusLamaran(id_lamaran: int, status: String) : void
  + kirimNotifikasi(id_pelamar: int, pesan: String) : void
}

' ==================== KELAS LOWONGAN ====================
class Lowongan {
  - id_lowongan : int
  - judul : String
  - deskripsi : String
  - kualifikasi : String
  - jenis_pekerjaan : String
  - lokasi : String
  - gaji : String
  - batas_lamaran : Date
  - status : String
  - tanggal_dibuat : Date
  + tambahLowongan() : void
  + editLowongan() : void
  + hapusLowongan() : void
  + getLowongan() : Lowongan
  + getDaftarLowongan() : List<Lowongan>
  + cariLowongan(keyword: String) : List<Lowongan>
}

' ==================== KELAS LAMARAN ====================
class Lamaran {
  - id_lamaran : int
  - tanggal_melamar : Date
  - status : String
  - catatan_pelamar : String
  - catatan_hrd : String
  - tanggal_update : Date
  + kirimLamaran() : void
  + batalLamaran() : void
  + updateStatus(status: String) : void
  + getStatus() : String
  + getLamaran() : Lamaran
  + getDaftarLamaran() : List<Lamaran>
}

' ==================== KELAS PROFIL ====================

  - id_profil : int
  - pendidikan_terakhir : String
  - jurusan : String
  - institusi : String
  - tahun_lulus : int
  - pengalaman_kerja : String
  - keahlian : String
  - foto : String
  - linkedin : String
  - tanggal_update : Date
  + updateProfil() : void
  + getProfil() : Profil
  + tambahPengalaman(data: String) : void
  + tambahKeahlian(keahlian: String) : void
}

' ==================== KELAS DOKUMEN (BARU) ====================
class Dokumen {
  - id_dokumen : int
  - nama_file : String
  - tipe_dokumen : String
  - ukuran_file : double
  - path_file : String
  - tanggal_upload : Date
  - keterangan : String
  + uploadDokumen(file: File) : void
  + hapusDokumen() : void
  + getDokumen() : Dokumen
  + getDaftarDokumen() : List<Dokumen>
  + validasiFile(file: File) : boolean
}

' ==================== KELAS NOTIFIKASI (BARU) ====================
class Notifikasi {
  - id_notifikasi : int
  - judul : String
  - pesan : String
  - tanggal_kirim : Date
  - status_baca : boolean
  - tipe_notifikasi : String
  + kirimNotifikasi() : void
  + tandaiBaca() : void
  + hapusNotifikasi() : void
  + getNotifikasi() : Notifikasi

}

' ==================== KELAS PERUSAHAAN (BARU) ====================

  - nama_perusahaan : String

  - bidang_usaha : String
  - alamat : String
  - kota : String
  - no_telepon : String
  - email_perusahaan : String
  - website : String
  - logo : String
  - tahun_berdiri : int

  + getProfilPerusahaan() : Perusahaan
  + getLowongan() : List<Lowongan>
}

Lamaran "1" -- "0..*" Dokumen : melampirkan >

Perusahaan "1" -- "0..*" Lowongan : memiliki >

' HRD - Lamaran (1:N)
HRD "1" -- "0..*" Lamaran : memproses >

@enduml

The user wants practical advice on efficiently searching, evaluating fit, and verifying safety of open-source projects. This is a knowledge question I can answer directly.Pertanyaan bagus, Shin. Ini panduan praktisnya:

---

**1. Cara mencari lebih efisien**

Gunakan **filter dan operator pencarian GitHub**. Jangan cuma ketik keyword biasa, tapi manfaatkan fitur advanced search:

- **Bahasa pemrograman:** tambahkan `language:python` atau `language:javascript` di search bar supaya hasilnya langsung sesuai tech stack kamu.
- **Sortir hasil:** sort by "Most stars" atau "Recently updated" supaya yang muncul duluan adalah project populer atau yang masih aktif.
- **Topics/Tags:** di GitHub banyak project pakai tag seperti `job-board`, `recruitment`, `career`. Kamu bisa klik topic tersebut untuk lihat project sejenis.
- **Contoh query:** `job application tracker language:python stars:>50` — ini langsung filter project Python dengan minimal 50 stars.

Intinya, **semakin spesifik keyword + filter, semakin sedikit waktu terbuang** scroll project yang tidak relevan.

---

**2. Cara menilai apakah project sesuai kriteria kamu**

Sebelum mulai browsing, **tulis dulu daftar kriteria aplikasi kamu**, misalnya:

- Fitur apa saja yang dibutuhkan? (login, upload CV, status lamaran, dashboard admin, dll)
- Tech stack apa yang dipakai/diminta dosen?
- Skala aplikasi — sederhana atau kompleks?

Lalu saat menemukan project, cek hal-hal ini:

- **README.md** — ini "wajah" project. Baca deskripsi, fitur, dan screenshot-nya. Kalau README-nya kosong atau berantakan, biasanya project-nya juga kurang rapi.
- **Demo/Screenshot** — banyak project yang sediakan live demo atau screenshot. Ini cara tercepat untuk tahu cocok atau tidak tanpa harus install dulu.
- **Daftar fitur** — cocokkan dengan checklist kebutuhan kamu tadi.
- **Tech stack** — biasanya ditulis di README. Pastikan sesuai dengan yang kamu kuasai atau yang diminta dosen.
- **Struktur folder** — buka sekilas file dan folder-nya. Kalau terstruktur rapi, biasanya lebih mudah dipahami dan dimodifikasi.

---

**3. Cara memastikan project aman untuk diakses dan dipakai**

Ini penting dan sering diabaikan:

- **Lisensi** — cek file `LICENSE` di repository. Lisensi yang umum dan aman dipakai: **MIT**, **Apache 2.0**, **BSD**. Kalau lisensinya **GPL**, kamu boleh pakai tapi ada syarat tertentu (hasil modifikasi harus open-source juga). Kalau **tidak ada lisensi sama sekali**, secara hukum kamu sebenarnya tidak punya izin untuk memakainya.

- **Jumlah stars, forks, dan kontributor** — project yang banyak dilihat orang lebih kecil kemungkinan mengandung kode berbahaya, karena sudah banyak mata yang mereview.

- **Issues dan Pull Requests** — cek tab Issues. Kalau banyak laporan bug tanpa respon, atau ada laporan keamanan yang diabaikan, itu red flag.

- **Terakhir di-update** — project yang sudah bertahun-tahun tidak di-update mungkin punya celah keamanan (vulnerability) di dependency-nya.

- **Jangan langsung jalankan kode asing di komputer utama** — kalau mau coba install dan run, lebih baik pakai environment terpisah (virtual machine, Docker, atau minimal virtual environment untuk Python). Ini untuk jaga-jaga kalau ada kode yang tidak aman.

- **Scan dependency** — setelah clone, kamu bisa cek apakah ada library yang dipakai project tersebut punya known vulnerability. GitHub sendiri biasanya menampilkan peringatan "Dependabot alerts" kalau ada.

---

Singkatnya: **spesifik saat mencari, cocokkan dengan checklist kebutuhan, dan selalu cek lisensi + reputasi project sebelum dipakai.** Kalau kamu mau, ceritakan fitur dan tech stack aplikasi kamu — saya bisa bantu carikan project yang lebih spesifik.

**1. Cari screenshot langsung di README**

Scroll cepat ke bagian README — biasanya kalau developer peduli desain, mereka taruh screenshot atau GIF di sana. Kalau README tidak ada gambar sama sekali, kemungkinan besar desainnya memang bukan fokus utama project tersebut. Langsung skip dan lanjut ke project berikutnya.

**2. Cek live demo**

Banyak project yang sediakan link demo (biasanya di bagian atas README atau di kolom "About" sebelah kanan). Cari kata-kata seperti "Live Demo", "Demo", atau icon link di samping deskripsi repo. Ini cara tercepat — kamu langsung lihat tampilan aslinya di browser tanpa install apapun.

**3. Manfaatkan pencarian yang lebih visual**

Daripada cari di GitHub (yang memang text-heavy), coba platform lain yang lebih mengedepankan tampilan visual:

- **Dribbble / Behance** — cari keyword "job application app UI" atau "job portal design". Di sini desainer menampilkan mockup dan desain lengkap. Kamu bisa dapat inspirasi desain dulu, baru cari project GitHub yang mirip.
- **Vercel Templates** atau **Netlify Templates** — banyak template yang sudah di-deploy dan bisa langsung dilihat tampilannya.
- **ThemeForest** — meskipun berbayar, kamu bisa lihat preview desainnya secara gratis untuk dijadikan referensi.

**4. Gunakan GitHub Topics + filter "has demo"**

Coba tambahkan keyword `demo` atau `live` di pencarian, misalnya: `job portal demo site:github.com`. Ini membantu menemukan repo yang memang menyediakan demo.

Tanpa clone, kamu bisa langsung browse file di GitHub lewat browser. Buka folder seperti `screenshots/`, `docs/`, `images/`, atau `assets/` — kadang developer taruh gambar tampilan aplikasi di sana.

They want to know: 1. Where to put frontend files in Laravel's directory structure 2. How to organize things properly 3. How to make sure it doesn't error Since they're using Laravel with pure HTML/CSS/JS (no Blade PHP in views), and all data via AJAX to API, I need to think about the best approach. Let me think about the Laravel project structure for this use case: Option 1: Use Laravel's `public/` directory for static HTML files Option 2: Use Laravel's Blade views but only as HTML shells (no PHP) Option 3: Use `resources/views` with minimal Blade just for routing, but pure HTML/CSS/JS content For their case with a presentation tomorrow and focusing on design, the most practical approach is using `resources/views/` with Blade files that contain pure HTML—this keeps Laravel's routing working properly while letting them focus on frontend design without worrying about PHP syntax errors. I'll structure this with a master layout file that handles the HTML boilerplate and inheritance, keeping everything else as static assets in the public folder.Pertanyaan bagus, Shin. Karena kamu kejar presentasi besok dan fokus design dulu, ini panduan struktur yang rapi dan anti-error: ## Konsep Dasarnya Walaupun kamu bilang "no PHP di view", di Laravel tetap pakai file `.blade.php` — tapi isinya **pure HTML**. PHP-nya cuma 1-2 baris untuk layout inheritance (`@extends`, `@yield`). Ini cara paling rapi karena routing Laravel langsung works, dan nanti tinggal sambung API. ## Struktur yang Saya Rekomendasikan ``` project-ecogreen/ ├── resources/views/ │ ├── layouts/ │ │ └── app.blade.php ← Master layout (header, sidebar, footer) │ ├── auth/ │ │ ├── login.blade.php │ │ └── register.blade.php │ ├── admin/ │ │ ├── dashboard.blade.php │ │ ├── lowongan.blade.php │ │ └── pelamar.blade.php │ ├── pelamar/ │ │ ├── dashboard.blade.php │ │ ├── profil.blade.php │ │ └── lamaran.blade.php │ └── landing.blade.php ← Halaman utama/publik │ ├── public/ │ ├── css/ │ │ ├── app.css ← Global styles (reset, typography, colors) │ │ ├── components.css ← Reusable (button, card, modal, table) │ │ ├── auth.css ← Style untuk login/register │ │ ├── admin.css ← Style halaman admin │ │ └── pelamar.css ← Style halaman pelamar │ ├── js/ │ │ ├── app.js ← Global (AJAX helper, auth check) │ │ ├── auth.js ← Login/register logic │ │ ├── admin/ │ │ │ ├── dashboard.js │ │ │ ├── lowongan.js │ │ │ └── pelamar.js │ │ └── pelamar/ │ │ ├── dashboard.js │ │ ├── profil.js │ │ └── lamaran.js │ └── images/ │ ├── logo.png │ └── ... │ ├── routes/ │ ├── web.php ← Return view saja (no logic) │ └── api.php ← Semua endpoint data ``` ## Urutan Implementasi **Step 1** — Buat master layout dulu (`layouts/app.blade.php`). Ini kerangka HTML yang semua halaman pakai: head, navbar/sidebar, area konten, footer, dan link ke CSS/JS. **Step 2** — Buat `app.css` untuk global styles: warna brand, font, reset, dan variabel CSS yang konsisten di semua halaman. **Step 3** — Buat `components.css` untuk komponen yang muncul berulang: button, card, form input, tabel, badge status, dsb. **Step 4** — Buat halaman satu per satu. Setiap halaman cuma extend layout dan isi konten HTML statis. Contoh isi `admin/dashboard.blade.php`: ```blade @extends('layouts.app') @section('title', 'Dashboard Admin') @section('css') @endsection @section('content')

Dashboard Admin

- Total Pelamar
@endsection @section('js') @endsection ``` **Step 5** — Daftarkan route di `web.php`, cukup return view: ```php Route::get('/', fn() => view('landing')); Route::get('/login', fn() => view('auth.login')); Route::get('/admin/dashboard', fn() => view('admin.dashboard')); // dst... ``` **Step 6** — Terakhir (nanti, bukan sekarang), buat API endpoint di `api.php` dan sambungkan via AJAX di file JS masing-masing. ## Tips Anti-Error Pakai `{{ asset('...') }}` untuk semua path CSS/JS/images supaya path-nya selalu benar. Jangan hard-code path manual. Dan pastikan `php artisan serve` jalan saat testing. --- Jadi langkah pertamamu sekarang: **kirim screenshot Figma halaman pertama** (biasanya login atau landing page), dan saya langsung buatkan master layout + halaman pertamanya sekaligus. Shin wants a detailed comparison between Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS, including pros/cons and which is better for professional/enterprise-level UI/UX design.Oke, saya jelaskan perbandingannya secara lengkap supaya kamu bisa pilih dengan yakin.

## Konsep Dasar

**Bootstrap** itu framework berbasis **komponen**. Dia sudah sediakan komponen jadi seperti navbar, card, modal, table, form — kamu tinggal pakai class-nya dan langsung muncul. Ibaratnya seperti beli furniture IKEA — sudah jadi, tinggal pasang.

**Tailwind CSS** itu framework berbasis **utility**. Dia tidak kasih komponen jadi, tapi kasih kamu "alat-alat kecil" (utility class) untuk bangun design sendiri dari nol. Ibaratnya seperti beli kayu, paku, dan cat — kamu bentuk sendiri sesuai mau.

## Perbandingan

**Kecepatan development** — Bootstrap lebih cepat untuk prototyping karena komponen sudah siap. Tailwind lebih lambat di awal, tapi setelah terbiasa dan punya komponen sendiri, kecepatannya bisa setara atau lebih cepat.

**Kebebasan design** — Di sinilah perbedaan besar. Bootstrap punya "tampilan khas Bootstrap" yang susah dihilangkan — banyak website akhirnya terlihat mirip. Tailwind kasih kebebasan penuh, setiap elemen bisa kamu design seunik mungkin tanpa harus override style bawaan.

**Untuk standar perusahaan/client** — Tailwind lebih unggul. Perusahaan biasanya punya brand guideline sendiri (warna, spacing, tipografi). Tailwind bisa dikonfigurasi di `tailwind.config.js` supaya semua utility class mengikuti brand guideline. Bootstrap bisa juga tapi harus banyak override CSS, yang sering bikin kode berantakan.

**Ukuran file** — Bootstrap memuat semua CSS-nya sekitar 230KB meskipun kamu cuma pakai 10% komponennya. Tailwind di production cuma memuat class yang benar-benar kamu pakai, jadi file-nya bisa jauh lebih kecil dan website lebih ringan.

**Learning curve** — Bootstrap lebih mudah dipelajari karena tinggal hafalin nama komponen. Tailwind butuh waktu adaptasi karena kamu harus paham CSS properties-nya dulu, baru bisa pakai utility class-nya dengan efektif.

**Maintainability** — Bootstrap sering bikin masalah di project besar karena override CSS menumpuk dan saling bentrok. Tailwind lebih bersih karena style langsung di elemen, tidak ada CSS yang saling timpa.

**Komunitas & tren industri** — Bootstrap sudah lama jadi standar (sejak 2011), tapi tren industri sekarang bergeser ke Tailwind. Banyak perusahaan tech modern dan startup sudah adopsi Tailwind. Framework populer seperti Next.js, Laravel Breeze, dan banyak template premium sekarang default pakai Tailwind.

## Kelebihan & Kekurangan

**Bootstrap:**
- Kelebihan: cepat, mudah dipelajari, dokumentasi lengkap, komponen JS siap pakai (modal, dropdown, carousel), cocok untuk yang belum kuat CSS.
- Kekurangan: tampilan generik, susah dikustomisasi mendalam, file besar, banyak override CSS kalau mau beda dari tampilan default, kurang fleksibel untuk design unik.

**Tailwind:**
- Kelebihan: design bebas dan unik, file production kecil, mudah mengikuti brand guideline, konsisten, scalable untuk project besar, standar industri modern.
- Kekurangan: HTML jadi panjang karena banyak class, butuh build tool (Vite), learning curve lebih tinggi, tidak ada komponen JS bawaan (perlu library tambahan seperti Alpine.js atau Headless UI).

## Rekomendasi untuk Project Kamu

Kalau kamu bicara **standar client perusahaan** dan **kualitas UI/UX terbaik**, jawabannya **Tailwind CSS**. Alasannya, design untuk PT Eco Green Oleochemicals harus terlihat profesional dan unik sesuai brand mereka — bukan terlihat seperti template Bootstrap yang banyak beredar. Tailwind juga lebih scalable kalau project ini dikembangkan lebih lanjut.

**Tapi** — mengingat presentasi besok dan kamu butuh cepat, kamu bisa pertimbangkan dua opsi. Pertama, tetap pakai Bootstrap sekarang untuk kejar deadline, lalu migrasi ke Tailwind nanti. Kedua, langsung pakai Tailwind dari awal, dan saya bantu setup serta buatkan semua halamannya supaya kamu tidak perlu pusing dengan konfigurasinya.

Mau pilih yang mana, Shin?

## Kalau Pakai CDN (untuk sekarang, kejar presentasi)

Tidak ada file `tailwind.config.js` terpisah. Konfigurasinya langsung di dalam layout Blade via tag `<script>`:

